rows.reference: Ẹkún síssun jẹ́ àfihàn ìbínú àmọ́ àwọn èèyàn ‘ò mọ̀.

rows.source: One of my sharpest memories from an early job, in a male-dominated office, where I once found myself weeping with inexpressible rage, was my being grabbed by the scruff of my neck by an older woman - a chilly manager of whom I'd always been slightly terrified - who dragged me into a stairwell.
rows.output: Ọkan lára ​​àwọn ìrántí tó dára jùlọ láti ọ̀dọ̀ iṣẹ́ àkọ́kọ́ mi, nínú ọ́fíìsì tí àwọn ọkùnrin jẹ́ olórí, níbi tí mo ti rí ara mi tí ń sunkún pẹ̀lú ìbànújẹ́ tí kò lè sọ, ni ọ̀rọ̀ kan tí obìnrin àgbà kan tí mo ti ń bẹ̀rù díẹ̀ ṣe, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ olùdarí tó ń gbé
rows.reference: Mo rántí nígbà tí mo wà ní ibiṣẹ́ kan, ọkụ̀nrin ló pọ̀ jù ní ibiṣẹ́ náà. Lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà tínú bá bí mi, bẹ́è ni máa bú sígbe. Ní ọjọ́ kan ní ọgá wa kan, màmá arúgbó ni wọ́n, ni wọ́n fa mí lọ sí ẹ̀gbẹ́ kan, àmọ́ ẹ̀rù ń bà mí bí wọ́n ṣe mú mi dání.

rows.source: "Never let them see you crying," she told me.
rows.output: "Kò jẹ́ kí wọ́n rí ẹ ní ẹ̀jẹ̀," ó sọ fún mi.
rows.reference: ”Má sunkún mọ níwájú àwọn èèyàn,” ni mò ń gbọ́.

rows.source: "They don't know you're furious.
rows.output: Wọn kò mọ̀ pé o ń bínú.
rows.reference: Kò yé wọn pé inú ló ń bí ẹ.

rows.source: They think you're sad and will be pleased because they got to you."
rows.output: Wọ́n rò pé o nira fún ọ, wọ́n á sì dùn nítorí pé wọ́n ti dé ọ.
rows.reference: Bí ìgbà tí òfò ń ṣe ẹ ló ń rò. Inú wọn ń dùn ni torí wọ́n rò pé àwọn ló ń mú ẹ sọkún.@

rows.source: Patricia Schroeder, then a Democratic congresswoman from Colorado, had worked with Gary Hart on his presidential runs.
rows.output: Patricia Schroeder, to jẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ìjọba olóṣèlú Democratic kan láti Colorado, ti ṣiṣẹ́ pọ̀ pẹ̀lú Gary Hart lórí àwọn ìpè rẹ̀ fún ààrẹ.
rows.reference: Patricia Schroeder, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrat àti aṣòfin ní Colorado nígbà kan,bá Gary Hart ṣiṣẹ́ nígbà tó n du ipò ààrẹ.

rows.source: In 1987, when Mr. Hart was caught in an extramarital affair aboard a boat called Monkey Business and bowed out of the race, Ms. Schroeder, deeply frustrated, figured there was no reason she shouldn't explore the idea of running for president herself.
rows.output: Ni ọdun 1987, nigbati Ọgbẹni Hart ba mu ninu ẹlẹgbẹ kan ti o wa ni ọkọ oju omi ti a npe ni Monkey Business ati pe o fi ipo silẹ ninu ere-ije naa, Iyaafin Schroeder, ti o ni ibanujẹ gidigidi, ro pe ko si idi ti ko fi le ṣawari imọran ti ṣiṣe fun aarẹ funrarẹ.
rows.reference: Ní ọdún 1987, tí wọ́n ní Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Hart ní àjọṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú obínrin mìíràn nínú ọkọ ojú-omi Monkey Business, bí Hart ‘ò ṣe díje fún ipò náà mọ́ nìyẹn. Iṣẹ̀lẹ̀ yí ‘ò dùn mọ́ Aya Schroeder nínú. Bí ó ṣe pinnu láti gbégba ìbò ààrẹ nìyẹn.

rows.source: "It was not a well-thought-out decision," she said to me with a laugh 30 years later.
rows.output: "Kò jẹ́ ìpinnu tí a ṣe dáadáa," ó sọ fún mi pẹ̀lú ẹ̀rín ọdún mẹ́ta lẹ́yìn náà.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn ọgbọ̀n ọdún, ó ní “ìpinnu yẹn ‘da to ó.

rows.source: "There were already seven other candidates in the race, and the last thing they needed was another one.
rows.output: "Àwọn ẹlẹ́ṣin márùn-ún mìíràn wà nínú ìdíje náà, wọn ò sì nílò ẹlẹ́ṣin mìíràn.
rows.reference: ”Àwọn méje ti wà nílẹ̀, tí wọ́n dìje du ipò ààrẹ. Wọn ‘ò wa kẹ́lòmíì darapọ̀ mọ́ wọn.

rows.source: Somebody called it "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.""
rows.output: Ẹnikan pe ni "Ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ Àwọ̀ Ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ àti Àwọn Dwarfs Meje."
rows.reference: Fíìmù kan tí àkọlé ẹ jẹ́ “Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs” ni èèyàn kan kà á kún.”

rows.source: Because it was late in the campaign, she was behind on fund-raising, and so she vowed that she wouldn't enter the race unless she raised $2 million.
rows.output: Nítorí pé ó pẹ́ jù nínú ìpolongo náà, ó jìnnà síra láti gbà owó, torí náà ó ṣe ìlérí pé kò ní wọ inú eré náà láì fi owó tó $2 mílíọ̀nù.
rows.reference: Torí ó pẹ́ kí ọmọbìnrin yìí tó jaHde láti díje, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kò ní owó lọwọ́, ó pinnu láti wáwó tó tó mílíọnu 2 dọ́là kó tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ni lọ káàkiri.

rows.source: It was a losing battle.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ìjà tí a kò lè ṣẹ́gun.
rows.reference: Ìjà tí kò lè borí rèé.

rows.source: She discovered that some of her supporters who gave $1,000 to men would give her only $250.
rows.output: Ó rí i pé àwọn olùtìlẹ́yìn rẹ̀ kan tí wọ́n fún ẹgbẹ̀rún dọ́là ẹgbẹ̀rún kan fún àwọn ọkùnrin náà, wọ́n fún un ní ẹgbẹ̀rún ọgọ́ta dọ́là nìkan.
rows.reference: Àwọn t’ọ́n fún ni 250 dọlà, máa fún àwọn ọkùnrin ẹgbẹ́ ẹ̀ ní 1000 dọ́là.

rows.source: "Do they think I get a discount?" she wondered.
rows.output: "Ṣé wọ́n rò pé mo ń gba ìdínkù?" ó ronú.
rows.reference: ”Ṣé wọ́n rò pé ẹ̀dínwó wà fún mi ni?” ni ìbéèrè tó ń bi ara ẹ̀ léèrè.

rows.source: When she made her speech announcing that she would not launch a formal campaign, she was so overcome by emotions - gratitude for the people who'd supported her, frustration with the system that made it so difficult to raise money and to target voters rather than delegates, and anger at the sexism - that she got choked up.
rows.output: Nígbà tí ó sọ ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ nípa ìkìlọ̀ pé kò ní ṣe ìpolongo ìṣèlú, ó bínú gan-an - ìmoore fún àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ti ṣètìlẹ́yìn fún un, ìbànújẹ́ pẹ̀lú eto náà tí ó jẹ́ kí ó ṣòro láti gba owó, àti láti fojú sọ́nà fún àwọn olùdìbò dípò àwọn aṣojú,
rows.reference: Nígbà tó kéde pé òun ‘ò ní sẹ ìkéde ńlá, ó sọ ẹ̀dùn ọkàn ẹ̀ – ó dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ àwọn t’ọ́n gbárùkùtí, sọ̀rọ̀ lóri ìsoro lóri ọ̀rọ̀ owó tí ó ní lò fún ìkéde sí àwọn olùdìbò àti ìrúnú sí ìyàtọ̀ tó waà láàrin ọkùnrin àti obìnrin – gbogbo ohun tó muú dorí góńgó.

rows.source: "You would have thought I'd had a nervous breakdown," recalled Ms. Schroeder about how the press reacted to her.
rows.output: "O yẹ ki o ro pe mo ti ni ìyàlẹnu," Ms. Schroeder sọ nipa bi awọn oniroyin ṣe fesi si i.
rows.reference: ”Bíi ìgbà tí mo ní àrùn lára ni àwọn oníròyìn sọ mí dà.”

rows.source: "You'd have thought Kleenex was my corporate sponsor.
rows.output: "O yẹ ki o ro pe Kleenex ni onigbowo ile-iṣẹ mi.
rows.reference: ”Ọ̀pọ̀ ló ní ile-iṣẹ́ Kleenex jẹ́ agbátẹrù mi.

rows.source: I remember thinking, what are they going to put on my tombstone?
rows.output: Mo rántí pé mo rò pé, kí ni wọ́n máa kọ sí ibojì mi?
rows.reference: Mo ròó débi pé kí ni àwọn èèyàn máa kọ síbi ìtẹ́kùú mi?

rows.source: "She cried"?""
rows.output: "O sọkún?"
rows.reference: ”Tígbetigbe ló fi sọ̀rọ̀”?

rows.source: How the US-China trade war may be good for Beijing
rows.output: Bí ìjà ìtajà US àti Ṣáínà ṣe lè jẹ́ ohun tí Beijing nílò
rows.reference: Beijing ló máa jẹ àǹfààní ìjà tó dá lórí ọrọ̀-ajé tó wá láàrin Amẹ́ríkà àti China

rows.source: The opening salvos of the trade war between the US and China were deafening, and while the battle is far from over, a rift between the countries may be beneficial to Beijing in the long term, experts say.
rows.output: Àwọn ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìjà ìtajà láàárín US àti Ṣáínà jẹ́ ohun tó ń bani lẹ́rù, àtipé bí ìjà náà ti ń lọ, ìyapa láàárín àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè náà lè jẹ́ àǹfààní fún Beijing ní ìgbà pípẹ́, àwọn amòye sọ.
rows.reference: Àwọn onímọ̀ ní ìjà tó dá lórí ọrọ̀-ajé tó wá láàrin Amẹ́ríkà àti China kò ní ojútùú, àtipé kò le parí. Nígbẹ̀yìn, Beijing ló máa jẹ àǹfààní ìjà yí.

rows.source: Donald Trump, the US President, fired the first warning earlier this year by taxing key Chinese exports including solar panels, steel and aluminium.
rows.output: Donald Trump, Ààrẹ Orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, ti gbé ìkìlọ̀ àkọ́kọ́ jáde ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí nípa fífi owó-orí kún àwọn ọjà pàtàkì ti Ṣáínà, títí kan àwọn panẹli oòrùn, irin, àti àlùmọ́ní.
rows.reference: Donald Trump, Ààrẹ Amẹ́ríkà, fìdí ọ̀rọ̀ yí múlẹ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí. Ó gbówó lé owó-orí àwọn ọjà bíi sólà, irin àti alumí t’ọ́n ti China wàá.

rows.source: The most significant escalation rolled in this week with new tariffs affecting $200 billion (£150 billion) worth of items, effectively taxing half of all goods coming into the US from China.
rows.output: Ìyípadà tó ṣe pàtàkì jù lọ tó wáyé ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí ni àwọn ìdájọ́ tuntun tó kan $200 biliọnu (150 biliọnu) nínú àwọn nǹkan, tó jẹ́ kí ìdájọ́ kan nínú gbogbo àwọn ọjà tó ń bọ̀ sí orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà láti Ṣáínà.
rows.reference: Lọ́sẹ̀ yí àfikún tó dé bá owó-orí kan iye ọjà tó tó bílíọ́nù 200 dọ́là. China ni àwọn ọjà yí tí ń wá sí Amẹ́ríkà.

rows.source: Beijing has retaliated each time in kind, most recently slapping tariffs of five to ten per cent on $60 billion of American goods.
rows.output: Beijing ti gba ni gbogbo igba, ni igba to ṣẹṣẹ julọ nipa fifi owo-ori ti o wa lati marun si mẹwa ogorun lori $60 bilionu awọn ọja Amẹrika.
rows.reference: Beijing náà ṣe tiẹ̀. Ó gbé owó tó lé ní ìdá márùn-ún sí mẹ́wàá lorí àwọn ọjà to tó bílíọ́nù 60 dọ́là lórí àwọn ọjà tó ti Amẹ́ríkà wá.

rows.source: China has pledged to match the US shot-for-shot, and the world's second largest economy is unlikely to blink anytime soon.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Ṣáínà ti ṣèlérí láti bá àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà ìlọ́po méjì, àwọn ètò ọrọ̀ ajé tó tóbi jù lọ ní ayé kò sì ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n yára yí padà ní kánjúkánjú.
rows.reference: China ni ohun tí Amẹ́ríkà bá ṣe ni òun náà máa ṣe e. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kò sí ohun tó lè mi ọ̀rọ̀-ajé China tó wà ní ipò kejì lágbàáyé.

rows.source: Getting Washington to back down means caving into demands, but publicly bowing to the US would be far too embarrassing for Xi Jinping, China's president.
rows.output: Ìdáhùn Washington sí ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ìbéèrè náà túmọ̀ sí ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n fífi ara rẹ̀ hàn sí orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà yóò jẹ́ ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì búburú fún Xi Jinping, ààrẹ Ṣáínà.
rows.reference: T’Ámẹ́ríkà bá jọwọ́ sílẹ̀ bíi ìgbà tí wọ́n ń ṣe ohun tí àwọn èèyàn fẹ́ ni. Ṣùgbọ́n fún Xi Jinping, Ààrẹ China, kò ní gbà sí Amẹ́ríkà lẹ́nu torí ohun ìtìjú ni.

rows.source: Still, experts say if Beijing can play its cards right, US trade war pressures could positively support China over the long term by lowering the inter-dependence of the two economies.
rows.output: Bí ó ti wù kí ó rí, àwọn amòye sọ pé bí Beijing bá lè ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rẹ̀ dáadáa, ìjà ìtajà àgbáyé lè ṣe àtìlẹ́yìn fún Ṣáínà ní ìgbà pípẹ́ nípa dídín ìbáṣepọ̀ láàárín àwọn ọ̀rọ̀-ajé méjèèjì.
rows.reference: Àwọn onímọ̀ tẹnumọ pé bíi Beijing bá ta ayò ẹ̀ dáadáa, òun ló máa jẹ àǹfààní ìjà yí nígbẹ̀yìn. Ìgbáralé ọjà tó ń ti ìú kọ̀ọ̀kan jáde ma dínkù

rows.source: "The fact that a quick political decision in either Washington or Beijing could create the conditions that start an economic tailspin in either country is actually a lot more dangerous than onlookers have acknowledged before," said Abigail Grace, a research associate who focuses on Asia at the Center for New American Security, a think tank.
rows.output: "Ìtàn náà pé ìpinnu ìṣèlú yára ní Washington tàbí Beijing lè dá àyíká tí yóò mú kí ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ètò ọrọ̀ ajé bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní orílẹ̀-èdè méjèèjì, ó jẹ́ ohun tí ó léwu ju bí àwọn tó ń wo lórí ṣe ti jẹ́ kí a mọ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀," ni Abigail Grace, ẹni tí ó ń ṣe ìwádìí nípa Asia ní Center for New American Security
rows.reference: ”Yálà láti Washington tàbí Beijing, ohun tí àwọn olórí ìlú yìí bá ṣọ lè mú kí ọrọ̀-ajé wọn dojúbolẹ̀. Ó burú ju bíi àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó kù ṣe lérò lọ,” lèrò Abigail Grace, oníwádìí lóri ọ̀rọ̀ Asia láti Center for New American Security -ẹgbẹ́ tó ń ran àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè lọ́wọ́ láti ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ ètò-ìṣúná àti ọrọ̀-ajé.

rows.source: Syria 'ready' for refugees to return, says Foreign Minister
rows.output: Síríà ti ṣetan fún àwọn olùwá-ibi láti padà, ọ̀rọ̀ Ààrẹ Àjọ Àwọn Orílẹ̀-Èdè Àgbáyé
rows.reference: Mínísítà loŕi ọ̀rọ̀ ilẹ̀-òkèèrè ní Syria ‘setán’ láti gba àwọn ọmọ Syria tí wọ́n sá kúrò ní Syria padà

rows.source: Syria says it's ready for the voluntary return of refugees and is appealing for help to rebuild the country devastated by a more than seven-year long war.
rows.output: Síríà sọ pé ó ti ṣetan fún ìpadàbọ̀ àìlòkun ti àwọn aṣikiri, ó sì ń bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ láti tún orílẹ̀-èdè náà ṣe tí ogun tó ti pé ọdún méje ti bà jẹ́.
rows.reference: Syria ti ṣetán láti gba àwọn ọmọ ìlú e tí wọ́n fẹ́ padà sí orílẹ̀-èdè wọn padà. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni wọ́n rawọ́ ẹ̀bẹ̀ sí àwọn èèyàn láti ran àwọn lọ́wọ́ láti tún orílẹ̀-èdè tí ogun ọdún méje t run ṣe.

rows.source: Speaking to the United Nations General Assembly, Foreign minister Walid al-Moualem said conditions in the country are improving.
rows.output: Láti sọ̀rọ̀ sí Ìgbìmọ̀ Àwọn Orílẹ̀-èdè Àgbáyé, Minisita fún Ìbáṣepọ̀ Àgbáyé Walid al-Moualem sọ pé ipò orílẹ̀-èdè náà ń dára sí i.
rows.reference: Mínísítà loŕi ọ̀rọ̀ ilẹ̀-òkèèrè, Walid al-Moualem, sọ fún àjọ Àgbáyé pé nǹkan padà bọ̀ sípò ní orílẹ̀-èdè náà.

rows.source: "Today the situation on the ground is more stable and secure thanks to progress made in combating terrorism," he said.
rows.output: "Ọjọ́ yìí, ipò tó wà lórí ilẹ̀ náà ti dára si, kò sì sí ìdààmú mọ́ rárá, nítorí ìlọsíwájú tó wà nínú ìjàǹbá àwọn ọlọ́ṣà."
rows.reference: Ó ní, ”Nǹkan ti da ju ti àtẹ̀yínwa lọ. Àbò àti ìtẹ̀síwájú ti dé bá àwùjọ látàrí ìgbógunti àjàngbilà.”

rows.source: The government continues to rehabilitate the areas destroyed by terrorists to restore normalcy.
rows.output: Ijọba naa tẹsiwaju lati tun awọn agbegbe ti awọn onijagidijagan ti pa run lati mu pada deede.
rows.reference: Ìjọba tún gbogbo ibi tí àwọn alájàngbilà ti bàjẹ́ ṣe torí kí ìtẹ̀síwájú lè dé bá àwùjọ.

rows.source: All conditions are now present for the voluntary return of refugees to the country they had to leave because of terrorism and the unilateral economic measures that targeted their daily lives and their livelihoods.
rows.output: Gbogbo ipo bayi wa fun ipadabọ ti ara ẹni ti awọn aṣikiri si orilẹ-ede ti wọn ni lati lọ nitori iberu ati awọn igbese eto-ọrọ ti ko ni ẹtọ ti o dojukọ igbesi aye wọn lojoojumọ ati awọn iṣẹ-aje wọn.
rows.reference: Nítorí náà, àwọn ọmọ ìlú tí wọ́n sá kúrò ní orílẹ̀-èdè wọn látàrí àjàngbilà àti ọrọ̀-ajé tó buŕ jáì lè padà padà báyìí.

rows.source: The UN estimates that more than 5.5 million Syrians have fled the country since the war began in 2011.
rows.output: Àwọn UN sọ pé ju mílíọ̀nù 5.5 àwọn Síríà ló ti sá kúrò ní orílẹ̀-èdè náà láti ìgbà tí ogun bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ọdún 2011.
rows.reference: Àjọ UN ní ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè Syria tó lé ni mílíọ́nù 5 ló sá kúrò níbẹ̀ ní ọdún 2011.

rows.source: Another six million people still living in the country are in need of humanitarian assistance.
rows.output: Mẹ́rìndínlọ́gọ́ta mílíọ̀nù àwọn ènìyàn tún wà ní orílẹ̀-èdè náà tí wọ́n nílò ìrànlọ́wọ́ àjọṣepọ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn mílíọ́nù 6 tí wọ́n wà ní orílẹ̀-èdè náà nílò ìrànlọ́wọ́ àwọn àjọ onírànlọ́wọ́.

rows.source: Al-Moualem said the Syrian regime would welcome help in rebuilding the devastated country.
rows.output: Al-Moualem sọ pé ìjọba Síríà yóò kíyè sí ìrànlọ́wọ́ láti tún orílẹ̀-èdè tí ìbànújẹ́ bá ti bàjẹ́.
rows.reference: Al-Moualem ní ìjọba Syria nílò gbogbo ìrànlọwọ́ láti tún orílẹ̀-èdè náà ṣe.

rows.source: But he stressed that it would not accept conditional assistance or help from countries that sponsored the insurgency.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ó tẹnu mọ́ ọn pé kò ní gba ìrànlọ́wọ́ tí ó dá lórí àdéhùn tàbí ìrànlọ́wọ́ láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí wọ́n ń gbèjà ìkọlù náà.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ ‘ò ní àwọn ‘ò wá ìrànlọ́wọ́ kílóbádé tàbí láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè t’ọ́n jẹ́ onígbọ̀wọ́ fún àwọn lájàngbìlà.

rows.source: Europe clinches Ryder Cup victory in Paris
rows.output: Yúróòpù gba ìṣẹ́gun Ryder Cup ní Paris
rows.reference: Ọmọ Úróópù ló borí ní ìdíje ti Ryder ní Paris

rows.source: Team Europe has won the 2018 Ryder Cup defeating Team USA by a final score of 16.5 to 10.5 at Le Golf National outside Paris, France.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ Yúróòpù ti ṣẹ́gun ìdíje Ryder Cup 2018 nípa ṣíṣe àmì 16.5 sí 10.5 ní Le Golf National lóde ìlú Paris, Faranse.
rows.reference: Àwọn ẹgbẹ́ tí wọ́n wá láti Úróópù ná àwọn ẹgbẹ́ tí Amẹ́ríkà ní 16.5 sí 10.5 ní Le Golf National tó wà nítòsí Paris ní Faransé.

rows.source: The US has now lost six consecutive times on European soil and has not won a Ryder Cup in Europe since 1993.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà ti pàdánù ìdíje mẹ́fà tẹ́lẹ̀ ní ilẹ̀ Yúróòpù, wọn kò sì gba ìdíje Ryder Cup ní Yúróòpù láti ọdún 1993.
rows.reference: Ẹlẹ́kẹ̀ẹfà rèé tí ẹgbẹ́ ti Amẹ́ríkà máa pàdánù ìdíje ti Ryder léraléra ní ilẹ̀ Úróópù láti ọdún 1993

rows.source: Europe regained the crown as the Danish captain Thomas Bjorn's team reached the 14.5 points they required to beat the United States.
rows.output: Yuroopu gba ade ti o ti sọnu pada gẹgẹ bi ẹgbẹ ẹlẹsẹ Danish Thomas Bjorn ti de 14.5 ojuami ti wọn nilo lati ṣẹgun Amẹrika.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn, ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè Denmark àti olórí agbábọ́ọlù fún ẹgbẹ́ ti Úróópù ní máàkì 14.5 t’ọ́n nílò láti na ẹgbẹ́ ti Amẹ́ríkà.

rows.source: US star Phil Mickelson, who struggled most of the tournament, plunked his tee-shot into the water at the par-3 16th hole, conceding his match to Francesco Molinari.
rows.output: Ìràwọ̀ Amẹ́ríkà Phil Mickelson, tí ó tiraka jù lọ ní gbogbo eré náà, fi bọ́ọ̀lù rẹ̀ sínú omi ní ihò 16th par-3, ó sì jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ pé Francesco Molinari ti ṣẹ́gun.
rows.reference: Phil Mickelson, tí kò ṣe dáadáa ní ìdíje náà, gbá bọ́ọ̀lù láti ibi tee lọ sínú omi. Bí Francesco Molinari ṣe nàá nìyẹn.

rows.source: The Italian golfer Molinari shined in all of his rounds, becoming 1-of-4 players to ever go 5-0-0 since the tournament's current format begun in 1979.
rows.output: Ẹrọ orin golf Italia Molinari tan imọlẹ ni gbogbo awọn iyipo rẹ, di ọkan ninu awọn elere idaraya mẹrin nikan ti o ti ṣaṣeyọri eyi lati igba ti ọna lọwọlọwọ ti idije naa bẹrẹ ni 1979.
rows.reference: Ó yẹ Molinari, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ agbábọ̀ọ̀lù gọ́ọ̀fù torí ó yege nínú gbogbo ìfẹsèwọnsẹ̀ márùn-ún tó gbá. Ó jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn mẹ́rin tó ní irú àṣeyorí yìí.

rows.source: American Jordan Spieth was blown out 5&4 by the lowest-ranked player on the European team, Thorbjorn Olesen of Denmark.
rows.output: Ẹnìkan Amẹ́ríkà, Jordan Spieth, ni a fọ́ 5&4 nipasẹ́ ẹni tí ó kéré jù lọ lórí ẹgbẹ́ Yúróòpù, Thorbjorn Olesen ti Denmark.
rows.reference: Thorbjorn Olesen, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò mọ gọ́ọ̀fù gbá dáadáa, síbẹ̀ ó na Jordan Spieth, ọmọ Amẹ́ríkà ní 5 sí 4.

rows.source: The world's top-ranked player, Dustin Johnson, fell 2 and 1 to Ian Poulter of England who may have played in his final Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Ẹni tó ga jù lọ nínú àwọn eléré ìdárayá, Dustin Johnson, ṣubú 2 àti 1 sí Ian Poulter ti England, ẹni tó lè ti ṣe eré Ryder Cup tó kẹ́yìn.
rows.reference: Ian Poulter, ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè England na Dustin Johnson, agbágọ́ọ̀fù tó gbóná ní àgbáyé ní 2 sí 1. Ó ṣeéṣe kó jẹ́ Ian Poulter ‘ò ní kópa nínú ìdíje Ryder mọ́.

rows.source: A veteran of eight Ryder Cups, Spaniard Sergio Garcia became the tournaments all-time winningest European with 25.5 career point.
rows.output: Ẹni tí ó ti kópa nínú àwọn Ryder Cup mẹ́jọ, Sergio Garcia ará Sípéènì di ẹni tí ó ní àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn ẹ̀rí àkọ́kọ́ Yúróòpù pẹ̀lú 25.5 àkọsílẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́.
rows.reference: Spaniard Sergio Garcia ni gbajúgbajà agbágọ́ọ̀fù tó gba ife Ryder ní ẹẹ̀mẹjọ. Gbogbo máàkì tó ní jẹ́ 25.5.

rows.source: "I don't usually cry but today I can't help it.
rows.output: "Mo máa ń sunkún, ṣùgbọ́n lónìí, mi ò lè ràn án lọ́wọ́.
rows.reference: ”Lóòótọ́ mò ń kẹ́ àmọ́ ẹkún ayọ̀ ni tòní.

rows.source: It's been a rough year.
rows.output: Ó ti jẹ́ ọdún tí ó le.
rows.reference: Ọdún yìí ‘ò rọgbọ.

rows.source: So thankful for Thomas to pick me and believe in me.
rows.output: Inú mi dùn fún Thomas láti yan mi àti láti gbà mí gbọ́.
rows.reference: Mo dúpẹ́ lọwọ́ Thomas tó rànmílọ́wọ́ láti di agbágọ́ọ̀fù.

rows.source: I am so happy, so happy to get the cup back.
rows.output: Mo dùn, mo dùn láti gba ife náà padà.
rows.reference: Inú mi dùn, inú mi dùn láti gba ife ìdíje yìí padà.

rows.source: It's about the team., and I'm happy I was able to help," said an emotional Garcia following the European victory.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ nípa ẹgbẹ́ náà, mo sì dùn pé mo lè ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́,” ni García sọ lẹ́yìn ìṣẹ́gun ilẹ̀ Yúróòpù.
rows.reference: Iṣẹ́ àjọṣẹ ni. Inú mi dùn pé mo jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn olóríire náà,” tayọ̀tayọ̀ ni Gracia sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àṣeyọrí ẹgbẹ́ Úróópù.

rows.source: He passes the torch to his fellow countryman John Ram who took down US golf legend Tiger Woods 2&1 in singles play on Sunday.
rows.output: Ó fi iná tó ń gbé fún ẹlẹgbẹ́ orílẹ̀-èdè rẹ̀, John Ram, ẹni tó ṣẹ́gun olókìkí gọ́ọ̀lù orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, Tiger Woods, 2&1, nínú eré ìdárayá kan ní ọjọ́ Sọ́nà.
rows.reference: Ó gbé iná fún ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè ẹ John Ram tó na Tiger Woods, agbágọ́ọ̀fù ọmọ Amẹ́ríkà, ní 2 sí 1 ní ọjọ́ Àìkú.

rows.source: "The incredible pride I feel, to beat Tiger Woods, I grew up watching that guy," said 23-year-old Rahm.
rows.output: "Ìyàlẹ́nu ìgbéraga tí mo ní, láti ṣẹ́gun Tiger Woods, mo dàgbà láti máa wo ọkùnrin yìí."
rows.reference: John Rahm, ọmọ ọdfún 23, ní “Mo máa ń wo Tiger Woods nígbà tí mo wà ní kékeré. Ohun ìwúrí ló jẹ́ fún mi láti na Tiger.”

rows.source: Woods lost all four of his matches in France and now has a record of 13-21-3 career Ryder Cup record.
rows.output: Woods padà gbogbo ìdíje mẹ́rin rẹ̀ ní ilẹ̀ Faransé, ó sì ní ìwé àkọsílẹ̀ 13-21-3 fún ìdíje Ryder Cup rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Woods fìdírẹmi ní ìfẹsẹ̀wọnsẹ̀ mẹrin tó gbá. Àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ̀ ní ìdíje Ryder rèé: 13-21-3.

rows.source: A strange statistic by one of the greatest players of all-time, having won 14 major titles second to only Jack Nicklaus.
rows.output: Ìṣirò àjèjì kan láti ọ̀dọ̀ ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn agbábọ́ọ̀lù tó dára jù lọ nínú gbogbo àkókò, tí ó ti gba àmì ẹ̀yẹ 14 pàtàkì, ẹ̀ẹ̀kejì nìkan sí Jack Nicklaus.
rows.reference: Èyí ‘ò buyì kún Woods ẹni tí ó ti gba ife 14 ní onírúurú ìdíje; tó sì ṣe ipò keji lẹ́yìn Jack Nicklaus nínú àwọn t’ọ́n gba ife jùlọ nínú gọ́ọ̀fù.

rows.source: Team USA struggled all weekend to find the fairways with the exception of Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas and Tony Finau, who played high-calibre golf throughout the entire tournament.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ Amẹ́ríkà ń tiraka láti rí àwọn ọ̀nà tó dára ní gbogbo ìgbà ìdíje náà, àmọ́ Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas àti Tony Finau ń ṣe gọ́ọ̀lù tó ga jù lọ ní gbogbo ìdíje náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ti USA ‘ò rí bọ́ọ̀lù gbá jálẹ̀ ìdíje náà àyàfi Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas àti Tony Finau ló ta bíyọ́bíyọ́ nínú wọn.

rows.source: US captain Jim Furyk spoke after a disappointing performance for his squad, "I'm proud of these guys, they fought.
rows.output: Olùdarí orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, Jim Furyk, sọ̀rọ̀ lẹ́yìn ìṣe tí kò dára fún ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀, “Mo ní ìgbéraga fún àwọn ọkùnrin wọ̀nyí, wọ́n ń jà.
rows.reference: Jim Furyk, balógun agbágọ́ọ̀fù tó ṣojú Amẹ́ríkà, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ inú ẹ̀ ‘ò dùn ní “Àwọn ọmọkùnrin yìí gbìyànjú. Wọ́n jà fitafita,

rows.source: There was time this morning when we put some heat on Europe.
rows.output: Ní òwúrọ̀ yìí, a ní àkókò kan tí a fi gbé ìgbóná sí Yúróòpù.
rows.reference: Ní òwúrò yí, a kóná mọ àwọn ẹgbẹ́ agbágọ́ọfù Úròòpù.

rows.source: We scrapped.
rows.output: A kò fi bọ́ǹbù ṣe.
rows.reference: Kò sí ohun tí a kò gbìyànjú ẹ̀.

rows.source: Hats off to Thomas.
rows.output: Ẹ̀yìn ọ̀pá fún Thomas.
rows.reference: Òṣùbà fún Thomas.

rows.source: He is a great captain.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ olórí ńlá.
rows.reference: Balógun gidi ni.

rows.source: All 12 of his players played very well.
rows.output: Gbogbo awọn oṣere 12 rẹ ṣe daradara.
rows.reference: Gbogbo àwọn agbágọ́ọ̀fù 12 t’ọ́n lò gbá bọ́ọ̀lù dáadáa.

rows.source: We'll regroup, I'll work with the PGA of America and our Ryder Cup Committee and we'll move forward.
rows.output: A ó tún ṣe àtúnṣe, màá ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú Ẹgbẹ́ Gọ́ọ̀lù ti Amẹ́ríkà àti Ìgbìmọ̀ Ryder Cup wa, a ó sì lọ síwájú.
rows.reference: A máa tún ra mú. Mo ṣe tán láti ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àjọ agbágọ́ọ̀fù PGA àti ìgbìmọ̀ Ryder ní Amẹ́ríkà fún ìtẹ̀síwájú gọ́ọ̀fù.

rows.source: I love these 12 guys and I'm proud to serve as captain.
rows.output: Mo nífẹ̀ẹ́ àwọn ọkùnrin 12 wọ̀nyí, mo sì mọrírì láti jẹ́ olórí.
rows.reference: Mo fẹ́ran àwọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ mi 12 ta jọ gbá gọ́ọ̀fù. Inú mi sì dùn láti jẹ́ balógun wọn.

rows.source: You have to tip your cap.
rows.output: O gbọ́dọ̀ fẹ́ fìlà rẹ.
rows.reference: Mo bẹ́rí fún wọn,

rows.source: We got outplayed."
rows.output: A ṣe ìpèníjà."
rows.reference: Won gba boolu juwa lo."

rows.source: Red Tide Update: Concentrations decrease in Pinellas, Manatee and Sarasota
rows.output: Ìròyìn Red Tide: Àwọn ìwọ̀n dín kù ní Pinellas, Manatee àti Sarasota
rows.reference: Àwọn ohun tuntun t’ọ́n ṣẹlẹ̀ nípa ìjì inú omi: Ìjì yí kò jà mọ́ ní àwọn abúlé bíi Pinellas, Manatee àti Sarasota

rows.source: The newest report from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Commission shows a general decrease in Red Tide concentrations for parts of the Tampa Bay area.
rows.output: Iroyin tuntun lati Igbimọ Eja ati Egan Florida fihan idinku gbogbogbo ninu awọn ipele Red Tide fun awọn apakan ti agbegbe Tampa Bay.
rows.reference: Àjọ tó ń rí sí ọ̀rọ̀ ẹja àti ẹran igbó ní Florida ní ìjì omi ti dẹ́kun ní àwọn agbègbè Tampa Bay.

rows.source: According to the FWC, patchier bloom conditions are being reported in areas of Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte and Collier counties - which suggests decreasing concentrations.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí FWC ṣe sọ, àwọn ipò ìbàlẹ̀ àwọ̀n ọ̀gbìn ni a ń ròyìn ní àwọn agbègbè Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte àti Collier - èyí tó túmọ̀ sí pé ìwọ̀n ìbàlẹ̀ ń dín kù.
rows.reference: Àjọ Florida yìí ní koọ sí ìjì omi ní àwọn abúlé bíi Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte àti Collier.

rows.source: A bloom the Red Tide extends approximately 130 miles of coastline from northern Pinellas to southern Lee counties.
rows.output: Ìkún omi pupa náà gbooro tó kìlómítà 130 ní etíkun láti àríwá Pinellas sí gúúsù Lee.
rows.reference: Àríwá Pinellas ni ìjì omi yìí ti sàn dé gúsù abúlé Lee. Ó tó ibùsọ̀ 130 tí ìjì omi naà deé.

rows.source: Patches can be found about 10 miles offshore of Hillsborough County, but at fewer sites relative to last week.
rows.output: Àwọn àpòpọ̀ lè rí ní àgbègbè 10 kìlómítà (16 kìlómítà) kúrò ní ìlú Hillsborough, ṣùgbọ́n ní àwọn ibi díẹ̀ sí i ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Àpá ìjì omi yìí wà ní ibùsọ̀ 10 sí abúlé Hillsborough, àmọ́ kò pọ̀ tó ti ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá.

rows.source: Red Tide has also been observed in Pasco County.
rows.output: Ìkún omi pupa tún ti rí ní ìpínlẹ̀ Pasco.
rows.reference: Ìjì omi náà jà ní abúlé Pasco.

rows.source: Medium concentrations in or offshore of Pinellas County have been reported in the past week, low to high concentrations offshore of Hillsborough County, background to high concentrations in Manatee County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Sarasota County, background to medium concentrations in Charlotte County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Lee County, and low concentrations in Collier County.
rows.output: Awọn idiwọn alabọde ni tabi ni ita ti Ipinle Pinellas ti jabo ni ọsẹ to kọja, awọn idiwọn kekere si giga ni ita ti Ipinle Hillsborough, awọn idiwọn abẹlẹ si giga ni Ipinle Manatee, awọn idiwọn abẹlẹ si giga ni tabi ni ita ti Ipinle Sarasota, awọn idiwọn abẹlẹ si awọn idiwọn alabọde ni Ipinle Charlotte, awọn idiwọn abẹlẹ si giga ni tabi ni ita ti Ipinle Lee, ati awọn idiwọn kekere ni Ipinle Col
rows.reference: Láàrin ọ̀sẹ̀ bíi mélòó kan, Ìjì yí ti dínkù ní Pinellas àti agbègbè ẹ̀. Ó tún dínkù sí ti abúlé àti agbègbè Hillsborough, Mantee, Sarasota, Charlotte, Lee àti Collier.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation continues to be reported in Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, and Collier counties.
rows.output: Ìrora ẹ̀dọ̀fóró ń bá a lọ ní Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, àti Collier.
rows.reference: Ìṣòrò pẹ̀lú èémi pọ̀ ní abúlé Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, àti Collier.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation was not reported in Northwest Florida over the past week.
rows.output: Ìrora ẹ̀dọ̀fóró kò jẹ́ kí a sọ̀rọ̀ ní Àríwá Florida ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ kò sí ìṣòrò pẹ̀lú èémí ní àríwá-iwọ-oòrùn Floria lọ́sẹ̀ tó kọjá.

rows.source: Macedonia's PM Zoran Zaev, his wife Zorica and his son Dushko cast their ballot for the referendum in Macedonia on changing the country's name that would open the way for it to join NATO and the European Union in Strumica, Macedonia September 30, 2018.
rows.output: Makidoniya ta zama shugaba Zoran Zaev, matarsa Zorica da ɗansa Dushko sun jefa kuri'arsu a kan kuri'ar a Makidoniya game da canza sunan ƙasar da zai buɗe mata hanyar shiga NATO da Tarayyar Turai a Strumica, Makidoniya a ranar 30 ga Satumba, 2018.
rows.reference: Firaministan Macedonia Zoran Zaev, da shi da matarsa  Zorica da ɗansa Dushko sun kaɗa kuri’arsu ta raba gardamar a cikin Macedonia a kan canza sunan ƙasar wanda zai buɗe hanya da shiga NATO da Tarayyar Turai a cikin Strumica, Macedonia 3 ga Satumba, 2018.

rows.source: In front of parliament in Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, was preparing a small stage and pulling up chairs in front of tents set up by those who will boycott the referendum.
rows.output: A gaban majalisar dokoki a Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, yana shirin wani ƙaramin mataki kuma yana jan kujeru a gaban gidajen da aka kafa ta wadanda za su yi watsi da zaben.
rows.reference: A gaban majalisar dokoki da ke cikin Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, mai shekaru 54, ya shirya wani ƙaramin munbari kuma ya janyo kujeru sama ta gaban tanti-tanti da waɗanda ke ƙaurace wa raba gardamar suka kafa.

rows.source: "We are for NATO and EU, but we want to join with our heads up, not through the service door" Kavadarkov said.
rows.output: "Muna goyon bayan NATO da EU, amma muna son shiga tare da kanmu a kai, ba ta bakin kofa ba" in ji Kavadarkov.
rows.reference: “Mu na NATO da Tarayyar Turai ne, amma muna son shiga da mutuncimu, ba ta bayan ƙofar aiki ba,” inji Kavadarkov.

rows.source: "We are a poor country, but we do have dignity.
rows.output: "Mun kasance ƙasa mai talauci, amma har yanzu muna da daraja.
rows.reference: “Mu wata ƙasa ce talaka, amma muna da kamala.

rows.source: If they don't want to take us as Macedonia, we can turn to others like China and Russia and become part of Euro-Asia integration."
rows.output: Idan ba sa son karɓar mu a matsayin Masedoniya, za mu iya juya zuwa wasu kamar Sin da Rasha mu zama wani ɓangare na haɗin gwiwar Turai-Asiya."
rows.reference: Idan ba su son su ɗauke mu a matsayin Macedonia, za mu iya juyawa ga sauran kamar China da Rusha kuma mu zama ɓangare na haɗewar Turai da Asiya.”

rows.source: Prime Minister Zaev says NATO membership will bring much needed investment to Macedonia, which has an unemployment rate of more than 20 percent.
rows.output: Firayim Minista Zaev ya ce shiga NATO zai kawo jari mai mahimmanci a kasar Masedoniya, wadda ke da kaso 20 cikin 100 na rashin aikin yi.
rows.reference: Firaminista Zaev ya ce zama mamban NATO zai kawo zuba jari sosai zuwa ga Macedonia, wadda ke da wani kimar rashin aikin yi na fiye da kashi 20 cikin ɗari.

rows.source: "I believe the huge majority will be in favor because more than 80 percent of our citizens are in favor of EU and NATO," Zaev said after casting his ballot.
rows.output: "Na yi imani da babban rinjaye zai kasance a gefen goyon bayan saboda sama da kashi 80 cikin 100 na 'yan kasarmu suna goyon bayan EU da NATO," in ji Zaev bayan ya kada kuri'arsa.
rows.reference: “Na yi imani da yawa sosai za su so saboda fiye da kashi 80 cikin ɗari na ‘yan ƙasarmu suna son Tarayyar Turai da NATO,”inji Zaev bayan kaɗa kuri’arsa.

rows.source: He said that a "yes" result would be "confirmation of our future."
rows.output: Ya ce "eh" zai zama "tabbatar da makomarmu."
rows.reference: Ya ce wani sakamako na “eh” zai zama tabbatarwa da makomarmu.”

rows.source: A poll published last Monday by Macedonia's Institute for Policy Research said between 30 and 43 percent of voters would take part in the referendum - below the required turnout.
rows.output: An yi wata kuri'a a makon da ya gabata da cewa kashi 30 zuwa 43 cikin 100 na masu kada kuri'a za su shiga zaben - kasa da yawan kuri'un da ake bukata.
rows.reference: Wani zaɓen jin ra’ayin jama’a da Cibiyar Nazarin Ƙuduri ta Macedonia ta buga ranar Litinin ya ce tsakanin kashi 30 zuwa 43 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a za su shiga cikin raba gardamar - kasa da fitowar da ake buƙatar.

rows.source: Another poll, conducted by Macedonia's Telma TV, found 57 percent of respondents planning to vote on Sunday.
rows.output: Wani bincike da aka gudanar da shi ta hanyar gidan Talabijin na Telma na Masedoniya ya nuna cewa kashi 57 cikin 100 na wadanda aka yi binciken sun shirya kada kuri'a a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Wani jin ra’ayin jama’ar, da gidan talabijin na Telma na Macedonia, ya samo kashi 57 cikin ɗari na masu martanin suna shirya jefa kuri’ar ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Of those, 70 percent said they would vote yes.
rows.output: Daga cikin wadanda aka yi musu tambaya, kashi 70 cikin 100 sun ce za su kada kuri'a ta eh.
rows.reference: Daga waɗannan, kashi 70 cikin ɗari za su so su jefa eh.

rows.source: For the referendum to be successful turnout needs to be 50 percent plus one vote.
rows.output: Don a yi nasarar zaben, dole ne kashi 50 cikin 100 na masu kada kuri'a su zabi.
rows.reference: Don raba gardamar ta ci nasara da buƙatar fitowar ta zama kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ƙarin kuri’a ɗaya.

rows.source: A failure in the referendum would represent the first serious blow to policy of the pro-Western government since it took over in May last year.
rows.output: Wani gazawa a zaben zaɓe zai zama karon farko da gwamnatin da ke goyon bayan yammacin duniya ta fuskanci babban kalubale tun bayan da ta karɓi mulki a watan Mayun shekarar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Wata gazawa a cikin raba gardamar za ta zama matsala ta farko ga ƙudurin masu goyon bayan gwamnatin Yamma tun da ta kama ragama a cikin Mayu na shekarar da ta wuce.

rows.source: Watch: Manchester City's Sergio Aguero navigates through entire Brighton defense for goal
rows.output: Kallon: Sergio Aguero na Manchester City ya yi tafiya ta hanyar tsaron Brighton gaba daya don zura kwallo
rows.reference: Kalli: Sergio Aguero na Manchester City ya kewaya ta cikin tsaro na Brighton gaba ɗaya don ci

rows.source: Sergio Aguero and Raheem Sterling dispatched of the Brighton defense in Manchester City's 2-0 win on Saturday at Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England.
rows.output: Sergio Aguero da Raheem Sterling sun kai hari kan tsaron Brighton a nasarar da Manchester City ta samu da ci 2-0 a ranar Asabar a filin wasa na Etihad a Manchester, Ingila.
rows.reference: Sergio Aguero da Raheem Sterling sun tura tsaro na  Brighton a cikin cin Manchester City 2 da 0 ranar Asabar a Filin Wasa na Etihad da ke cikin Manchester, Ingila.

rows.source: Aguero made it look ridiculously easy on his score in the 65th minute.
rows.output: Aguero ya sa ya zama mai sauƙi a kan ci a minti na 65.
rows.reference: Aguero ya nuna da saukin wulakanci a kan cin nasa cikin mintina na 65.

rows.source: The Argentine striker received a pass at midfield at the start of the sequence.
rows.output: Mai tsaron gaba na Argentina ya karɓi wani kwallo a tsakiyar filin wasa a farkon jerin.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasa mai kai harin na Argentina ya karɓi wani tura ƙwallo a tsakiyar fili a farkon jerin.

rows.source: He raced between three Brighton defenders, before slashing into the open field.
rows.output: Ya yi gudu tsakanin masu tsaron Brighton guda uku, kafin ya yanke shi cikin filin bude.
rows.reference: Ya yi gudu tsakanin masu tsaron Brighton, kafin yankewa zuwa cikin filin da ke buɗe.

rows.source: Aguero then found himself surrounded by four green shirts.
rows.output: Aguero sai ya sami kansa a tsakiyar riguna masu kore hudu.
rows.reference: Daga nan Aguero ya sami kansa a kewaye da riguna koraye huɗu.

rows.source: He pushed around one defender before outrunning several more at the edge of the Brighton box.
rows.output: Ya tura wani mai tsaron gida ya wuce kafin ya zarce wasu da yawa a gefen akwatin Brighton.
rows.reference: Ya tura a kewaye da mai tsaro daya kafin gujewa sauran a gefen akwati na Brighton.

rows.source: He then pushed a pass to his left, finding Sterling.
rows.output: Sannan ya tura kwallon zuwa hagu, inda ya samu Sterling.
rows.reference: Daga nan ya tura wata miƙawa zuwa ga damansa, inda ya sami Sterling.

rows.source: The English forward used his first touch in the box to give the ball back to Aguero, who used his right boot to beat Brighton keeper Mathew Ryan with a shot into the right side of the net.
rows.output: Farkon ƙwallon da Ingilishi ya yi a cikin akwatin ya ba da damar dawo da ƙwallon ga Aguero, wanda ya yi amfani da ƙafarsa ta dama don doke mai tsaron gida na Brighton Mathew Ryan da harbin da ya shiga gefen dama na raga.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasan gaba na Ingilan ya yi amfani da tabinsa na farko a cikin akwatin don ba da ƙwallo ga Aguero, wanda ya yi amfani da takalminsa na dama don bugan golan Brighton  Mathew Ryan da wani ɗan duka zuwa cikin gefen dama na ragar.

rows.source: "Aguero is struggling with some problems in his feet," City manager Pep Guardiola told reporters.
rows.output: "Aguero yana fama da wasu matsaloli a ƙafafunsa," manajan City Pep Guardiola ya gaya wa 'yan jarida.
rows.reference: “Aguero yana gwagwarmaya tare da wasu matsaloli a cikin ƙafofinsa,” a cewar rahoto na manajan City Pep Guardiola.

rows.source: "We spoke about him playing 55, 60 minutes.
rows.output: "Mun yi magana game da shi yana wasa 55, 60 mintuna.
rows.reference: “Mun yi magana a kansa yana mai wasan mintina 55, 60.

rows.source: That's what happened.
rows.output: Abin da ya faru.
rows.reference: Wannan shi ne abin da ya faru.

rows.source: We were lucky he scored a goal in that moment."
rows.output: Mun yi sa'a ya zura kwallo a wannan lokacin.
rows.reference: Mun yi nasara ya yi nasarar wani ci a wannan lokacin.”

rows.source: But it was Sterling who gave the Sky Blues the initial advantage in the Premier League scuffle.
rows.output: Amma Sterling ne ya ba wa Sky Blues fa'ida ta farko a gasar Premier.
rows.reference: Amma Sterling ne ya ba wa Sky Blues dama ta farko a cikin rikicin wasan Premier League din.

rows.source: That goal came in the 29th minute.
rows.output: An cimma wannan burin a minti na 29.
rows.reference: Wannan cin ya zo ne a cikin mintina na 29.

rows.source: Aguero received the ball deep in Brighton territory on that play.
rows.output: Aguero ya karɓi ƙwallon a cikin yankin Brighton mai zurfi a wannan wasan.
rows.reference: Aguero ya karɓi ƙwallon a cikin iyakar Brighton sosai a wannan wasan.

rows.source: He sent a beautiful through ball along the left flank to Leroy Sane.
rows.output: Ya taka wata kwallon da ta yi kyau a gefen hagu zuwa ga Leroy Sane.
rows.reference: Ya aika wata kyakkyawar ƙwallo ta ciki ta kan filankin hagun zuwa ga Leroy Sane.

rows.source: Sane took a few touches before leading Sterling toward the far post.
rows.output: Sane ya ɗauki 'yan taɓawa kafin ya jagoranci Sterling zuwa kusurwar nesa.
rows.reference: Sane ya ɗan yi wasu taɓe-taɓe kafin jagorar Sterling zuwa ƙarshen matsaya mai nisa.

rows.source: The Sky Blues forward tapped the ball into the net just before sliding out of bounds.
rows.output: Farkon Sky Blues ya buga kwallon a cikin raga kafin ya fita daga layin.
rows.reference: Mai bugun gaban na Sky Blues ya taɓa ƙwallon zuwa cikin raga kawai kafin ficewa daga iyakokin.

rows.source: City battles Hoffenheim in Champions League group play at 12:55 p.m. on Tuesday at Rhein-Neckar-Arena in Sinsheim, Germany.
rows.output: Birnin yana fafatawa da Hoffenheim a wasan rukuni na gasar zakarun Turai a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a ƙarshen mako a
rows.reference: City ɗin yana yakar Hoffenheim a cikin wasan gungun Champions League da ƙarfe 12:55 na rana a ranar Talata at Rhein-Neckar-Arena da ke cikin Sinsheim, Jamus.

rows.source: Scherzer wants to play spoiler vs. Rockies
rows.output: Scherzer yana son zama mai lalatawa a kan Rockies
rows.reference: Scherzer yana son zama mai ɓatawa da Rockies

rows.source: With the Nationals eliminated from playoff contention, there wasn't much reason to force another start.
rows.output: Tare da 'yan wasan da suka fita daga gasar, babu dalilin da zai sa a yi wani wasan karshe.
rows.reference: Da yake an cire Nationals daga gasar sake wasa, babu wani dalili na tilasta sake farawa.

rows.source: But the ever-competitive Scherzer hopes to take the mound on Sunday against the Colorado Rockies, but only if there are still playoff implications for the Rockies, who hold a one-game lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NL West.
rows.output: Amma Scherzer mai gasa kullum yana fatan zai hau filin a ranar Lahadi a kan Rockies na Colorado, amma kawai idan akwai wasu abubuwan da suka shafi wasan share fage ga Rockies, wadanda ke da kwallo daya a kan Dodgers na Los Angeles a yankin Yamma.
rows.reference: Amma mai son gasar kodayaushe Scherzer yana fatan ɗaukan tarin ranar Lahadi a kan Colorado Rockies, amma kawai idan har yanzi kawai tasirori na sake wasa don Rockies din, wadanda ke rike wani jagorancin wasa a saman Los Angeles Dodgers a cikin NL West ɗin.

rows.source: The Rockies clinched at least a wild-card spot with a 5-2 win over the Nationals on Friday night, but are still looking to lock up their first division title.
rows.output: An tabbatar da Rockies a kalla suna da wuri a gasar cin kofin duniya da nasarar da suka samu a kan Nats da ci 5-2 a daren Juma'a, amma har yanzu suna neman lashe gasar.
rows.reference: Rockies sun aƙalla sami wawan katin fice tare da wata cin nasara 5 da 2 a kan Nationals a ranar Juma’a da dare, amma har yanzu suna neman su rufe matsayinsu na sashe na farko.

rows.source: "Even though we're playing for nothing, at least we can be able to toe the rubber knowing that the atmosphere here in Denver with the crowd and the other team would be playing at probably the highest level of any point I would face this year.
rows.output: "Ko da yake muna wasa don komai, aƙalla za mu iya yin ƙoƙari mu yi da roba sanin cewa yanayin nan a Denver tare da taron jama'a da ƙungiyar ƙungiyar za su kasance a mafi girman matakin da zan fuskanta wannan shekara.
rows.reference: “Kodayake muna wasa ne ba dan kome ba, aƙalla za mu iya taka roba muna sane da cewa yanayin a cikin Denver yana tare da dandazon jama’a kuma ɗaya ƙungiyar za ta wasa a kila lebur mafi girma na kowane bigire da zan fuskanta wannan shekara.

rows.source: Why wouldn't I want to compete in that?"
rows.output: Me yasa ba zan so in yi gasa a cikin hakan ba?
rows.reference: Me zai hana na so na yi gasa a cikin wannan?”

rows.source: The Nationals have yet to announce a starter for Sunday, but are reportedly inclined to let Scherzer pitch in such a situation.
rows.output: Kungiyar ta kasa ta sanar da wanda zai fara wasa a ranar Lahadi, amma ana ruwaito cewa suna shirin barin Scherzer ya yi wasa a irin wannan yanayi.
rows.reference: Har yanzu Nationals ɗin ba su sanar da wani mafari ba don Lahadi amma an ba da rahoto sun so su bari Scherzer ya tsananta yanayin.

rows.source: Scherzer, who would be making his 34th start, threw a bullpen session on Thursday and would be pitching on his normal rest Sunday.
rows.output: Scherzer, wanda zai zama farawa na 34, ya yi zaman jefa a ranar Alhamis kuma zai yi jefa a ranar hutunsa na al'ada ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Scherzer, wanda zai yi farinsa na 34, ya jefa wani babban lokaci a ranar Alhamis kuma zai tsananta a kan hutunsa na daidai ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: The Washington right-hander is 18-7 with a 2.53 ERA and 300 strikeouts in 220 2/3 innings this season.
rows.output: Mai tsaron dama na Washington yana da shekaru 18-7 tare da 2.53 ERA da kuma bugun gaba 300 a cikin 220 2/3 innings a wannan kakar.
rows.reference: Mai riƙe Washington daidai yana 18-7 tare da wani 2.53 ERA da bugun waje 300 a cikin 220 2/3 innings wannan lokacin.

rows.source: Trump rallies in West Virginia
rows.output: Trump ya yi gangami a West Virginia
rows.reference: Trump ya yi gangami a cikin Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.source: The President obliquely referred to the situation surrounding his Supreme Court pick Brett Kavanaugh while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
rows.output: Shugaban ya yi nuni da yanayin da ke kewaye da zabensa na Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh yayin da yake tattaunawa kan muhimmancin fitowar jam'iyyar Republican a zaben tsakiyar wa'adi.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya ɗan ambaci yanayin da ke kewaye da wanda ya zaɓa don Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh a lokacin da yake magana game da amfanin fitowa ta ‘yan jam’iyyar Republican a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango.

rows.source: "All of what we've done is at stake in November.
rows.output: "Dukkan abin da muka yi yana cikin hadari a watan Nuwamba.
rows.reference: “Dukkan abin da muka yi ya tsaya ciki a Nuwamba.

rows.source: Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
rows.output: Mako biyar kafin daya daga cikin zaben da suka fi muhimmanci a rayuwarmu.
rows.reference: Makonni biyar daga yanzu daga ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka mafi amfani a cikin lokacin rayuwarmu.

rows.source: This is one of the big, big -- I'm not running but I'm really running that's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates," he said.
rows.output: Wannan na ɗaya daga cikin manyan, manyan -- ba na gudu ba amma ina gudu sosai wannan shine dalilin da yasa nake ko'ina na faɗa don ƙwararrun 'yan takara," ya ce.
rows.reference: Wannan shi ne daga cikin babban, babban - Ba zan tsaya ba amma a zahiri zan tsaya shi ya sa nake dukkan kowane wuri ina yaƙi don ‘yan takara na gari,” inji shi.

rows.source: Trump continued, "You see this horrible, horrible radical group of Democrats, you see it happening right now.
rows.output: Trump ya ci gaba, "Ku ga wannan rukunin 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat masu tsattsauran ra'ayi, ku ga yadda suke aiki a yanzu.
rows.reference: Trump ya ci gaba, “Kun ga wannan bala’in, gungun bala’i na ‘yan jam’iyyar Democrats, kun ga abin da ke faruwa yanzun nan.

rows.source: And they're determined to take back power by using any means necessary, you see the meanness, the nastiness.
rows.output: Kuma suna da niyyar dawo da iko ta kowace hanya da za su iya, kamar yadda kuke gani, tsananin tsanani, mugun hali.
rows.reference: Kuma sun ƙudurta karɓan iko ta yin amfani da kowace damar za su iya, kun ga baƙin halin, rashin kirkin.

rows.source: They don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over in order to get power and control, that's what they want is power and control, we're not going to give it to them."
rows.output: Ba sa damuwa da wanda suke cutarwa, wanda suke bukatar su yi tafiya a kai don samun iko da ikon, wannan shine abin da suke so, iko da ikon, ba za mu ba su ba."
rows.reference: Ba ruwansu da wanda suka ɓata wa rai, wanda za su rusa su sami iko da sarrafa, shi ya sa abin da suke so shi ne iko da sarrafa, ba za mu ba su shi ba.”

rows.source: Democrats, he said, are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
rows.output: Dimokuradiyya, ya ce, suna da burin "juriya da toshe."
rows.reference: ‘Yan jam’iyyar Democrat, inji shi, suna kan manufa ce ta “ƙi da kange.”

rows.source: "And you see that over the last four days," he said, calling the Democrats "angry and mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: "Kuma ka ga cewa a cikin kwanaki hudu da suka gabata," ya ce, yana kiran 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat da "fushi da tsanani da mugunta da rashin gaskiya."
rows.reference: “Kuma kun ga cewa a cikin kwanaki huɗu da suka wuce,” inji shi, yana mai kiran ‘yan Democrat ɗin da “masu fushi da baƙin ciki da zali da rashin gaskiya.”

rows.source: He referenced Senate Judiciary Committee ranking Democratic Sen. Dianne Feinstein by name, which received loud boos from the audience.
rows.output: Ya ambaci matsayin shugaban kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dattawa, Demokaradiyya Sen. Dianne Feinstein da sunansa, wanda ya samu hargitsi daga masu sauraro.
rows.reference: Ya ambaci babban dan Kwamitin Shari’a na Majalisar Dattawa Sanata Dianne Feinstein da sunanta, wanda masu sauraro suka yi wa ihu.

rows.source: "Remember her answer?
rows.output: "Ka tuna yadda ta amsa?
rows.reference: “Kun tuna amsarta?

rows.source: Did you leak the document?
rows.output: Shin ka yi wa takardar zubewa?
rows.reference: Kin yi yoyon takardar?

rows.source: Uh, uh, what.
rows.output: Uh, uh, menene.
rows.reference: Uh, uh, me.

rows.source: No, uh no, I wait one - that was really bad body language - the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: A'a, uh a'a, ina jira ɗaya - wannan ya yi muni sosai a cikin alamu - mafi muni a cikin alamu da na taɓa gani."
rows.reference: A’a, uh, a’a, na jira ɗaya ne - wannan mummunan abu ne na alamar rashin gaskiya - mafi munin alamar rashin gaskiya da ban taɓa gani ba.”

rows.source: Labour is no longer a broad church.
rows.output: Aikin ba ƙungiyar addini ba ce.
rows.reference: Yanzu Labour ba wani babban majami’a ne ba.

rows.source: It is intolerant of those who speak their minds
rows.output: Ba ta yarda da wadanda suke magana da gaskiya ba.
rows.reference: Wani rashin haƙuri ne na waɗanda ke faɗan abin da ke cikin zuciyarsu

rows.source: When Momentum's activists in my local party voted to censure me, it was hardly a surprise.
rows.output: Lokacin da masu fafutukar Momentum a jam'iyyata ta gida suka kada kuri'ar cire ni, ba abin mamaki ba ne.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ‘yan rajin Momentum a cikin jam’iyyata ta gida suka jefa kuri’a don tsaida ni, ba wani abin mamaki ne ba.

rows.source: After all, I'm the latest in a line of Labour MPs to be told we are not welcome - all for speaking our minds.
rows.output: Bayan haka, ni ne na karshe a cikin jerin 'yan majalisar dokokin Labour da aka gaya mana cewa ba mu da maraba - duk saboda magana kan ra'ayinmu.
rows.reference: Tun da yake, ni ne mafi sabo a wani layi na mambobin Labour na majalisa da za a faɗa musu ba a maraba da mu - dukka saboda faɗan abi da ke zuciyarmu.

rows.source: My parliamentary colleague Joan Ryan received similar treatment because she resolutely stood up to antisemitism.
rows.output: Abokin majalisar dokokinmu Joan Ryan ta samu irin wannan magani ne saboda ta tsaya tsayin daka wajen yaki da cin zarafin Yahudawa.
rows.reference: Abokiyata a majalisa Joan Ryan ta sami irin wulakanci saboda ta tsaya tsayin daka tana faɗa da ra’ayin ƙin Yahudawa.

rows.source: In my case, the censure motion criticised me for disagreeing with Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.output: A cikin yanayina, an soki kudirin cirewa saboda rashin amincewa da Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.reference: A nawa misalin, batun dakatarwar ya soke ni don ƙin yarda da Jeremy Corbyn.

rows.source: On the importance of a responsible economic policy, on national security, on Europe, ironically similar issues on which Jeremy disagreed with previous leaders.
rows.output: A kan muhimmancin manufofin tattalin arziki masu alhakin, kan tsaron kasa, kan Turai, abin ban dariya irin batutuwan da Jeremy ya yi rashin jituwa da shugabannin da suka gabata.
rows.reference: A kan amfani na wani ƙudurin tattalin arzikin mai kyau, a kan tsaron ƙasa, a kan Turai, abin takaici batutuwa iri guda wanda a kai Jeremy ya ƙi yarda da shugabanni da suka wuce.

rows.source: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."
rows.output: Sanarwar ta Nottingham Gabas ta Labour ta ce a ranar Juma'a cewa "muna son tarukan su zama masu hada kai da kuma samar da sakamako."
rows.reference: Sanarwa don taron Labour ta Nottingham ta Gabas a ranar Juma’a ta kawo cewa, “muna son tarukan su zama a haɗe da  ma’ana.”

rows.source: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.
rows.output: A cikin mafi yawan shekaru takwas na zama dan majalisar dokokin yankin, tarukan GC na daren Juma'a sun kasance daidai da haka.
rows.reference: Ga mafi yawan na shekaru takwas ɗin a matsayi na mamban Labour a majalisa, haka dai yake daren tarukan GC.

rows.source: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.
rows.output: Abin takaici, a yau ba haka ba ne yanayin yawancin tarurruka kuma alkawarin "kinder, gentler" na siyasa ya daɗe ana mantawa da shi, idan har ya taɓa farawa.
rows.reference: Abin takaici a yau, ba shi ne fasalin taruka da yawa kuma alkawari na siyasa ta “ihsani, hankali” tuni aka manta idan, ma, an taɓa farawa.

rows.source: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.
rows.output: Yana da matukar bayyana cewa ra'ayoyi daban-daban ba a amince da su a jam'iyyar Labour ba, kuma ana tantance kowane ra'ayi bisa ko yana da kyau ga shugabancin jam'iyyar.
rows.reference: Yana ƙara zama a bayyane fili cewa ba a haƙuri da ra’ayoyi daban-daban a cikin jam’iyyar Labour kuma ana hukunta kowane ra’ayi a kan ko zai karɓu ga shugabannin jam’iyyar.

rows.source: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.
rows.output: Wannan ya fara ne kusan nan da nan bayan Jeremy ya zama shugaba, yayin da abokan aiki da na yi tunanin ina da ra'ayi iri ɗaya na siyasa suka fara tsammanin zan juya hagu in ɗauki matsayi da ba zan taɓa amincewa da shi ba - ko a kan tsaron ƙasa ko kasuwar EU guda.
rows.reference: Wannan ya fara jim kaɗan bayan Jeremy ya zama shugaba, don abokan aiki da nake jin a da muna da irin mahangar siyasa sun fara tsammani zan yi wani juyi da daukan matsaya da ba zan taɓa yarda da su ba - ko a kan tsaron ƙasa ko kasuwa guda ta Tarayyar Turai.

rows.source: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.
rows.output: Duk lokacin da na yi magana a bainar jama'a - kuma ba shi da mahimmanci abin da nake faɗa - sai kuma wani gungun masu suka a shafukan sada zumunta suna kira da a cire ni, suna sukar siyasar tsakiya, suna cewa ba ni da wuri a jam'iyyar Labour.
rows.reference: A kodayaushe na yi magana a cikin jama’a - kuma ba ruwan haƙiƙa abin da na ce - kawai sai tarun cin mutunci a kan kafar sadar zumunta ana kira ga sake zaɓe, ana watsi da siyasar ta tsakiya, ana faɗa mun cewa ya kamata na zama ba na cikin jam’iyyar Labour.

rows.source: And that is not just my experience.
rows.output: Kuma hakan ba kawai abin da nake ji ba ne.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan ba kawai abin da na gani ne ba.

rows.source: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.
rows.output: Tabbas, na san cewa ina da sa'a fiye da wasu abokan aikina, domin sharhin da ake yi mani ya fi mayar da hankali kan siyasa.
rows.reference: Haƙiƙa, na san na ti sa’a sosai fiye da sauran abokan aikina saboda umarce-umarce da ake fuskantowa a kaina sukan zama na siyasa.

rows.source: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.
rows.output: Ina jin tsoron ƙwarewa da kuma jajircewar abokan aiki waɗanda ke fuskantar guguwar cin zarafi na jinsi ko na ƙabilanci kowace rana amma ba su taɓa janyewa ba.
rows.reference: Ina cikin dan shayi na ra’ayin kwarewa da ƙudurtawa ta waɗannan abokan aikin waɗanda ke fuskantar wani cin mutunci ta fuska jinsi ko bambancin launin fata a kowace rana amma ba su taɓa gudu ba.

rows.source: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.
rows.output: Ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da suka fi baƙin ciki a wannan zamani na siyasa shi ne yadda matakan cin zarafi suka zama ruwan dare.
rows.reference: Daya daga cikin ɓangarorin abu mafi ɓata rai a wannan lokaci na siyasa shi ne yadda lebur-lebur na cin mutunci suna zama ruwan dare.

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn claimed last week that the Labour party should foster a culture of tolerance.
rows.output: Jeremy Corbyn ya yi iƙirarin makon da ya gabata cewa jam'iyyar Labour ta kamata ta haɓaka al'adar juriya.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn ya ce a mako da ya wuce cewa ya kamata jam’iyyar Labour ta samar da wata al’adar haƙuri.

rows.source: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.
rows.output: Gaskiya ita ce, ba mu wani babban cocin da muke a baya ba kuma tare da kowace "matsayin rashin yarda" ko canje-canjen ka'idojin zaɓe, jam'iyyar ta zama ƙanƙanta.
rows.reference: Abin da yake zahiri shi ne yanzu mu ba wancan babbar majami’ar ne ba da kowane batu na “ba a yarda da iyawa ba” ko canjin dokokin zaɓe a ce jam’iyya tana zama karama.

rows.source: I have had lots of advice over the past two years urging me to keep my head down, not to be so vocal and then I would "be all right."
rows.output: Na samu shawarwari da yawa a cikin shekaru biyu da suka gabata da ke ƙarfafa ni in kiyaye kaina, in kada in yi magana sosai, sannan zan "yi daidai."
rows.reference: Na sha samun sharawa da yawa a cikin shekaru biyu da suka wuce ana kira da na yi shiru, kar na yi surutu shi ke nan zan zama “ba wata matsala.”

rows.source: But that is not what I came into politics to do.
rows.output: Amma hakan ba abin da na zo siyasa don yi ba.
rows.reference: Amma ban shiga siyasa don na yi wannan abu ba.

rows.source: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.
rows.output: Tun lokacin da na shiga jam'iyyar Labour shekaru 32 da suka wuce a matsayin dalibi, wanda ya samo asali daga rashin kulawar gwamnatin Thatcher da ta bar makarantata ta kwana ta fadi, na yi ƙoƙarin ƙarfafa ayyukan jama'a ga waɗanda suka fi buƙata - ko a matsayin ɗan majalisa na gida ko ministan gwamnati.
rows.reference: Tun da ma na shiga jam’iyyar Labour shekaru 32 da suka wuce a matsayin wani yaro dan makaranta, da ya sami zaburarwa daga wazarai na gwamnatin Thatcher da a fakaice ta bar cikekken ajina na makaranta yana faɗuwa, na yi tunanin na zama gwarzon gyara ayyukan jama’a ga waɗanda ke buƙatar sosai - ko a matsayi na wani kansila na gida ko ministan gwamnati.

rows.source: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.
rows.output: Ban taba boye siyasar nawa ba, ciki har da zabukan da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Ban taɓa boye siyasata ba, har da cikin zaɓen da ya gabata.

rows.source: No one in Nottingham East could have been in any way confused about my policy positions and areas of disagreement with the current leadership.
rows.output: Babu wanda ke Nottingham Gabas da zai iya yin kuskure game da matsayin manufofina da wuraren da nake da rashin jituwa da shugabancin yanzu.
rows.reference: Ba wani daga cikin Nottingham ta Gabas da za a ce ya shiga ruɗani game da matsayin ƙudurina da yankuna na rashin amincewa tare da shugabancin yanzu.

rows.source: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.
rows.output: Ga waɗanda suka yi waƙa a ranar Juma'a, kawai zan ce cewa yayin da ƙasar ke tafiya zuwa ga Brexit wanda zai cutar da gidaje, kasuwanci da ayyukan jama'a, ban fahimci sha'awar yin amfani da lokaci da kuzari wajen yin waɗannan ayyuka ba.
rows.reference: Ga waɗanda suka tallata batu na ranar Juma’a, abin da dukka zan ce shi ne cewa a lokacin da ƙasar ke tattaki zuwa wani Brexit da zai cutar da iyalai, kasuwanci da ayyukan gwamnati, ban fahimci sha’awar ɓata lokaci da ƙarfin gwiwa ba a kan mubaya’a ta zuwa ga shugaban jam’iyyar Labour.

rows.source: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.
rows.output: Amma a gaskiya babban sakon da nake da shi ba shi ne ga Nottingham Momentum ba, sai dai ga wadanda na wakilta, ko dai 'yan jam'iyyar Labour ne ko kuma ba 'yan jam'iyyar Labour ba: Ina alfahari da yi muku hidima kuma ina alkawarin cewa babu wani adadi da zai hana ni daga yin abin da nake ganin ya fi dacewa da kowa.
rows.reference: Amma a zahiri kuwa saƙo ɗaya da nake da shi ba zuwa ga Nottingham Momentum ne ba, zuwa ga mazaɓata ne, ko mambobin Labour ko a’a: Ina alfahari da yin aiki don jama’a kuma na yi alkawari cewa ba wani irin barazana sake zaɓe ko ruɗanin siyasa da zai hana ni yin aiki a cikin abin da na yi imani da shi shi ne mafi kyawun abubuwan da za su yi wa jama’a dadi gaba ɗaya.

rows.source: Chris Leslie is MP for Nottingham East
rows.output: Chris Leslie shi ne wakilin majalisar dokokin Burtaniya na Nottingham Gabas
rows.reference: Chris Leslie mamban majalisa ne na Nottingham ta Gabasa

rows.source: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Unbeaten Ayr go top
rows.output: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr ba ta yi rashin nasara ba, ta kai saman teburin
rows.reference: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr da ba a doke ba ta yi sama

rows.source: Two late tries may have skewed the final result somewhat, but there is no doubt Ayr deserved to triumph in this wonderfully-entertaining Tennent's Premiership match of the day.
rows.output: Bi biyu na ƙarshe sun yi ƙoƙari suka yi, wanda ya sa sakamakon ƙarshe ya yi ɗan ƙaramin canji, amma babu shakka Ayr ya cancanci ya yi nasara a wannan wasan Tennent's Premiership mai ban sha'awa na rana.
rows.reference: Gwaje-gwaje guda biyu masu jinkiri sun tsallake sakamakon ƙarshe wani iri, amma babu shakka Ayr ya dace ya ci nasara a cikin wannan nishaɗi mai ban mamaki na wasan Premiership na Tennent na ranar.

rows.source: They now top the table, the only unbeaten side of the ten.
rows.output: Yanzu suna kan teburin, kawai kungiyar da ba ta yi rashin nasara ba daga cikin goma.
rows.reference: Su ne yanzu ke saman teburin, ɓangare da kaɗai ba a doke ba na goman.

rows.source: In the end, it was their superior defence, as much as their better chance-taking, which carried the home side and coach Peter Murchie had every right to be pleased.
rows.output: A ƙarshe, ya kasance kariyar su ta fi kowa, kamar yadda suka fi kyau wajen ɗaukar damar, wanda ya ba da gudummawa ga nasarar ƙungiyar gida da koci Peter Murchie ya yi daidai da yin farin ciki.
rows.reference: Daga ƙarshe, tsaronsu da ya fi girma ne, kamar ma samun damarsu ta yin magana sosai, wanda ta ɗauki gefen gidan kuma mai horar da ‘yan wasa Peter Murchie yana dukkan dalili da zai ji daɗi.

rows.source: "We've been tested over our games this far, and we're still unbeaten, so I have to be happy," he said.
rows.output: "Mun yi gwaji a kan wasanninmu har yanzu, kuma ba mu taɓa yin rashin nasara ba, don haka ina da dalilin yin farin ciki," ya ce.
rows.reference: “An gwada mu a cikin wasanninmu har zuwa nan, kuma har yanzu ba a doke mu ba, don haka dole na yi murna,” inji shi.

rows.source: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Credit to Ayr, they took their chances better than we did."
rows.output: Robyn Christie na Melrose ya ce: "Kudi ga Ayr, sun ɗauki damarmarsu mafi kyau fiye da yadda muka yi."
rows.reference: Robyn Christie na Melrose ya ce: “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ayr, sun ɗauki damammakinsu sosai fiye da yadda muka yi.”

rows.source: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.
rows.output: A cikin minti na 14, Grant Anderson ya zura kwallo a raga, wanda Frazier Climo ya canza, ya sanya Ayr a gaba. Sai dai, bayan an bai wa Scotland cap Rory Hughes jan kati, wanda ya saki shi daga wasan, Melrose ya yi amfani da karfin gwiwa kuma Jason Baggot ya zura kwallo a raga ba tare da canji ba.
rows.reference: Gwajin mintina na 14 na gudunmawar Anderson, da  Frazier Climo ya sauya, sa Ayr a gaba, amma, wani rawayar kati don kyaftin na Scotland Rory Hughes, da Warriors suka sake don wasan, ya bari Melrose ta yi lambobin faɗa da Jason Baggot

rows.source: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.
rows.output: Climo ya faɗaɗa jagorancin Ayr da hukunci, kafin, a ƙarshen rabin lokaci, ya ci kuma ya canza ƙwallon ƙafa don sanya shi 17-5 zuwa Ayr a hutun rabin lokaci.
rows.reference: Climo ya faɗaɗa shugabancin Ayr tare da wani fenalti, kafin, lokacin hutun rabin lokaci, ya ci shi ke nan ya musanya wani gwajin kai kaɗai don ya sa ya zama 17 zuwa 5 zuwa Ayr a hutun.

rows.source: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.
rows.output: Amma Melrose ya fara rabin na biyu da kyau kuma gwajin da Patrick Anderson ya yi, wanda Baggot ya canza, ya rage tazarar zuwa maki biyar.
rows.reference: Amma Melrose ta fara rabi na biyun ne daidai kuma Patrick Anderson ya yi kokari, da Baggot ya musanya, rage hanyar wucewar zuwa matakai biyar.

rows.source: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.
rows.output: Sannan an yi jinkiri mai tsawo saboda raunin da ya yi tsanani ga Ruaridh Knott, wanda aka kai shi asibiti, kuma daga sake farawa, Ayr ta kara kaimi ta hanyar wani Stafford McDowall, wanda Climo ya canza.
rows.reference: A da akwai a lokacin wani jinkiri mai tsayi don wani rauni mai yawa ga Ruaridh Knott, wanda aka ɗauka a kan makara, kuma sake farawar, Ayr ta tura gaba dan saman ta hanyar wani gwaji na Stafford McDowall, da Climo ya musanya.

rows.source: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.
rows.output: Kyaftin Ayr Blair Macpherson ya yi jan kati, kuma Melrose ya yi amfani da karfin da ya yi, inda ya zura kwallo a ragar Bruce Colvine, a karshen wani lokaci na matsin lamba.
rows.reference: Sa’an nan an ba wa muƙaddashin kyaftin ɗin Ayr Blair Macpherson kati rawaya, haka kuma, Melrose ya sa mutumin ya ƙara biya wani gwajin Bruce Colvine da ba a musanya ba, daga ƙarshe wani mummuna harin matsi.

rows.source: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.
rows.output: Gidan ya dawo, duk da haka, kuma lokacin da Struan Hutchinson ya samu jan kati don kai hari ga Climo ba tare da kwallo ba, daga layin hukunci, MacPherson ya taba kasa a bayan gungun Ayr da ke ci gaba.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren gidan ya dawo, amma, kuma a lokacin da aka ba da kati rawaya a Struan Hutchinson don tunkarar Climo ba tare da ƙwallo ba, daga layin wajen fenalti the penalty, MacPherson ya taɓa ƙasa daga bayan tunkuɗewar Ayr da ke kusantowa.

rows.source: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.
rows.output: Climo ya canza, kamar yadda ya sake yi daga farko, bayan Kyle Rowe ya tattara bugun daga kai da kai na David Armstrong ya kuma tura Gregor Henry a gefen hagu don bugun gida na biyar.
rows.reference: Climo ya musanyu, kamar yadda ya sake yi aƙalla daga farawa, bayan Kyle Rowe ya tara bugun akwati na David Armstrong kuma ya aika Gregor Henry wani waje don gwajin gefen gida na biyar.

rows.source: Still Game star looks set for new career in restaurant industry
rows.output: Tauraron wasan har yanzu yana shirin sabon sana'a a masana'antar gidan abinci
rows.reference: Har yanzu tauraro Game ya shirya don sabon aiki a masana’antar sayar da abinci

rows.source: Still Game star Ford Kieran looks set to move into the hospitality industry after it was discovered he's been named as the director of a licensed restaurants company.
rows.output: Tauraron wasan har yanzu, Ford Kieran, yana shirin shiga masana'antar masauki bayan an gano cewa an nada shi a matsayin darakta a wani kamfani mai gidajen cin abinci da aka ba da lasisi.
rows.reference: Har yanzu tauraro Game Ford Kieran ya nuna ya shirya shiga zuwa cikin masana’antar kulawa bayan an gano an ba shi matsayi na daraktan wani kamfani mai lasisin sayar da abinci.

rows.source: The 56-year-old plays Jack Jarvis on the popular BBC show, which he writes and co-stars with long-time comedy partner Greg Hemphill.
rows.output: Mai shekaru 56 yana taka rawar Jack Jarvis a shahararren shirin BBC, wanda ya rubuta kuma ya yi tare da abokin aikin barkwanci na dogon lokaci Greg Hemphill.
rows.reference: Mai shekaru 56 yana fitowa a Jack Jarvis a cikin sanannen shirin BBC, wanda yake rubutawa da sauran taurari tare da mai haɗn gwiwa dan barkwanci Greg Hemphill.

rows.source: The duo have announced that the upcoming ninth series will be the final one in the show's run, and it appears Kiernan is planning for life after Craiglang.
rows.output: An sanar da cewa jerin na tara na gaba zai zama na karshe a cikin jerin, kuma yana kama da cewa Kiernan yana shirin rayuwa bayan Craiglang.
rows.reference: Su biyun sun sanar da cewa jerin nau’uka na tara da ke zuwa za su zama na ƙarshe a cikin gudanar da shirin, kuma ya bayyana Kiernan yana shirya rayuwa bayana Craiglang.

rows.source: According to official record listings, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.output: Bisa ga rajistar hukuma, shi ne babban jami'in kamfanin Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.reference: A cewar rubutaccen labari na jere-jere na kamfani, shi ne darakta na Adriftmorn Limited.

rows.source: The actor declined to comment on the story, though a Scottish Sun source hinted that Kiernan was looking to get involved in Glasgow's "thriving restaurant trade."
rows.output: Ba a yi magana da ɗan wasan ba game da labarin, amma wani tushen Sun na Scotland ya nuna cewa Kiernan yana neman shiga cikin kasuwancin gidan abinci na "mai bunƙasa" na Glasgow.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasan kwaikwayon ya ki yin ya ce wani kome a kan labarin, kodayake wata kafar labari ta Scottish Sun ta tsegunta cewa Kiernan yana neman ya shiga cikin “kasuwar sayar da abinci mai ci gaba” ta Glasgow.

rows.source: 'The sea is ours': landlocked Bolivia hopes court will reopen path to Pacific
rows.output: "Tekunmu ne": Ƙasar da ba ta da ruwa, Bolivia na fatan kotu za ta sake buɗe hanyar zuwa Tekun Pasifik.
rows.reference: ‘Tekun namu ne’: Bolivia da ke rufe da ƙasa tana fatan kotu za ta buɗe hanyar zuwa Pacific

rows.source: Sailors patrol a rigging-clad naval headquarters in La Paz.
rows.output: Masu ruwa da ruwa suna zagayawa da hedkwatar sojojin ruwa a La Paz.
rows.reference: Matuƙan jirgin ruwa suna sintiri a wurin tsayuwa na hedikwatar sojojin ruwa a cikin La Paz.

rows.source: Public buildings fly an ocean-blue flag.
rows.output: Gine-ginen jama'a suna tashi da tutar ruwan teku.
rows.reference: Gine-ginen gwamnati sun daga tutar launin teku shudi.

rows.source: Naval bases from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon are daubed with the motto: "The sea is ours by right.
rows.output: Tashoshin ruwa daga tafkin Titicaca zuwa Amazon suna da rubutu: "Tekun namu ne ta hanyar hakki.
rows.reference: Sansanonin sojojin ruwa daga Tabkin Titicaca zuwa  Amazon da aka sa wa motto: “Teku namu ne a haƙƙi.

rows.source: To recover it is a duty."
rows.output: Don dawo da shi wajibi ne."
rows.reference: Dawo da shi haƙƙinmu ne.”

rows.source: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.
rows.output: A duk fadin kasar Bolivia da ba ta da bakin teku, tunanin bakin teku da aka rasa ga Chile a yakin ƙarfe na ƙarni na 19 ya yi kyau - kamar yadda shekarar da ake son tafiya a teku ta Pacific.
rows.reference: A cikin gaba ɗaya Bolivia da ke kewaye da ƙasa, tuna rasa wani yankin bakin teku ga Chile wani mummunan rikicin albarkar abu na ƙarni na 19 har yanzu a fili a yake - don saboda shi ne buƙatar su sake bi ta ruwan Tekun Pacific Ocean.

rows.source: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.
rows.output: Wadannan fata na iya kasancewa a mafi girman matakin shekaru goma, yayin da Bolivia ke jiran hukuncin kotun koli ta kasa da kasa a ranar 1 ga watan Oktoba bayan shekaru biyar na tattaunawa.
rows.reference: Waɗannan ire-iren fata suna watakila mafi girma a cikin shekaru, a lokacin da Bolivia din ke jiran wani ƙaramin hukunci daga kotun duniya a ranar 1 ga Oktoba bayan shekaru biyar ana jin bahasi.

rows.source: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.
rows.output: "Bolivia tana da karfin gwiwa, ruhin hadin kai da kwanciyar hankali, kuma ba shakka tana sa ran sakamakon da kyakkyawan fata," in ji Roberto Calzadilla, jakadan Bolivia.
rows.reference: "Bolivia tana da kuzari, da halin haɗin kai da kwanciyar hankali, kuma ba shakka tana tsammanin wani kyakkyawan batu da zai fito,” inji Roberto Calzadilla, wani jami’in diflomasiyya na Bolivia.

rows.source: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.
rows.output: Yawan 'yan Bolivia za su kalli hukuncin kotun ICJ a kan manyan allunan a fadin kasar, suna fatan cewa kotun da ke Hague za ta yanke hukunci a kan Bolivia cewa - bayan shekaru da dama na tattaunawa da ba ta da tabbas - Chile ta yi wajibi ta tattauna ba da Bolivia damar samun hanyar teku mai zaman kanta.
rows.reference: ‘Yan Bolivia za su kalli hukuncin na Kotun Duniyar a kan manyan talabijoji a faɗin ƙasar, suna masu fatan cewa kotun ta The Hague za ta sami matsaya na yarda da neman na Bolivia - bayan shekaru masu yawa na tattaunawa da ba nasara - Chile ta yarda da tattaunawa inda ta ba wa Bolivia ‘yancin mafita zuwa ga tekun.

rows.source: Evo Morales, Bolivia's charismatic indigenous president - who faces a controversial battle for re-election next year - also has plenty riding on Monday's ruling.
rows.output: Evo Morales, shugaban ƙasar Bolivia mai ban mamaki da asalin ƙasar - wanda ke fuskantar wata babbar gwabza ta sake zaɓe a shekara mai zuwa - kuma yana da abubuwa da yawa da za su yi hasashe a ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: Evo Morales, shugaban Bolivia mai farin jini ɗan asali - wanda ke fuskantar wani yaƙi mai ruɗarwa na sake zaɓe shekara mai zuwa yana da dama mai yawa daga hukuncin na ranar Litinin.

rows.source: "We are very close to returning to the Pacific Ocean," he vowed in late August.
rows.output: "Muna kusa da dawowa zuwa Tekun Pasifik," ya yi alkawari a karshen watan Agusta.
rows.reference: “Mun kusan dawowa zuwa ga Tekun Pacific,” a wata  jaddadawa a cikin ƙarshen Agusta.

rows.source: But some analysts believe that the court is unlikely to decide in Bolivia's favour - and that little would change if it did.
rows.output: Amma wasu masana sun yi imanin cewa kotun ba ta yiwuwa ta yanke hukunci a kan Bolivia - kuma ba za a yi wani canji ba idan ta yi.
rows.reference: Amma wasu masu fashin baƙi sun yi imani cewa zai yi wahala ta yanke hukunci yadda Bolivia ɗin ke so - kuma cewa ba abin da zai canza idan ta yi.

rows.source: The Netherlands-based UN body has no power to award Chilean territory, and has stipulated that it will not determine the outcome of possible talks.
rows.output: Jami'ar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya da ke kasar Netherlands ba ta da ikon baiwa Chile yankin kasa, kuma ta bayyana cewa ba za ta tantance sakamakon tattaunawar da za ta iya yi ba.
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniyar mai mazauni a Netherlands ba ta da iko na bayar da iyakar ta Chile, kuma ta bayyana cewa ba za ta ƙudurta abin da zai bayyana na tattaunawar da za yiwu.

rows.source: That the ICJ's ruling comes only six months after the final arguments were heard indicates the case "wasn't complicated," said Paz Zárate, a Chilean expert in international law.
rows.output: Hukuncin kotun ICJ ya zo ne kawai watanni shida bayan an yi muhawara ta karshe, wanda ke nuna cewa "ba a rikitar da shi ba," in ji Paz Zárate, kwararre kan doka ta kasa da kasa a kasar Chile.
rows.reference: Cewar hukunci na Kotun Duniyar yana zuwa ne kawai a bayan watanni shida da jin mahawarorin ƙarshe ya nuna shari’ar “ba ta da rudani,” inji Paz Zárate wata ƙwararriya ‘yar Chile a kan shari’ar ƙasa-da-ƙasa.

rows.source: And far from furthering Bolivia's cause, the past four years may have set it back.
rows.output: Kuma nesa da kara karfafa tattalin arzikin Bolivia, shekaru hudu da suka gabata na iya jefa ta baya.
rows.reference: Kuma bai yi kusa da taimakon shari’ar ta Bolivia ba, shekaru huɗun da suka wuce kila sun jawo mata koma baya.

rows.source: "The issue of access to the sea has been hijacked by the current Bolivian administration," said Zárate.
rows.output: "Batun samun damar zuwa teku an sace shi da gwamnatin Bolivia ta yanzu," in ji Zárát.
rows.reference: “Gwamnatin Bolivia ta yanzun ta kame batun na samun iso ga tekun,” inji Zárate.

rows.source: Morales's belligerent rhetoric has sapped any residual Chilean goodwill, she suggested.
rows.output: Maganganun da Morales ya yi sun yi tsanani sun kawo ƙarshen duk wani kyakkyawan fata da Chile ke da shi, in ji ta.
rows.reference: “Surutan Morales marassa kyau sun ƙare duk wani tausayi na Chile, a ra’ayinta.

rows.source: Bolivia and Chile will at some point continue to talk, but it will be extremely difficult to hold discussions after this.
rows.output: Bolivia da Chile za su yi magana a wani lokaci, amma zai yi matukar wahala a yi tattaunawa bayan wannan.
