rows.source: According to the London Gazette, on 29 September 1918 Lt Col Vann led his battalion across the Canal de Saint-Quentin "through a very thick fog and under heavy fire from field and machine guns."
rows.output: A cewar jaridar Landan, a ranar 29 ga Satumba 1918, Lt Col Vann ya jagoranci rundunarsa ta wuce Canal de Saint-Quentin "ta hanyar wani kauri mai kauri da kuma karkashin wuta mai nauyi daga bindigogi da na'urorin harbi."
rows.reference: A cewar kundin tarihin London, ranar 29 ga Satumba 1918, Lt Col Vann ya jagoranci dakarunsa a fadin Canal de Saint-Quentin "ta hanyar mai matukar damuwa da hazo mai matukar duhu ga wuta daga filin daga da bindigogi na inji."

rows.source: He later rushed up to the firing line and with the "greatest gallantry" led the line forward before rushing a field-gun single-handed and knocked out three of the detachment.
rows.output: Ya daga baya ya yi gudu zuwa layin harbe-harbe ya jagoranci layin gaba da jaruntaka kafin ya ruga da bindigar filin ya kuma kashe mutane uku daga cikin rundunar.
rows.reference: Daga bisani sai ya haura zuwa layin harbi tare "mafi girma jarumta" wanda ya jagorancin gaban layin kafin ya fakaito da bindigar -fili shi kadai kuma ya durkusa runduna uku.

rows.source: Lt Col Vann was killed by a German sniper on 4 October 1918 - just over a month before the war ended.
rows.output: Maj Vann ya kashe shi da wani mai harbin bindiga na Jamus a ranar 4 ga Oktoba 1918 - kusan wata guda kafin a kawo karshen yakin.
rows.reference: Maharbin ɓoye na ƙasar Jamus ne ya kashe Laftanar Kanar Vann a ranar 4 ga watan Oktobar 1918 - wata daya kawai kafin a gama yaƙin.

rows.source: Michael Vann, 72, said his grandfather's actions were "something that I know that I could never live up to but something which is humbling."
rows.output: Michael Vann, 72, ya ce ayyukan kakansa "wani abu ne da na san ba zan iya rayuwa ba, amma wani abu ne mai ban sha'awa."
rows.reference: Michael Vann, mai shekaru 72, ya ce ayyukan kakansa "wani abu da na san cewa ba zan taba iya zama ba sai dai wani abu da yake da tawali'u."

rows.source: He and his brother Dr James Vann also laid a wreath after the parade, which was led by the Brentwood Imperial Youth Band.
rows.output: Shi da ɗan'uwansa Dr James Vann suma sun shimfiɗa wani zane bayan tattakin, wanda ƙungiyar matasa ta Brentwood Imperial ta jagoranta.
rows.reference: Shi da ɗan'uwansa, Dr James Vann, sun kuma sanya kyalle bayan faretin, wanda Brentwood Imperial Youth Band ya jagoranta.

rows.source: Michael Vann said he was "feeling very honoured to play a part in the parade" and added "the valour of a genuine hero is being demonstrated by the support that is going to be given by a lot of people."
rows.output: Michael Vann ya ce yana "ji daɗin samun daraja sosai don yin rawa a cikin tattakin" kuma ya kara da cewa "jaruntaka na gaskiya na nuna jaruntaka ta hanyar tallafin da mutane da yawa za su bayar."
rows.reference: Michael Vann ya ce "na ji daɗin karamawan sosai don rawan da na taka a cikin faratin" kuma ya kara da cewa babban jarumi ne wanda a nunawa goyon baya da kuma taimakon da mutane ke bayarwa."

rows.source: MMA fans stayed up all night to watch Bellator 206, they got Peppa Pig instead
rows.output: Masu sha'awar MMA sun zauna duk dare suna kallon Bellator 206, sun sami Peppa Pig maimakon
rows.reference: Masoyan MMA sun kwana a zaune domin kallon Bellator 206, amma kuma sai suka samu Peppa Pig a maimako

rows.source: Imagine this, you have stayed up all night to watch the a packed Bellator 206 only to be denied watching the main event.
rows.output: Ka yi tunanin wannan, ka tsaya dukan dare don kallon cunkoson Bellator 206 kawai don ka hana ka kallon babban taron.
rows.reference: Ka yi la'akari da haka, ka kwana zaune don kallon Bellator 206 amma kawai sai a hana ka kallon ainihin taron.

rows.source: The bill from San Jose contained 13 fights, including six on the main card and was being shown live through the night in the UK on Channel 5.
rows.output: Kudirin daga San Jose ya ƙunshi fafatawa 13, ciki har da shida a babban katin, kuma ana nuna shi kai tsaye a duk dare a Birtaniya a tashar Channel 5.
rows.reference: Lissafin daga San Jose ya ƙunshi fadace-fadace 13, ciki harda shida a kan babban katin kuma an nuna su kai tsaye cikin dare a Birtaniya akan Tasha na 5.

rows.source: At 6am, just as Gegard Mousasi and Rory MacDonald were preparing to face each other, viewers in the UK were left stunned when the coverage changed to Peppa Pig.
rows.output: Da misalin ƙarfe 6 na safe, daidai lokacin da Gegard Mousasi da Rory MacDonald suka shirya fuskantar juna, masu kallo a Birtaniya sun yi mamaki lokacin da watsa shirye-shiryen ya canza zuwa Peppa Pig.
rows.reference: Ƙarfe 6 na safe, kamar yadda Gegard Mousasi da Rory MacDonald suka shirya don fuskantar juna, masu kallo a Birtaniya sun kasance masu mamaki lokacin da yanayin ya canza zuwa Peppa Pig.

rows.source: Some were unimpressed after they had stayed awake until the early hours especially for the fight.
rows.output: Wasu sun ji kunya bayan sun tsaya a farke har zuwa sa'o'i masu wuya musamman don fafatawar.
rows.reference: Wadansu ba su damu ba bayan sun kwana zaune har zuwa har farkon safiya musamman don fadan.

rows.source: One fan on Twitter described the switch to the children's cartoon as "some sort of sick joke."
rows.output: Wani mai sha'awar Twitter ya bayyana canjin zuwa zane-zanen yara a matsayin "wani irin wasa mai ban tsoro."
rows.reference: Masoyi daya ya bayyana a Twitter cewa canji zuwa zane mai ban dariya na yara kamar “wani irin wasan mararsa lafiya.’

rows.source: "It's government regulation that at 6 a.m. that content was not suitable so they had to switch to children's programming, " said Dave Schwartz, Bellator senior vice president of marketing and communication, when asked about the transmission.
rows.output: "Shi ne dokar gwamnati ta haramta watsa shirye-shiryen da suka shafi yara a lokacin da ake watsa shirye-shiryen da suka shafi yara a lokacin da ake watsa shirye-shiryen da suka shafi yara a lokacin da ake watsa shirye-shiryen da suka shafi yara a lokacin da ake watsa shirye-shiryen da suka shafi yara a lokacin da ake watsa shirye-shiryen da suka shafi yara a lokacin da ake watsa shirye-shiryen da suka shafi
rows.reference: "Dokar gwamnati ce cewa karfe 6 na safe a canza tashar domin shirin bai dace ba don haka dole su canza zuwa shirye shiryen yara," in ji Dave Schwartz, matamakin shugaba na sadarwa da kasuwanci, lokacin da aka tambaye shi game da watsawa.

rows.source: ""Peppa the pig," yes."
rows.output: "Peppa alade," eh.
rows.reference: ""Peppa aleden," eh."

rows.source: Bellator company president Scott Coker said that they are going to work on their scheduling to include UK viewers in the future.
rows.output: Shugaban kamfanin Bellator Scott Coker ya ce za su yi aiki a kan jadawalinsu don haɗawa da masu kallo a Birtaniya a nan gaba.
rows.reference: Shugaban kamfanin Bellator, Scott Coker, ya ce za su yi aiki a kan shirye-shiryen su hade da masu kallo na Birtaniya a nan gaba.

rows.source: "I think that when I think about the replay, I think that we can probably work it out," Coker said.
rows.output: "Ina ganin cewa idan na yi tunani game da sake kunnawa, ina ganin cewa za mu iya yiwuwa mu warware shi," Coker ya ce.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin idan na yi tunani game da sake bugawa, ina tsammanin zai iya wadatarwa," in ji Coker.

rows.source: "But it's six in the morning on a Sunday there and we won't be able to work this out until Sunday our time, Monday their time.
rows.output: "Amma yana da shida na safe a ranar Lahadi a can kuma ba za mu iya aiki da wannan ba har sai ranar Lahadi a lokacinmu, ranar Litinin a lokacinsu.
rows.reference: "Amma shida ne na safiyar ranar Lahadi a can, kuma ba za mu iya yin hakan ba har sai lokacin mu na Lahadi, Litinin lokacin su.

rows.source: But we are working on it.
rows.output: Amma muna aiki a kai.
rows.reference: amma mu na aiki akan shi.

rows.source: Believe me, when it switched over there were a lot of texts going back and forth and they all were not friendly.
rows.output: Ka yarda da ni, lokacin da ya canza zuwa can, akwai wasu rubuce-rubuce da yawa suna tafiya da juna kuma duk ba su da kyau.
rows.reference: Ku yarda da ni, lokacin da aka sauya shi a can akwai sakonni da suke ta yawo gaba da baya kuma dukansu ba su da dadi.

rows.source: We were trying to fix it, we thought it was a technical glitch.
rows.output: Muna kokarin gyara shi, muna tunanin kuskure ne na fasaha.
rows.reference: Mu na ƙoƙarin gyara shi, mun yi tsammani abu ne da ya shafi matsalar fasaha.

rows.source: But it wasn't, it was a governmental issue.
rows.output: Amma ba haka ba ne, batun gwamnati ne.
rows.reference: Amma ba haka ba, batu ne na gwamnati.

rows.source: I can promise you the next time it's not going to happen.
rows.output: Zan iya ba ku tabbacin cewa lokaci na gaba ba zai faru ba.
rows.reference: Ina maku alkwalin hakan ba zai sake faruwa ba.

rows.source: We'll keep it down to five fights instead of six - like we normally do - and we tried to overdeliver for the fans and we just went over.
rows.output: Za mu kiyaye shi zuwa fada biyar maimakon shida - kamar yadda muke yi - kuma mun yi ƙoƙarin wuce gona da iri ga masu sha'awar kuma mun kawai wuce.
rows.reference: Ku yarda dani, lokacin da aka sauya shi a can akwai sakonni da suke ta yawo gaba da baya kuma dukansu ba su da dadi.

rows.source: It's an unfortunate situation."
rows.output: Wannan yanayi ne mai ban tsoro."
rows.reference: halin takaici ne.”

rows.source: Desert Island Discs: Tom Daley felt 'inferior' over sexuality
rows.output: Rundunar Tsibirin Hamada: Tom Daley ya ji "ƙananan" game da jinsinsa
rows.reference: Hamada Tsibirin Discs: Tom Daley ya ji 'dagawa' saboda jinsi

rows.source: Olympic diver Tom Daley says he grew up feeling inferior to everyone because of his sexuality - but that gave him the motivation to become a success.
rows.output: Mai nutsewa a gasar Olympics Tom Daley ya ce ya ji kunya da kowa saboda jinsinsa - amma hakan ya ba shi kwarin guiwa ya zama mai nasara.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasan Olympics Tom Daley ya ce ya girma yana jin dagawa fiye da kowa saboda jinsin sa - amma hakan ne ya bashi hazaka wajen samun nasara.

rows.source: The 24-year-old said he did not realise until he went to secondary school that "not everyone is like me."
rows.output: Mai shekaru 24 ya ce bai gane ba sai ya je makarantar sakandare cewa "ba kowa kamar ni ba."
rows.reference: Dan shekaru 24 ya ce bai fahimta ba har sai da ya tafi makarantar sakandare cewa "ba kowa ba ne kamar ni."

rows.source: Speaking on the first Radio 4 Desert Island Discs presented by Lauren Laverne, he said he spoke out about gay rights to give others "hope."
rows.output: A yayin da yake magana a kan shirin Radio 4 Desert Island Discs da Lauren Laverne ya gabatar, ya ce ya yi magana game da hakkin LGBTQ don ba wasu "bege."
rows.reference: Da yake jawabi a gidan farko Rediyo 4 Hamadan Tsibiri wanda Lauren Laverne ya gabatar, ya ce ya yi magana game da hakkokin 'yan luwadi na ba da wasu "fata".

rows.source: He also said becoming a parent made him care less about winning the Olympics.
rows.output: Ya kuma ce zama uba ya sa ya kasa damuwa da lashe gasar Olympics.
rows.reference: Kuma yace kasancewarsa uba ya sanya shi rashin damuwa akan cin wasan Olympics.

rows.source: The regular presenter of the long-running show, Kirsty Young, has taken a number of months off because of illness.
rows.output: Mai gabatar da shirin na yau da kullun, Kirsty Young, ya dauki watanni da yawa na hutu saboda rashin lafiya.
rows.reference: Mai gabatarwa da shirin na yau da kullum, Kirsty Young, ya dauki watanni da dama na hutu saboda rashin lafiya.

rows.source: Appearing as a castaway on Laverne's first programme, Daley said he felt "less than" everyone else growing up because "it wasn't socially acceptable to like boys and girls."
rows.output: Bayyana a matsayin wanda aka yi wa kama a shirin farko na Laverne, Daley ya ce ya ji "kasa da" kowa a lokacin girma saboda "ba a yarda da son yara maza da mata."
rows.reference: Yayin da ya bayyana a matsayin wani na daban a kan shirin farko na Laverne, Daley ya ce yana jin "kasa da" kowa na girma saboda "ba a yarda da ba jama’a su so maza da 'yan mata ba."

rows.source: He said: "To this day, those feelings of feeling less than, and feeling different, have been the real things that have given me the power and strength to be able to succeed."
rows.output: Ya ce: "Har yau, wadannan ji na jin kasa da kasa, da jin bambamci, sun kasance abubuwan da suka ba ni karfin gwiwa da karfin gwiwa don in iya samun nasara."
rows.reference: Ya ce: "Har wa yau, irin abubuwan da nake ji na ƙasa da, da kuma jin wani abu daban, sun kasance ainihin abubuwan da suka ba ni iko da karfi don samun nasara."

rows.source: He wanted to prove that he was "something," he said, so that he did not disappoint everyone when they eventually found out about his sexuality.
rows.output: Ya so ya tabbatar da cewa shi "wani abu ne," ya ce, don haka ba ya bata wa kowa rai lokacin da suka gano jinsinsa a karshe.
rows.reference: Ya so ya tabbatar da cewa shi "wani abu," in ji shi, don haka bai yi takaici ga kowa ba a lokacin da suka gano jinsin sa.

rows.source: The two-time bronze Olympic medallist has become a high-profile LGBT campaigner and used his appearance at this year's Commonwealth Games in Australia to appeal for more countries to decriminalise homosexuality.
rows.output: Mai ritaya sau biyu a gasar Olympics ta tagulla, ya zama mai fafutukar LGBT kuma ya yi amfani da halartar gasar Commonwealth a wannan shekarar a Ostiraliya don rokon kasashe da dama su soke hukuncin kisa na jima'i.
rows.reference: Wakilin wasan Olympics na tagulla guda biyu ya zama dan wasan LGBT mai girma kuma ya yi amfani da shi a gasar Commonwealth na wannan shekara a Australia don neman kara yawan kasashe da zasu bada daman luwadi.

rows.source: He said he spoke out because he felt lucky to be able to live openly without ramifications and wanted to give others "hope."
rows.output: Ya ce ya yi magana ne saboda ya ji sa’ar rayuwa a bayyane ba tare da wani sakamako ba, kuma ya so ya ba wasu “fata.”
rows.reference: Ya ce ya yi magana ne saboda ya ji daɗin kasancewa a fili ba tare da raguwa ba kuma yana so ya ba wasu "fata".

rows.source: The three-time world champion said falling in love with a man - US film-maker Dustin Lance Black, who he met in 2013 - "caught me by surprise."
rows.output: Mai taken duniya sau uku ya ce, "Soyayya da namiji - wanda shine mai shirya fina-finan Amurka Dustin Lance Black, wanda na hadu da shi a shekarar 2013 - ya kama ni da mamaki."
rows.reference: Shi zakara uku a duniya ya ce fadawa soyaya da namij i-dan wasan Dustin Lance Black na Amurka, wanda ya hadu da shi a 2013 - "ya zame man abun mamaki."

rows.source: Daley married the Oscar winner, who is 20 years his senior, last year but he said the age gap had never been an issue.
rows.output: Daley ya auri wanda ya lashe kyautar Oscar, wanda ya kai shekaru 20 a kan shi, a shekarar da ta gabata amma ya ce tazarar shekaru ba ta taba zama matsala ba.
rows.reference: Daley ya auri zakaran Oscar, wanda ya girme shi da shekaru 20, a bara amma ya ce tazarar shekarun ba damuwa bane.

rows.source: "When you go through so much at such a young age" - he went to his first Olympics aged 14 and his father died of cancer three years later - he said that it was hard to find someone the same age who had experienced similar highs and lows.
rows.output: "Idan ka shiga irin wannan yanayi a lokacin da kake matashi" - ya tafi gasar Olympics ta farko yana da shekaru 14, kuma mahaifinsa ya rasu sakamakon ciwon daji shekaru uku bayan haka - ya ce yana da wuya a samu wani da irin wannan shekarun da ya fuskanci irin wannan manyan abubuwa da kuma ƙananan abubuwa.
rows.reference: "Idan kayi fama da abubuwa da yawa a kanana shekaru" - ya tafi wasan Olympics din shi na farko yana da shekaru 14 kuma mahaifinsa ya mutu ciwon daji bayan shekaru uku - ya ce yana da wuya a sami mutumin da ya taɓa samun irin wannan matsayi sama da kasa.

rows.source: The couple became parents in June, to a son called Robert Ray Black-Daley, and Daley said his "whole perspective" had changed.
rows.output: Ma'auratan sun zama iyaye a watan Yuni, da ɗa mai suna Robert Ray Black-Daley, kuma Daley ya ce ra'ayinsa "gaba ɗaya" ya canza.
rows.reference: Ma’auratan sun zama iyaye a Yuni, ga ɗa mai suna Robert Ray Black-Daley, kuma Daley ya ce “dukka haganen zaman gaban shi” ya canja.

rows.source: "If you had asked me last year, it was all about 'I need to win a gold medal'," he said.
rows.output: "Idan ka tambaye ni a shekarar da ta gabata, duk abin da ya shafi shi ne 'Ina bukatan lashe lambar zinare'."
rows.reference: “Idan da ka tambayeni bara, duk batun ‘ina bukatan na ci lambar zinariya ne’, inji shi.

rows.source: "You know what, there are bigger things than Olympic gold medals.
rows.output: "Kun san abin da, akwai abubuwa masu girma fiye da lambar zinare ta Olympics.
rows.reference: “Ka san meye, akwai wasu manyan abubuwa fiye da lambar zinariyar wasar Olympics.

rows.source: My Olympic gold medal is Robbie."
rows.output: Zanen zinare na Olympics na Robbie ne."
rows.reference: Lambar zinariyar wasar Olympics dina Robbie ne.”

rows.source: His son has the same name as his father Robert, who died in 2011 aged 40 after being diagnosed with brain cancer.
rows.output: Dansa yana da sunan mahaifinsa Robert, wanda ya rasu a shekarar 2011 yana da shekaru 40 bayan an gano masa ciwon daji a kwakwalwa.
rows.reference: Dan shi yana da suna daya da baban shi Robert, wanda ya mutu a 2011 a shekara 40 bayan an gano shi da cutar daji ta kwakwalwa.

rows.source: Daley said his dad did not accept he was going to die and one of the last things he had asked was if they had their tickets yet for London 2012 - as he wanted to be on the front row.
rows.output: Daley ya ce mahaifinsa bai yarda zai mutu ba kuma daya daga cikin abubuwan karshe da ya tambaya shi shine ko suna da tikiti tukuna don Landan 2012 - domin ya so ya kasance a layin gaba.
rows.reference: Daley ya ce baban shi bai yarda cewa zai mutu ba kuma abun daya daga cikin abubuwan karshe da ya tambaya shi ne idan su na da tiketin su zuwa Landan 2012 - tun da yana son ya zauna a layin gaba.

rows.source: "I couldn't say to him 'you're not going to be around to be on the front row dad'," he said.
rows.output: "Ba zan iya cewa masa 'ba za ka kasance a nan don zama a gaba ba, baba," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Ban iya ce mashi ‘ba zaka samu daman zama a layin gaba ba baba’,” ya ce.

rows.source: "I was holding his hand as he stopped breathing and it wasn't until he'd actually stopped breathing and he was dead that I finally acknowledged he wasn't invincible," he said.
rows.output: "Na rike hannunsa yayin da ya tsaya numfashi kuma ba har sai ya tsaya da gaske ya mutu ba na amince da cewa ba shi da kama da mutuwa."
rows.reference: “Ina rike da hannun shi a lokacin da ya daina nunfashi kuma har sai da ya asalin daina numfashi kuma ya mutu kafin na yarda cewa dan Adam ne,” ya ce.

rows.source: The following year Daley competed at the 2012 Olympics and won bronze.
rows.output: A shekara mai zuwa, Daley ya fafata a gasar Olympics ta 2012 kuma ya lashe tagulla.
rows.reference: Shekarar gaban Daley ya yi takara a wasar Olympics na 2012 kuma ya ci tagulla.

rows.source: "I just knew that this is what I had dreamt of my whole life - to dive in front of a home crowd at an Olympic Games, there was no better feeling," he said.
rows.output: "Na san cewa wannan shi ne abin da na yi mafarki na rayuwata gaba ɗaya - don nutsewa a gaban taron jama'a a gasar Olympics, babu wani jin daɗi mafi girma," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ni kawai na san cewa wannan shi ne abun da nake mafarkin shi duk rayuwa ta - na yi iyo a gaban taron mutanen gida a Wasar Olympics, babu wani yanayi da yafi haka,” ya ce.

rows.source: It also inspired his first song choice - Proud by Heather Small - which had resonated with him in the build up to the Olympics and still gave him goosebumps.
rows.output: Hakanan ya zaburar da waƙarsa ta farko - Murna ta Heather Ƙanana - wadda ta yi masa ƙamshi a lokacin da yake shirin gasar Olympics, kuma har yanzu tana sa shi jin ƙaiƙayi.
rows.reference: Kuma yayi wahayi a zabin wakar shi ta farko - Alfahari daga Heather Small - wanda yayi jimame da shi a shirye shiryen wasar Olympics kuma ya ke tayar mashi da sigar jiki.

rows.source: Desert Island Discs is on BBC Radio 4 on Sunday at 11:15 BST.
rows.output: Rukunin Tsibirin Hamada yana kan BBC Radio 4 a ranar Lahadi da karfe 11:15 BST.
rows.reference: Hamadan Tsibiri Disc yana kan BBC Radiyo 4 a ranar Lahadi a karfe 11:15

rows.source: Out-of-form Mickelson benched on Ryder Cup Saturday
rows.output: Mickelson da ba ya cikin koshin lafiya an sanya shi a gefe a lokacin gasar Ryder Cup ranar Asabar
rows.reference: An ajiye gajiyayyen dan wasa Mickelson a gasar Kofin Ryder ranar Asabar

rows.source: American Phil Mickelson will set a record on Sunday when he plays his 47th Ryder Cup match, but he will have to turn his form around to avoid it being an unhappy milestone.
rows.output: Amurkawa Phil Mickelson zai kafa tarihi a ranar Lahadi lokacin da ya buga wasansa na 47 na gasar Ryder, amma dole ne ya inganta wasansa don kaucewa cimma wani buri mara dadi.
rows.reference: Dan wasan Amurka Phil Mickelson zai kafa tarihi a ranar Lahadi lokacin da ya taka leda a gasar cin kofin Ryder na 47, amma dole ne ya sauya tsarinsa don kauce baƙin ciki a matsayin.

rows.source: Mickelson, playing in the biennial event for a record 12th time, was benched by captain Jim Furyk for Saturday's fourballs and foursomes.
rows.output: Mickelson, yana wasa a wannan taron na shekara-shekara a karo na 12, an mayar da shi baya ta hanyar kyaftin Jim Furyk don wasan zagaye na hudu da na hudu a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Mickelson, wanda ke taka leda a cikin biki na 12, kyaftin Jim Furyk ne ya ajiye dan wasan a kwallo hudu ga mutum hudu na ranar Asabar.

rows.source: Instead of being at the center of the action, as he so often has been for the United States, the five-times major winner split his day between being a cheerleader and working on his game on the range in the hope of rectifying what ails him.
rows.output: Maimakon kasancewa a tsakiyar aikin, kamar yadda ya kasance sau da yawa ga Amurka, wanda ya lashe babban gasar sau biyar, ya raba ranarsa tsakanin zama mai goyon baya da kuma aiki a kan wasansa a filin wasa, a fatan gyara abin da ke damunsa.
rows.reference: Maimakon kasancewarsa a tsakiyar wasan, kamar yadda ya saba wa Amurka, fitaccen mai nasara sau biyar ya raba ranar tsakaninsa na kasancewa mai karfafawa da kuma aiki a kan wasansa a kan layi tare da bege na gyara abin da yake da shi .

rows.source: Never the straightest of drivers even at the peak of his career, the 48-year-old is not an ideal fit for the tight Le Golf National course, where the long rough routinely punishes errant shots.
rows.output: Babu wanda ya yi tsayayya a hanyar tuki ko da a lokacin da ya fi kowa ƙarfi, mai shekaru 48 ba shi da kyau ga wannan ƙaramin filin wasan golf na Le Golf National, inda dogayen ciyayi ke hukunta kwallayen da ba daidai ba akai-akai.
rows.reference: Bai kasance tsayayye cikin deribobi ba ko a lokacin tashen wasan sa, dan shekaru 48 bai dace ba ga matakin wasan tsukakken wasan Le Golf na filin Tarayya, inda ke da tsayi ga azabtarwa da mummunar tashin hankali.

rows.source: And if the course on its own is not daunting enough, Mickelson, in the ninth match on Sunday, faces accurate British Open champion Francesco Molinari, who has teamed up with rookie Tommy Fleetwood to win all four of their matches this week.
rows.output: Kuma idan darasin da kansa bai isa ya firgita ba, Mickelson, a wasan na tara a ranar Lahadi, yana fuskantar zakaran gasar Biritaniya Francesco Molinari, wanda ya hada kai da sabon dan wasan Tommy Fleetwood don lashe dukkan wasannin hudu da suka yi a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Kuma idan wasan da kansa bai dace ba, Mickelson, a wasan na tara a ranar Lahadi, ya fuskanci babban zakara na Birtaniya Francesco Molinari, wanda ya haɗe tare da rookie Tommy Fleetwood don lashe dukkanin wasanni hudu a wannan makon.

rows.source: If the Americans, four points down starting the 12 singles matches, get off to a hot start, Mickelson's match could prove absolutely crucial.
rows.output: Idan Amurkawa, maki hudu a baya tun daga wasan karshe na goma sha biyu, sun fara da karfi, wasan Mickelson na iya zama mai matukar muhimmanci.
rows.reference: Idan mutanen amurka, da maki hudu kasa sun nuna cewa za su fara wasanni daidaiku 12, su tashi da zafi zuwa fara wasa, wasan na Mickelson zai zama mai muhimmiyar mahimmanci.

rows.source: Furyk expressed confidence in his man, not that he could say much else.
rows.output: Furyk ya bayyana kwarin gwiwa a kan mutumin, ba wai ya yi magana sosai ba.
rows.reference: Furyk ya nuna amincewa da mutumin na shi, duk da ba zai iya cewa komai ba kuma.

rows.source: "He fully understood the role that he had today, gave me a pat on the back and put his arm around me and said he would be ready tomorrow," Furyk said.
rows.output: "Ya fahimci rawar da yake takawa a yau, ya ba ni murmushi ya sanya hannu a kafada na ya ce zai shirya gobe," in ji Furyk.
rows.reference: "Ya fahimci muhimmancin da yake da ita a yau, ya tattaɓani a baya kuma ya sanya hannunsa kewaye da ni, ya ce zai kasance a shirye gobe," inji Furyk.

rows.source: "He's got a lot of confidence in himself.
rows.output: "Yana da kwarin guiwa sosai a kansa.
rows.reference: "Ya amince da kanshi sosai.

rows.source: He's a Hall of Famer and he's added so much to these teams in the past, and this week.
rows.output: Shi ɗan Hall of Fame ne kuma ya ƙara da yawa ga waɗannan ƙungiyoyin a baya, kuma wannan makon.
rows.reference: Yana cikin sanannen jarumai kuma an karu da shi sosai a wannan kungiyar a da, kuma da wannan satin.

rows.source: I probably didn't envision him playing two matches.
rows.output: Wataƙila ban yi tunanin zai buga wasanni biyu ba.
rows.reference: Ban taɓa tsammanin zai yiwu ya buga wasani biyu ba.

rows.source: I envisioned more, but that's the way it worked out and that's the way we thought we had to go.
rows.output: Na yi tunanin ƙarin abubuwa, amma haka ya kasance kuma haka muka yi tunanin dole ne mu tafi.
rows.reference: Na yi tsammanin fiye, amma haka tsarin ya ke kuma itace hanyar da mu ke tunanin za mu bi.

rows.source: He wants to be out there, just like everyone else."
rows.output: Yana son kasancewa a can, kamar kowa.
rows.reference: Ya so ya kasance a can waje, kamar sauran mutane. "

rows.source: Mickelson will pass Nick Faldo's record for the most Ryder Cup matches played on Sunday.
rows.output: Mickelson zai zarce rikodin Nick Faldo na mafi yawan wasannin Ryder Cup da za a yi a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Mickelson zai wuce tarihin Nick Faldo a gasar cin kofin Ryder da aka buga ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: It could mark the end of a Ryder Cup career that has never quite matched the heights of his individual record.
rows.output: Zai iya nuna ƙarshen aikin gasar cin kofin Ryder da bai taɓa kaiwa ga matsayin da ya ke da shi ba a matsayin ɗan wasa na kai.
rows.reference: Zai iya kawo ƙarshen wasan Ryder Cup wanda ba zai taɓa misaltuwa ba da babban matakin tarihin shi kadai.

rows.source: Mickelson has 18 wins, 20 losses and seven halves, though Furyk said his presence brought some intangibles to the team.
rows.output: Mickelson yana da nasarori 18, asara 20 da rabi bakwai, kodayake Furyk ya ce kasancewarsa ya kawo wasu abubuwan da ba a iya gani ba a kungiyar.
rows.reference: Mickelson ya ci wasanni 18, an ci shi 20 da kuma sun zuze a bakwai, duk da cewa Furyk ya ce kasancewarsa ya kawo wasu abubuwan mahimmai ga kungiyar.

rows.source: "He's funny, he's sarcastic, witty, likes to poke fun at people, and he's a great guy to have in the team room," he explained.
rows.output: "Yana da ban dariya, yana da ban dariya, yana da hikima, yana son ya yi wa mutane ba'a, kuma yana da mutum mai kyau a cikin ɗakin taro," ya bayyana.
rows.reference: "Yana da ban dariya,wauta, mai ƙayatarwa, yana da son zolayar mutane, kuma ya zama babban dan wasa a cikin dakin wasan," inji shi.

rows.source: "I think the younger players had fun having a go at him, as well, this week, which was fun to see.
rows.output: Ina ganin 'yan wasan da suka kai shekaru sun ji daɗin gwada shi, kuma hakan ya yi daɗi a gani.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin matasan ‘yan wasa na son zolayar shi, har ma, wannan satin, abin da yake da ban sha'awa.

rows.source: He provides a lot more than just play."
rows.output: Yana ba da ƙarin abubuwa da yawa fiye da wasa kawai."
rows.reference: Ya kawo abubuwa da yawa fiye da wassani kawai.”

rows.source: Europe captain Thomas Bjorn knows big lead can soon disappear
rows.output: Kyaftin ƙasar Turai Thomas Bjorn ya san cewa babban jagoranci zai iya ɓacewa da sauri
rows.reference: Kyaftin din Turai Thomas Bjorn ya san bada babban tazara zai shuɗe ba da daɗewa ba

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows from experience that a sizeable lead heading into the last-day singles in the Ryder Cup can easily turn into an uncomfortable ride.
rows.output: Thomas Bjorn, shugaban Turai, ya san daga gogewa cewa jagoranci mai girma da ke shiga ranar karshe ta gasar cin kofin Ryder na iya sauya cikin sauki zuwa tafiya mai ban tsoro.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn, kyaftin din Turai, ya sani daga kwarewa sa cewa samun tazara kadan a cikin 'yan kwanaki na karshe a wasan daidaiku na Ryder Cup zamewa tuki ma wahala.

rows.source: The Dane made his debut in the 1997 match at Valderrama, where a side captained by Seve Ballesteros held a five-point advantage over the Americans but only just got over the finishing line with their noses in front by the narrowest of margins, winning 14½-13½.
rows.output: Danawa ya fara buga wasansa na farko a wasan da aka yi a Valderrama a shekarar 1997, inda kungiyar da Seve Ballesteros ke jagoranta ta samu fa'ida ta maki biyar a kan Amurkawa, amma ta samu nasarar wuce layin gamawa da karamin tazarar, inda ta lashe maki 14½-13½.
rows.reference: Dane ya fara bugawa wasan shi na farko a 1997 a Valderrama, inda Seve Ballesteros ke jagorantar da maki biyar a kan 'yan Amurkan amma dai kawai ya sami nasarar kammala layi tare da hancunan su a gaba a tazarar mafi karanta, inda ya lashe 14½- 13½.

rows.source: "You keep reminding yourself that we had a big lead at Valderrama; we had a big lead at Brookline, where we lost, and at Valderrama, where we won, but only just," said Bjorn, pictured, after watching the Class of 2018 win 5-3 both on Friday and yesterday to lead 10-6 at Le Golf National.
rows.output: "Kuna ci gaba da tunatar da kanku cewa mun yi babban jagoranci a Valderrama; mun yi babban jagoranci a Brookline, inda muka yi asara, da Valderrama, inda muka yi nasara, amma kawai da karamin kashi," in ji Bjorn, wanda aka nuna, bayan kallon Class of 2018 ta lashe 5-3 a ranar Juma'a da kuma jiya, don jagorantar 10-6 a Le Golf National.
rows.reference: "Ka ci gaba da tunatar da kanka cewa mu na da babban jagora a Valderrama, mu na da babban jagora a Brookline, inda muka rasa, kuma a Valderrama, inda muka ci nasara, amma kawai," inji Bjorn, wanda ya kwatanta, bayan kallon Ajin 2018 lashe 5-3 a ranar Jumma'a da kuma jiya don kai 10-6 a Le Golf National.

rows.source: So history will show me and everybody on that team that this is not over.
rows.output: Don haka, tarihi zai nuna ni da kowa a cikin wannan kungiyar cewa wannan ba ya karewa.
rows.reference: Toh Tarihi zai nuna mani da duk wanda ke wannan kungiyar cewa ba’a gama ba tukun.

rows.source: You go full bore tomorrow.
rows.output: Ku tafi cikin gaggawa gobe.
rows.reference: Kana da cikaken shiga gobe.

rows.source: Get out there and do all the right things.
rows.output: Ka fita can ka yi komai daidai.
rows.reference: ka je can kayi duka abun da ya kamata daidai.

rows.source: This is not over till you've got the points on the board.
rows.output: Wannan ba ya ƙarewa har sai kun sami maki a kan allo.
rows.reference: Ba’a gama wannan ba sai ka samo makunan dake kan allo.

rows.source: We have a goal, and that is to try to win this trophy, and that's where the focus stays.
rows.output: Muna da burin, kuma hakan ya shafi ƙoƙarin lashe wannan kofin, kuma hakan ne inda mayar da hankali yake.
rows.reference: Mu na da manufa, kuma shi ne mu kokarta muci wannan kofin, kuma nan ne inda zamu mai da himma.

rows.source: I've said all along, I focus on the 12 players that are in our side, but we are so well aware of what's standing across on the other side - the greatest players in the world."
rows.output: Na ce a baya, ina mai da hankali ne kan 'yan wasa 12 da ke cikin kungiyarmu, amma muna da masaniya sosai game da abin da ke jiransu a gefen daya - mafi kyawun 'yan wasa a duniya."
rows.reference: Na fada tun farko, ina mai da himma akan ‘yan wasa 12 dake tawagarmu, amma kuma duk mun san mai ke faruwa a dayan ɓangaren - su na da zakarun yan wasa na duniya.”

rows.source: Delighted how his players have performed on a tough golf course, Bjorn added: "I would never get ahead of myself in this.
rows.output: Yana da daɗi yadda 'yan wasansa suka yi a kan wani tsari mai wahala na golf, Bjorn ya ce: "Ba zan taɓa samun kaina a gaba ba a wannan.
rows.reference: Sanin yadda wadannan ‘yan wasan suka yi a filin golf mai wahala, Bjorn ya kara: “Ba zan taɓa zuwa sama da kaina ba a wannan.

rows.source: Tomorrow's a different beast.
rows.output: Gobe wani dabba ne.
rows.reference: Gobe na daban ne babba.

rows.source: Tomorrow is the individual performances that come forward, and that is a different thing to do.
rows.output: Gobe ne lokacin da mutane ke fitowa su yi wasan kwaikwayo, kuma hakan wani abu ne daban da za a yi.
rows.reference: Gobe shi ne yin daidaiku da ke zuwa gaba, kuma shima abu ne na daban wajen yi.

rows.source: It's great to be out there with a partner when things are going good, but when you're out there individually, then you're tested to the full of your capacity as a golfer.
rows.output: Yana da kyau kasancewa a waje tare da abokin tarayya lokacin da abubuwa suke tafiya da kyau, amma lokacin da kuke a waje a matsayin mutum ɗaya, to, an gwada ku zuwa iyakar ƙarfin ku a matsayin ɗan wasan golf.
rows.reference: Yana da kyau idan ya kasance tare da abokin tarayya lokacin da abubuwa ke da kyau, amma idan kun fita waje ɗaidaiku, to ana jarraba ku da cikakken ikon ku a matsayin golfer.

rows.source: That's the message that you need to get across to players, is get the best out of yourself tomorrow.
rows.output: Wannan saƙon ne da kuke buƙatar ku isar wa 'yan wasa, ku sami mafi kyawun ku gobe.
rows.reference: Wannan shi ne saƙo da kake buƙatar ya isa zuwa ga 'yan wasa, shi ne fitar da iya kwazon ka gobe.

rows.source: Now, you leave your partner behind and he has to go and get the best out of himself, as well."
rows.output: Yanzu, ka bar abokin tarayyarka ya tafi ya fito da mafi kyawun kanta, kamar yadda ya kamata."
rows.reference: Yanzu, ku bar abokanku a baya domin dole ne fitar da iya kwazon sa da kanshi, da kuma. "

rows.source: In contrast to Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk will be looking for his players to perform better individually than they did as partners, the exceptions being Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who picked up three points out of four.
rows.output: A banbance-banbance da Bjorn, adadin Jim Furyk zai kasance yana neman 'yan wasansa su yi aiki mafi kyau a matsayin 'yan wasa fiye da yadda suka yi a matsayin abokan tarayya, ban da wasu 'yan wasa biyu, Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas, wadanda suka samu maki uku cikin hudu.
rows.reference: Ya bambanta da Bjorn, kishiyar lambar Jim Furyk zai nemi 'yan wasansa suyi aiki da kwarewa fiye da yadda suke yi a tarayya, waɗanda suka hada da Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas, wanda ya dauki maki uku daga cikin hudu.

rows.source: Furyk himself has been on both ends of those big last-day turnarounds, having been part of the winning team at Brookline before ending up a loser as Europe pulled off the "Miracle at Medinah."
rows.output: Furyk da kansa ya kasance a bangarorin biyu na waɗannan manyan juyin juya hali na ranar ƙarshe, kasancewa wani ɓangare na ƙungiyar da ta yi nasara a Brookline kafin ta zama wanda ya yi rashin nasara a lokacin da Turai ta yi "Aljanna a Medinah."
rows.reference: Furyk kansa ya kasance a kan iyakar wadannan manyan rukuni na baya-bayan nan, bayan kasancewa daya daga cikin 'yan wasan da suka lashe gasar a Brookline kafin su ci gaba da hasara yayin da Turai ta cire "Miracle a Madinah."

rows.source: "I remember every damn word of it," he said in reply to being asked how Ben Crenshaw, the captain in 1999, had rallied his players heading into the last day.
rows.output: "Na tuna kowace kalma ta duniya," ya ce a matsayin amsa ga tambayar yadda Ben Crenshaw, kyaftin a 1999, ya karfafa 'yan wasansa a ranar karshe.
rows.reference: "Ina tunawa da duk wani mummunar magana," in ji shi a amsa cewa ana tambayar shi yadda Ben Crenshaw, kyaftin din a shekarar 1999, ya haɗa 'yan wasansa zuwa ranar ƙarshe.

rows.source: "We have 12 important matches tomorrow, but you'd like to get off to that fast start like you saw at Brookline, like you saw at Medinah.
rows.output: "Mun samu wasanni 12 masu muhimmanci gobe, amma kina son samun saurin farawa kamar yadda kuka gani a Brookline, kamar yadda kuka gani a Medinah.
rows.reference: "Mu na da wasanni 12 gobe, amma kuma sai kun tashi fara zuwa da sauri kamar yadda kuka gani a Brookline, kamar yadda kuka gani a Medinah.

rows.source: When that momentum gets going one way, it puts a lot of pressure on those middle matches.
rows.output: Lokacin da wannan motsin ya fara tafiya ta hanya ɗaya, yana sanya babban matsi a kan waɗannan wasannin tsakiya.
rows.reference: Lokacin da damuwa ya shiga ta hanya ɗaya, yana sanya matsanancin matsa lamba a kan waɗannan wassanin tsakiyar.

rows.source: We set up our line-up accordingly and put the guys out in the fashion that we felt like, you know, we're trying to make some magic tomorrow."
rows.output: Mun tsara layinmu bisa ga haka kuma mun sanya mutanen a cikin tsarin da muka ji kamar, ka sani, muna ƙoƙarin yin sihiri gobe.
rows.reference: Mun kafa matakanmu bisa ga yadda ya kamata kuma muka sanya mutanen su cikin salon da muke so, kun sani, mu na ƙoƙarin yin bada mamaki a gobe. "

rows.source: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter the other Europeans in the top half of the order.
rows.output: An ba Thomas aikin gwada jagorantar yunkurin dawo da martaba, kuma yana fuskantar Rory McIlroy a cikin babban wasan, tare da Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood da Ian Poulter sauran 'yan Turai a cikin rabin sama na tsari.
rows.reference: An baiwa Thomas damar kokarin jagorancin Rory McIlroy a wasan sama tare da Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood da Ian Poulter da sauran 'yan Turai a cikin rabin sama a wannan tsarin.

rows.source: "I went with this group of guys in this order because I think it covers all the way through," said Bjorn of his singles selections.
rows.output: "Na tafi da wannan rukunin maza a wannan tsari domin ina ganin ya rufe dukkan hanyar," in ji Bjorn game da zaɓin sa na guda.
rows.reference: "Na tafi tare da wannan rukuni na mutane a cikin wannan tsari domin ina ganin yana rufe duk hanyar," in ji Bjorn na zabukansa.

rows.source: Germany's new warship postponed yet again
rows.output: Jirgin yaƙin Jamus na sabon zamani ya sake jinkirin
rows.reference: An sake jinkirta sabon jirgin yakin ruwa Jamus kuma

rows.source: German Navy's newest frigate should have been commissioned in 2014 to replace ageing Cold War-era warships, but it won't be there until at least the next year due to faulty systems and snowballing cost, local media reported.
rows.output: Jirgin ruwan sojojin Jamus na sabon gini ya kamata ya kasance a shekarar 2014 don maye gurbin tsofaffin jiragen yakin sanyi, amma ba zai kasance ba har sai a shekara mai zuwa saboda tsarin da ba su dace ba da kuma karuwar farashi, a cewar kafafen yada labarai na gida.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a kaddamar da sabon jirgin Sojin ruwan Jamus a shekarar 2014 don maye gurbin jiragen yaki tsofaffi Sanyi na zamani yaki. amma ba zai kasance ba har sai a kalla a shekara ta gaba saboda kuskuren tsarin da farashin dusar ƙanƙara, rahotanni na kafofin watsa labaru sun ruwaito.

rows.source: Commissioning of the "Rheinland-Pfalz," the lead ship of the brand new Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates, has now been postponed until the first half of 2019, according to Die Zeit newspaper citing a military spokesman.
rows.output: An dage shirin kaddamar da "Rheinland-Pfalz," wanda shine jirgin ruwa na farko a cikin sabuwar ajin Baden-Wuerttemberg, har zuwa rabin farkon shekarar 2019, a cewar jaridar Die Zeit, wanda ya ambaci wani jami'in soja.
rows.reference: Kadamar da Rheinland-Pfalz, wadda ke jagorantar sabon nauyin Baden-Wuerttemberg, yanzu an dakatar da shi har zuwa farkon rabin shekarar 2019, in ji wata sanarwa ta Die Zeit.

rows.source: The vessel should have joined the Navy in 2014, but the troubling post-delivery issues plagued the fate of the ambitious project.
rows.output: Jirgin ya kamata ya shiga rundunar sojojin ruwa a shekarar 2014, amma matsalolin da suka biyo bayan kammala aikin sun yi illa ga makomar aikin.
rows.reference: Ya kamata jirgin ya shiga Rundunar Sojan ruwa a shekarar 2014, amma matsalolin kamin kawowa ya tsaida da rabon zakulalen aikin.

rows.source: The four Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels the Navy ordered back in 2007 will come as replacement to the ageing Bremen-class frigates.
rows.output: Jiragen ruwa hudu na Baden-Wuerttemberg da Sojojin Ruwa suka umarce su a shekarar 2007 za su maye gurbin tsofaffin jiragen ruwa na Bremen.
rows.reference: Jiragen ruwa hudu na Baden-Wuerttemberg da Sojin ruwa suka bada salahun a 2007 zai zo ne a matsayin sauyi ga tsohon Bremen-class frigates.

rows.source: It is understood they will feature a powerful cannon, an array of anti-aircraft and anti-ship missiles as well as some stealth technologies, such as reduced radar, infrared and acoustic signatures.
rows.output: An fahimci cewa za su ƙunshi wani babban bindiga, jerin makaman anti-aircraft da anti-ship, da kuma wasu fasahohin sirri, kamar rage radar, infrared da sauti.
rows.reference: An fahimci cewa za su ƙunshi wata tashar wuta mai karfi, jigon kayan yaki na jiragen sama da na jirgin ruwa da wasu fasahar zamani, kamar rage radar, infrared da kuma sa hannun sauti.

rows.source: Other important features include longer maintenance periods - it should be possible to deploy the newest frigates for up to two years away from home ports.
rows.output: Sauran muhimman abubuwa sun hada da tsawon lokacin kula - ya kamata a iya tura sabbin jiragen ruwa na frigates har zuwa shekaru biyu daga tashoshin gida.
rows.reference: Wasu muhimman siffofi sun haɗa da tsawon lokaci na haɓakawa - ya kamata a yi amfani da sabon frigates har zuwa shekaru biyu daga tashoshin ruwan gida.

rows.source: However, continuous delays mean that the cutting-edge warships - said to allow Germany to project power overseas - will already become outdated by the time they enter service, Die Zeit notes.
rows.output: Duk da haka, jinkirin da ake yi na nufin cewa jiragen ruwa na zamani - wanda ake cewa suna ba Jamus damar yin tasiri a kasashen waje - za su riga sun zama tsofaffi kafin su shiga aiki, a cewar Die Zeit.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, kara jinkirin yana nuna ingancin jirgin yaƙin - wanda zai ba Jamus izinin malakar karfin yaki a saman teku - zasu zama sun fita yayi a lokacin da za su shiga hidima, bayanin Die Zeit.

rows.source: The ill-fated F125 frigate made headlines last year, when the German Navy officially refused to commission the vessel and returned it to Blohm & Voss shipyard in Hamburg.
rows.output: An yi wa jirgin ruwa na F125 baƙin ciki, lokacin da sojojin ruwa na Jamus suka ƙi karɓar jirgin a hukumance suka mayar da shi zuwa tashar jiragen ruwa ta Blohm & Voss a Hamburg.
rows.reference: Aibun F125 Frigate ya zama babban labari a shekarar bara, lokacin da jami’an sojin ruwa na Jamus suka ki kaddamar da jirgin kuma suka mayar da su zuwa wajen ajiyar Blohm & Voss a Hamburg.

rows.source: This was the first time the Navy has returned a ship to a shipbuilder after delivery.
rows.output: Wannan shi ne karon farko da Sojojin Ruwa suka dawo da jirgin ruwa zuwa masana'anta bayan an kai shi.
rows.reference: Wanna shi ne karin farka da Sojin ruwa zai mayar da jirgi zuwa ga mai gina shi bayan ya isar.

rows.source: Little was known about the reasons behind the return, but German media cited a number of crucial "software and hardware defects" that made the warship useless if deployed on a combat mission.
rows.output: Babu wani abu da aka sani game da dalilan dawowar, amma kafofin watsa labarai na Jamus sun ambaci wasu muhimman "kurakurai na software da kayan aiki" da suka sa jirgin ya zama maras amfani idan aka tura shi aikin yaki.
rows.reference: Kadan aka sani game da dalilan da suka sa aka mayar, amma kafofin watsa labaru na Jamus sun ba da labarin "lahani da manhaja" wanda suka sa jirgin yakin zai zame marar amfani idan an tura shi a aikin gwagwarmaya.

rows.source: Software deficiencies were particularly important as the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels will be operated by a crew of some 120 sailors - just half of the manpower on older Bremen class frigates.
rows.output: Rashin fasahar software ya kasance mai mahimmanci musamman yayin da jiragen ruwa na Baden-Wuerttemberg za a yi amfani da su ta hanyar ma'aikatan jirgin ruwa na kusan 120 - kawai rabin ma'aikatan jirgin ruwa na tsohuwar Bremen class frigates.
rows.reference: Karancin Manhaja ya kasance mai muhimmiyar muhimmanci kamar yadda ma'aikatan jirgin ruwa 120 na Baden-Wuerttemberg ke gudanar da su. Kusan rabin ma'aikatan tsohon Bremen class frigates.

rows.source: Also, it emerged that the ship is dramatically overweight which reduces its performance and limits the Navy's ability to add future upgrades.
rows.output: Haka kuma, ya bayyana cewa jirgin yana da nauyi sosai wanda ke rage aikinsa da kuma iyakance sojojin ruwa na iya kara inganta shi a nan gaba.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, ya bayyana cewa jirgin yana da nau’in mai nauyi wanda ya rage yin aikinsa kuma ya ƙayyade ikon sojin ruwa ingantawa na gaba.

rows.source: The 7,000-ton "Rheinland-Pfalz" is believed to be twice as heavy as similar-class ships used by the Germans in the Second World War.
rows.output: An yi imanin cewa jirgin ruwa mai nauyin tan 7,000 "Rheinland-Pfalz" ya ninka nauyin jiragen ruwa irin wannan da Jamus ta yi amfani da su a yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: An kiyasta cewa "Rheinland-Pfalz" na ton 7,000 "yana da nauyi a matsayin jiragen ruwa na irin wannan jirgi da Jamus ke amfani da ita a yakin duniya na biyu.

rows.source: Aside from faulty hardware, the price tag of the entire project - including the training of the crew - is also becoming an issue.
rows.output: Baya ga kayan aikin da ba su dace ba, farashin dukan aikin - ciki har da horar da ma'aikatan - kuma yana zama matsala.
rows.reference: Baya ga kayan aiki mara kyau, farashin dukan aikin - ciki har da horar da ma'aikatan - yana zama batun.

rows.source: It is said to have reached staggering €3.1billion ($3.6bn) - up from initial €2.2 billion.
rows.output: An ce ya kai kimanin Yuro miliyan 3.1 (dala miliyan 3.6) - wanda ya karu daga farkon Yuro miliyan 2.2.
rows.reference: An ce an kai kimanin dala biliyan €3.1 ($ 3.6bn) - daga farkon biliyan €2.2.

rows.source: Problems gripping the newest frigates become especially of importance in light of recent warnings that Germany's naval power is shrinking.
rows.output: Matsalolin da ke damun sabbin jiragen ruwa sun zama musamman masu muhimmanci a cikin hasashen da aka yi kwanan nan cewa karfin ruwan tekun Jamus yana raguwa.
rows.reference: Matsalolin da ke damun sabbin frigates sun zama mahimmanci a fagen gargadi na baya-bayan nan cewa ikon jiragen ruwa na Jamus yana raguwa.

rows.source: Earlier this year, Hans-Peter Bartels, chief of the German parliament's defense committee, acknowledged the Navy is actually "running out of deployment-capable ships."
rows.output: A farkon wannan shekarar, Hans-Peter Bartels, shugaban kwamitin tsaron majalisar dokokin Jamus, ya amince cewa jiragen ruwa na sojojin ruwa na "gudu da jiragen ruwa masu iya aiki."
rows.reference: Tun da farko wannan shekara, Hans-Peter Bartels, babban kwamandan kwamitin tsaro na kasar Jamus, ya amince da cewa jirgin ruwa na hakika yana "jiragen ruwa ya fara fita lokacin kaddamarwa na-jirage masu dama."

rows.source: The official said the issue has snowballed over time, because old ships were decommissioned but no replacement vessels were provided.
rows.output: Wani jami'in ya ce matsalar ta karu a tsawon lokaci, domin tsofaffin jiragen ruwa sun daina aiki amma ba a samar da sabbin jiragen ruwa ba.
rows.reference: Jami'in ya ce matsalar ta dusar ƙanƙara a kan lokaci, saboda an dakatar da manyan jiragen ruwa tsofaffi amma ba a ba a kawo masu mayewa ba.

rows.source: He lamented that none of the of the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates were able to join the Navy.
rows.output: Ya nuna damuwarsa cewa babu wani daga cikin jiragen ruwa na Baden-Wuerttemberg da ya samu damar shiga Rundunar Sojin Ruwa.
rows.reference: Ya yi baƙin ciki cewa babu wani daga cikin 'yan Baden-Wuerttemberg da suka shiga cikin jirgin ruwa.

rows.source: National Trust eavesdrops on secret life of bats
rows.output: Gidan Gidan Gida na Kasa yana sauraron rayuwar sirri na bats
rows.reference: Tarayya Aminci na leken asirin rayuwar jemagu

rows.source: New research being carried out at an estate in the Scottish Highlands aims to reveal how bats use the landscape in their hunt for food.
rows.output: Bincike da ake yi a wani gidauniya a cikin tsaunukan Scotland na neman bayyana yadda kwarangwal ke amfani da shimfidar wuri wajen neman abinci.
rows.reference: Sabon binciken da ake yi a wani yankin gidajen Sama na Scottish yana da manufa bayyana yadda jemagu suke amfani da wuri a cikin farauta don abinci.

rows.source: It is hoped the findings will shed new light on the behaviour of the unique flying mammals and help guide future conservation activities.
rows.output: Ana fatan binciken zai ba da haske kan halayen waɗannan dabbobi masu ban mamaki da kuma taimakawa wajen kula da su a nan gaba.
rows.reference: Ana fatan sakamakon binciken zai bayar da sabon haske game da halayyar mammals masu tashi da kuma taimakawa wajen jagorancin ayyukan kiyayewa na gaba.

rows.source: The study by scientists at the National Trust for Scotland will follow common and soprano pipistrelles as well as brown long-eared and Daubenton bats at Inverewe Gardens in Wester Ross.
rows.output: Wannan binciken da masana kimiyya a cikin National Trust for Scotland za su bi su ne na yau da kullun da soprano pipistrelles da kuma bats na brown long-eared da Daubenton a Inverewe Gardens a Wester Ross.
rows.reference: Masana binciken da masanan kimiyya suka yi a Tarrayan Aminci na Scotland za su bi na kullun da soprano pipistrelles tare da launin ruwan kasa da dogon-kunne da jamagen Daubenton a cikin Inverewe Gardens a Wester Ross.

rows.source: Special recorders will be placed at key locations around the property to track bat activities throughout the season.
rows.output: Ana sanya na'urorin rikodin na musamman a wurare masu mahimmanci a kusa da dukiya don bin diddigin ayyukan kwari a duk lokacin rani.
rows.reference: za’a sanya naurar daukar murya na musamman a wajeje daban a zagayen kayayyakin domin duba al’amorin jemagun a cikin dukkan kakan.

rows.source: NHS staff and volunteers will also carry out mobile surveys using hand-held detectors.
rows.output: Ma'aikatan NHS da masu aikin sa kai za su yi bincike ta hanyar amfani da na'urorin gano abubuwa masu nauyi.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatan NHS da masu sa kai za su kuma gudanar da bincike na wayar tafi-da-gidanka ta yin amfani da bincike na hannun.

rows.source: Expert sound analysis of all recordings will ascertain the frequency of the bat calls and which species are doing what.
rows.output: Binciken sauti na kwararru na duk rikodin zai tantance yawan kiran kwari da wane nau'in suke yi.
rows.reference: Sakamakon sautin daga kwararru na dukkan daukan muryan za su iya sa a gane yawan kiran jemagu kuma da abin da kowane jinsuna ke yi.

rows.source: A habitat map and report will then be produced to create a detailed landscape-scale picture of their behaviour.
rows.output: Za a samar da taswirar muhalli da rahoto don samar da cikakken hoto na yanayin muhalli.
rows.reference: Za a samar da taswira da rahoto na al'ada don ƙirƙirar hoto mai zurfi game da halin su.

rows.source: Rob Dewar, nature conservation adviser for NTS, hopes the results will reveal which areas of habitat are most important to the bats and how they are used by each of the species.
rows.output: Rob Dewar, mai ba da shawara kan kiyaye muhalli ga NTS, yana fatan sakamakon zai bayyana wane yanki na mazaunin ya fi muhimmanci ga kwari da yadda suke amfani da kowanne daga cikin jinsin.
rows.reference: Rob Dewar, mai ba da shawara game da yanayin na NTS, yana fatan sakamakon zai bayyana abin da yankunan zama mafi muhimmanci ga jemagui da kuma yadda suke amfani da kowannensu.

rows.source: This information will help determine the benefits of habitat management work such as meadow creation and how best to maintain woodlands for bats and other associated species.
rows.output: Wannan bayanin zai taimaka wajen tantance amfanin aikin sarrafa muhalli kamar ƙirƙirar ciyayi da kuma yadda ya fi dacewa a kula da dazuzzuka don kifin da sauran jinsunan da ke da alaƙa.
rows.reference: Wannan bayani zai taimaka wajen ƙayyade amfani da aikin gudanarwa na gida kamar aikin samar da kayan aiki da kuma yadda zai fi dacewa don kula da gandun daji na jemagu da wasu irin jinsuna su.

rows.source: Bat populations in Scotland and across the UK have declined considerably over the past century.
rows.output: Yawan jinsin bats a Scotland da sauran kasashen Burtaniya sun ragu sosai a cikin karni na baya.
rows.reference: Yawan jemagu a Scotland da wasu kasashen Bitaniya ya sauka sosai a cikin karni na baya.

rows.source: They are under threat from building and development work that affects roosts and loss of habitat.
rows.output: Suna cikin haɗari daga ayyukan gini da ci gaba da ke shafar gida da kuma asarar muhalli.
rows.reference: Su na cikin barazana daga gine-gine da aikin ci gaba da ke shafar hawaye da asarar wurin zama.

rows.source: Wind turbines and lighting can also pose a risk, as can flypapers and some chemical treatments of building materials, as well as attacks by pet cats.
rows.output: Motocin iska da haske ma na iya zama haɗari, kamar kuma takardun feshin jirgi da wasu magungunan sinadarai na kayan gini, da kuma hare-haren da kyanwa ke yi.
rows.reference: Hasken iska da hasken lantarki na iya haifar da haɗari, kamar yadda jaridu da wasu magungunan sunadarai na kayan gine-gine suke yi, da kuma hare-haren daga dabba gida maguna.

rows.source: Bats are not actually blind.
rows.output: Kwari ba su da makanta da gaske.
rows.reference: Gaskiyar shi ne jemgai ba makafai bane.

rows.source: However, due to their nocturnal hunting habits their ears are more useful than their eyes when it comes to catching prey.
rows.output: Duk da haka, saboda halayen farautarsu na dare, idanunsu sun fi amfani da idanunsu wajen kama farauta.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, saboda halin su na farautan dare kunnuwan su sun fi amfani bisa ga idanuwansu idan yazo batun kama nama.

rows.source: They use a sophisticated echo-location technique to pinpoint bugs and obstacles in their flight path.
rows.output: Suna amfani da fasahar kewayawa mai sarƙaƙiya don gano kwari da cikas a hanyarsu ta tashi.
rows.reference: Su na amfani da haddaden tsarin sauraren sautin wuri da gano kwari da abubuwan dake tashe hanyar su.

rows.source: The NTS, which is responsible for the care of more than 270 historical buildings, 38 important gardens and 76,000 hectares of land around the country, takes bats very seriously.
rows.output: Sashen NTS, wanda ke da alhakin kula da fiye da gine-gine na tarihi 270, lambuna masu mahimmanci 38, da kuma hekta 76,000 na fili a kusa da kasar, yana daukar jirgin sama da muhimmanci sosai.
rows.reference: NTS, waɗanda ke da nauyin kiyaye fiye da gidanjen tarii 270, lambuna masu amfani 38 da kadada 76,000 na fili a cikin kasar, su na daukan jemage da matukan mahimmanci.

rows.source: It has ten trained experts, who regularly carry out surveys, roost inspections and sometimes rescues.
rows.output: Tana da masu horarwa goma, waɗanda ke yin bincike akai-akai, duba gida, kuma wani lokaci suna ceto.
rows.reference: Yana da kwarraru goma, masu yawan yin bincike, dibin tarin gidajen jemagai da kuma ceto wani lokaci.

rows.source: The organisation has even set up Scotland's first and only dedicated bat reserve at Threave estate in Dumfries and Galloway, which is home to eight of Scotland's ten bat species.
rows.output: Kungiyar ta kafa ma'aunin kawai a Scotland don kare jinsunan da ke cikin gidan Threave a Dumfries da Galloway, wanda ke da gidaje na jinsunan da ke cikin gidan Scotland goma.
rows.reference: Masana’antar ta ma bude gidan ajiyar jemagai kawai na farko a Scotland a Dukiyar Threave dake Dumfires da Galloway, wanda ke da jinsi jemagai 8 daga cikin goma na Scotland.

rows.source: Estate manager David Thompson says the estate is the ideal territory for them.
rows.output: Manajan gida David Thompson ya ce gidan yana da kyau ga su.
rows.reference: Manajan Dukiyar David Thompson yace dukiyar na yanki mafi dacewa masu.

rows.source: "Here at Threave we have a great area for bats," he said.
rows.output: "A nan a Threave muna da babban yanki na kwari," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Nan a Threave mu na da kyakkyawan yanki wa jemagai,” yace.

rows.source: "We've got the old buildings, lots of veteran trees and all the good habitat.
rows.output: "Muna da tsofaffin gine-gine, da yawa daga cikin bishiyoyin da suka dade da kuma dukkan wuraren da suka dace.
rows.reference: “Mu na da tsofaffin gidaje, tsoffafin itace da kuma mazauni mai kyau.

rows.source: But there is much about bats that is still unknown, so the work we do here and at other properties will help us understand more about what they need to thrive."
rows.output: Amma akwai abubuwa da yawa game da kwari da ba a sani ba, don haka aikin da muke yi a nan da sauran kadarori zai taimaka mana mu fahimci abin da suke bukata don bunƙasa."
rows.reference: Amma akwai abubuwa da yawa akan jemagai da ba a sani ba, saboda haka ayyukan da muke yi akan wannan dukiyar zai taimake mu wajen gane wasu abubuwa da suke bukata dan su bunƙasa.”

rows.source: He stresses the importance of checking for bats before carrying out maintenance within properties as it is possible unwitting destruction of a single maternity roost could kill up to 400 females and young, possibly wiping out an entire local population.
rows.output: Ya jaddada mahimmancin duba gizo-gizon kafin a fara gyara a cikin kadarori domin yana yiwuwa a lalata wani gizo-gizo na uwa ta hanyar rashin sani, wanda zai iya kashe mata da jarirai har zuwa 400, wanda zai iya kawo cikas ga dukkan al'ummar yankin.
rows.reference: Ya jaddada mahimmanci diba jenmagan kafin a yi aikin kulawa da dukiyar tunda yana yiyuwa rusa tarin gidan matan zai iya kai ga mutuwan har matan su da yaran su 400, wanda zai iya yiyuwar shafe gaba ki daya yawan tsuntsayen yankin.

rows.source: Bats are protected and it is illegal to kill, harass or disturb them or destroy their roosts.
rows.output: Ana kare bats kuma yana da haramun kashe su, su yi musu tsawa ko kuma su lalata gidajensu.
rows.reference: Ana kiyaye jemagai dan haka bai hallatta a kashe su, tayar masu da hankali ko damuwar su ko rigiza gidajen su ba.

rows.source: Elisabeth Ferrell, Scottish officer for the Bat Conservation Trust, has encouraged the public to pitch in to help.
rows.output: Elisabeth Ferrell, jami'ar Scotland a cikin Bat Conservation Trust, ta ƙarfafa jama'a su shiga don taimakawa.
rows.reference: Elisabeth Ferrel, Jami’ar Scotland ta Ma’aikatar Kula da Jemage, ta nemi goyon bayan mutane su hada gwiwa wurin taimakawa.

rows.source: She said: "We still have a lot to learn about our bats and for many of our species we just don't know how their populations are faring."
rows.output: Ta ce: "Har yanzu muna da abubuwa da yawa da za mu koya game da kwari da kuma yadda yawancin jinsinmu suke yi."
rows.reference: Ta ce: “Mu na da abubuwa da yawa da zamu koya akan jemagai da kuma jinsunan su masu yawa kwai bamu san yadda yanayin yawan su yake ba.”

rows.source: Ronaldo dismisses rape claims as lawyers set to sue German magazine
rows.output: Ronaldo ya yi watsi da zargin fyade, yayin da lauyoyi suka shirya kai karar mujallar Jamus.
rows.reference: Ronaldo yayi watsi da ikirarin fyaɗe a yayin da lauyoyi suke shirin su kai ƙarar mujallar Jamus.

rows.source: Cristiano Ronaldo has branded rape claims against him as "fake news," saying that people "want to promote themselves" by using his name.
rows.output: Cristiano Ronaldo ya kira da a yi watsi da zargin fyade da ake yi masa da cewa "labaran karya ne," yana mai cewa mutane "suna son su inganta kansu" ta hanyar amfani da sunansa.
rows.reference: Cristiano Ronaldo yayi kira da ikirarin da aka mashi akan fyaɗe akan “labarun ƙarya”, yana cewa mutane “su na so su inganta kansu” ta hanyar amfani da sunan shi.

rows.source: His lawyers are set to sue German news magazine Der Spiegel, which published the allegations.
rows.output: Lauyoyinsa suna shirin gurfanar da mujallar labarai ta Jamus Der Spiegel, wadda ta buga zargin.
rows.reference: Lauyoyin shi su na shirin kai ƙarar mujallar Jamus Der Spiegel, wanda suka buga zargin.

rows.source: The Portugal and Juventus forward has been accused of raping an American woman, named as Kathryn Mayorga, in a Las Vegas hotel room in 2009.
rows.output: An zarge ta da laifin fyade wata mata 'yar Amurka mai suna Kathryn Mayorga, a dakin otal a Las Vegas a shekarar 2009.
rows.reference: An zargi dan wasan gaban na Portugal da Juventus da yi wa wata mata ‘yar Amurka fyaɗe, mai suna Kathryn Mayorga, a wani dakin otel na Las Vegas a 2009.

rows.source: He is alleged to have then paid her $375,000 to keep quiet about the incident, Der Spiegel reported on Friday.
rows.output: An zarge shi da ya biya ta dala 375,000 domin ta yi shiru kan lamarin, Der Spiegel ta ruwaito a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Ana zargin cewa bayan haka ya biya ta dala 375,000 dan ta rufe bakin ta akan abun, Der Spiegel sun yi rihoto ranar Jumma’a.

rows.source: Speaking in an Instagram Live video to his 142 million followers hours after the claims were reported, Ronaldo, 33, slammed the reports as "fake news."
rows.output: A yayin wani bidiyo na Instagram Live da ya yi wa magoya bayansa miliyan 142, sa'o'i kadan bayan an ruwaito ikirarin, Ronaldo mai shekaru 33, ya yi watsi da ikirarin a matsayin "labaran karya."
rows.reference: A lokacin da yake magana ta hanyar bidiyon shi ta Instagram da masu bin shi Miliyan 142 sa’o’i bayan an yi rihoton ikirarin, Ronaldo, 33, yayi watsi da rihoton matsayin “labarin karya”

rows.source: "No, no, no, no , no.
rows.output: "A'a, a'a, a'a, a'a, a'a.
rows.reference: “A’a, a’a, a’a, a’a, a’a.

rows.source: What they said today, fake news," the five-time Ballon d'Or winner says into the camera.
rows.output: Abin da suka faɗa a yau, labaran ƙarya ne," in ji wanda ya lashe kyautar Ballon d'Or sau biyar a cikin kyamarar.
rows.reference: abun da suka ce yau, labarin karya ne,” maciyin Ballon d’Or biyar din yace a cikin kamarar.

rows.source: "They want to promote themselves by using my name.
rows.output: "Suna son su bada kansu ta hanyar amfani da sunana.
rows.reference: “Su na so su inganta kansu ta hanyar amfani da suna na.

rows.source: It's normal.
rows.output: Yana da kyau.
rows.reference: Hakan daidai ne.

rows.source: They want to be famous to say my name, but it is part of the job.
rows.output: Suna son a san su da sunan, amma wani bangare ne na aikin.
rows.reference: Su na so su yi suna ta hanyar ambaton suna na, amma yana cikin aikin.

rows.source: I am a happy man and all good," the player added, smiling.
rows.output: Ni mutum ne mai farin ciki kuma duk abin da ya dace," ɗan wasan ya ƙara, yana murmushi.
rows.reference: “Ni mutun ne dake cikin kwanciyar hankali kuma komai kalau,” dan wasan ya ƙara, yana murmushi.

rows.source: Ronaldo's lawyers are preparing to sue Der Spiegel over the allegations, which they have called "an inadmissible reporting of suspicions in the area of privacy," according to Reuters.
rows.output: Lauyoyin Ronaldo suna shirin ɗaukar matakin shari'a kan Der Spiegel dangane da zargin, wanda suka kira "rabe-raben bayanai a fannin sirri," a cewar Reuters.
rows.reference: Lauyoyi masu kare Ronaldo su na shirin su kai ƙarar Der Spiegel akan zargin, wanda suka kira “Rihoton da bashi da hujja akan zargi ta yankin sirri,” bisa ga Reuters.

rows.source: Lawyer Christian Schertz said the player would seek compensation for "moral damages in an amount corresponding to the gravity of the infringement, which is probably one of the most serious violations of personal rights in recent years."
rows.output: Lauyan Christian Schertz ya ce dan wasan zai nemi diyya saboda "lalacewar ɗabi'a a cikin adadin da ya dace da girman laifin, wanda watakila ɗaya ne daga cikin manyan laifuffukan sirri a cikin 'yan shekarun nan."
rows.reference: Lawyer Christian Schertz ya ce dan wasan zai nemi cin tara akan “ɓata masa halaye na dabi'a, a cikin adadin da ya dace da nauyin laifin, wanda yakan iya zama mafi tsananin cin zarafin haƙin ɗan adam a cikin shekarun nan.”

rows.source: The alleged incident is said to have taken place in June 2009 at a suite at the Palms Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.
rows.output: An yi zargin cewa an yi wannan lamari ne a watan Yuni 2009 a wani daki a otal din Palms Hotel da Casino a Las Vegas.
rows.reference: Zargin ana cewa wai ya faru ne a Yuni 2009 a wani babban ɗaki na Palm Otel and Casino a Las Vegas.

rows.source: After meeting in a nightclub, Ronaldo and Mayorga reportedly went back to the player's room, where he allegedly anally raped her, according to papers filed at Clark County District Court in Nevada.
rows.output: Bayan haduwa da wani kulob na dare, Ronaldo da Mayorga an ruwaito sun koma dakin dan wasan, inda ake zargin ya yi mata fyade, kamar yadda takardun da aka shigar a kotun Clark County District a Nevada.
rows.reference: Bayan sun hadu a wani gidan wasan kwaikwayo na dare, Ronaldo da Mayorga wai sun koma dakin dan wasan, wurin da a zargin ya mata fyaɗe a duburi, bisa ga takardun da aka saka a fayil ɗin dake Kotun Gundumar Clark a Nevada.

rows.source: Mayorga claims Ronaldo fell to his knees after the alleged incident and told her he was "99 percent" a "good guy" let down by the "one percent."
rows.output: Mayorga ta yi iƙirarin cewa Ronaldo ya faɗi a ƙafafunsa bayan abin da ake zargin ya faru kuma ya gaya mata cewa "99 cikin ɗari" "mutumin kirki" ya fadi saboda "ɗaya cikin ɗari."
rows.reference: Mayorga tayi ikirari cewa Ronaldo ya faɗi akan gwiwan shi bayan hakan kuma ya ce mata “kashi 99” “mutumin kirki” wanda ke samun akasi daga “kashi ɗaya”.

rows.source: The documents claim that Ronaldo confirmed the pair had sex, but that it was consensual.
rows.output: Takardun sun yi iƙirarin cewa Ronaldo ya tabbatar da cewa ma'auratan sun yi jima'i, amma ya ce an yi hakan ne da yardar kai.
rows.reference: Takardur su na ikirari cewa Ronaldo ya gasganta cewa su biu sun yi jima’i, amma cikin yarjejeniya ce.

rows.source: Mayorga also claims she went to the police and had photographs taken of her injuries at a hospital, but later agreed to an out-of-court settlement because she felt "terrified of retaliation" and was worried about "being publicly humiliated."
rows.output: Mayorga ta yi iƙirarin cewa ta je ofishin 'yan sanda ta kuma yi hoton raunin da ta samu a asibiti, amma daga baya ta amince da sulhu a wajen kotu saboda ta ji "tsoron ramuwar gayya" kuma tana jin tsoron "zama a bainar jama'a."
rows.reference: Mayorga kuma tayi ikirari cewa ta je wajen ‘yan sanda kuma an ɗauki hotunan raunin da ta ji a asibit, amma daga baya ta yadda da sulhu a wajen kotu saboda ta ji “tsoron ramuwa” kuma ta damu akan “dizguwa a fuskar mutane.”

rows.source: The 34-year-old says she is now seeking to overturn the settlement as she continues to be traumatized by the alleged incident.
rows.output: Matar mai shekaru 34 ta ce yanzu tana neman a soke yarjejeniyar da aka yi mata yayin da take ci gaba da jin tsoro da damuwa daga lamarin da ake zargin.
rows.reference: Yar shekara 34 ɗn yanzu tana neman juya sulhun a yayin da ta ci gaba da fuskantar kunci daga abun da ya farun.

rows.source: Ronaldo was on the verge of joining Real Madrid from Manchester United at the time of the alleged assault, and this summer moved to Italian giants Juve in a €100 million deal.
rows.output: Ronaldo yana gab da shiga Real Madrid daga Manchester United a lokacin da ake zargin cin zarafi, kuma a wannan lokacin ya koma manyan kungiyoyin Italiya Juve kan kudi miliyan €100.
rows.reference: Ronaldo yana kan komawa Real Madrid daga Manchester United a lokacin da farmakin da ake zargin ya faru, kuma wannan ranin ya koma babban kungiyar kwallon Italia Juventus a yarjejeniyar Yuro miliyan100.

rows.source: Brexit: UK 'would forever regret' losing carmakers
rows.output: Brexit: Birtaniya za ta yi nadama har abada idan ta rasa masana'antar kera motoci
rows.reference: Brexit: UK ‘har abada zata yi da na sanin’ rasa masu kera motoci

rows.source: The UK "would regret it forever" if it lost its status as a world leader in car manufacturing after Brexit, Business Secretary Greg Clark has said.
rows.output: Birtaniya za ta yi nadama har abada idan ta rasa matsayinta na jagora a masana'antar kera motoci a duniya bayan Brexit, in ji Sakataren Harkokin Kasuwanci Greg Clark.
rows.reference: UK “zata yi da na sanin shi har abada” idan tayi rashin matsayin ta na shugabancin kera mota bayan Brexit, Sakataren Sana’a Greg Clark yace.

rows.source: He added it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.
rows.output: Ya kara da cewa yana da "damuwa" cewa Toyota UK ta gaya wa BBC cewa idan Birtaniya ta bar EU ba tare da yarjejeniya ba, za ta dakatar da samar da kayayyaki na wucin gadi a masana'antar ta a Burnaston, kusa da Derby.
rows.reference: Ya kara cewa abun “damuwa ne” cewa Toyota UK ta fada wa BBC cewa idan Britain ta fita EU ba tare da yarjejeniya ba zata sayar da aiki na dan wani lokaci a masana’antar ta a Burnaston, kusa da Derby.

rows.source: "We need a deal," Mr Clark said.
rows.output: "Muna buƙatar yarjejeniya," Mista Clark ya ce.
rows.reference: “Mu na bukatar yarjejeniya,” Mr Clark ya ce.

rows.source: The Japanese carmaker said the impact of border delays in the event of a no-deal Brexit could cost jobs.
rows.output: Masana'antar motocin Japan sun ce tasirin jinkirin iyaka a lokacin da ba a samu yarjejeniya kan Brexit ba na iya haifar da asarar ayyuka.
rows.reference: Kamfanin Japan din na mota yace tasirin jinkiri a iyakar kasa a yanayin Brexit babu yarjejeniya zai iya kwao rasa ayyuka.

rows.source: The Burnaston plant - which makes Toyota's Auris and Avensis - produced nearly 150,000 cars last year of which 90% were exported to the rest of the European Union.
rows.output: Masana'antar Burnaston - wadda ke kera motocin Toyota Auris da Avensis - ta samar da kusan motoci 150,000 a shekarar da ta gabata, daga cikinsu kashi 90% an fitar da su zuwa sauran kasashen Tarayyar Turai.
rows.reference: Masana’antar Burnaston din - wanda ke hada Toyota Auris da Avensis - sun kera kusan motoci 150,000 bara wanda a ciki kashi 90 aka fitar zuwa sauran kasashen Turai.

rows.source: "My view is that if Britain crashes out of the EU at the end of March we will see production stops in our factory," said Marvin Cooke, Toyota's managing director at Burnaston.
rows.output: "Ra'ayina shi ne cewa idan Birtaniya ta fadi daga EU a karshen watan Maris, za mu ga dakatar da samarwa a masana'antar mu," in ji Marvin Cooke, darektan gudanarwa na Toyota a Burnaston.
rows.reference: “A gani na shi ne idan Britain ta fita EU a karshen Maris zamu ga sayawar kira a masana;antar mu,” inji Mavin Cooke, Manajin Direkta na Toyota a Burnaston.

rows.source: Other UK car manufacturers have raised fears about leaving the EU without agreement on how cross-border trade will function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.output: Sauran masu kera motoci a Birtaniya sun bayyana damuwarsu game da barin Tarayyar Turai ba tare da yarjejeniya kan yadda cinikin kan iyaka zai yi ba, ciki har da Honda, BMW, da Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.reference: Wasu masu kera motocin UK sun nuna jin tsoro akan fita EU ba tare da yarjejniya ba akan yadda kasuwancin tsallaken iyaka zai kasance, har da Honda, BMW da Jaguar Land Rover.

rows.source: BMW, for example, says it will close its Mini plant in Oxford for a month following Brexit.
rows.output: BMW, misali, ta ce za ta rufe masana'antar Mini a Oxford na wata guda bayan Brexit.
rows.reference: BMW, kamar misali, ta ce zata kulle karamin masana’antar ta da ke Oxford na tsawon wata daya bayan Brexit.

rows.source: The main concerns relate to what carmakers say are supply chain risks in the event of a no-deal Brexit.
rows.output: Muhimman damuwar sun shafi abin da masana'antun motoci ke cewa hadarin sarkar samar da kayayyaki a lokacin da ba a samu yarjejeniya kan Brexit ba.
rows.reference: Babban damuwan yana dangance da abun da makera motoci suka ce ne dangane da hadarin samun kayayyakin aiki idan akayi Brexit ba yarjejeniya.

rows.source: Toyota's production line is run on a "just-in-time" basis, with parts arriving every 37 minutes from suppliers in both the UK and the EU for cars made to order.
rows.output: Layin samar da Toyota yana gudana ne bisa tsarin "just-in-time", inda sassa ke zuwa kowane minti 37 daga masu samar da kayayyaki a cikin Birtaniya da EU don motocin da aka yi oda.
rows.reference: Ana aiwatar da hanyar sarrafawar Toyota na akan tsarin “gab-da-lokaci”, yadda sassa su na isowa ko wani minti 37 daga masu kaya duk daga UK da EU na motocin da ake kira dan sari.

rows.source: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be disruption at the border which the industry says could lead to delays and shortages of parts.
rows.output: Idan Birtaniya ta bar Tarayyar Turai ba tare da yarjejeniya ba a ranar 29 ga Maris, akwai yiwuwar samun cikas a kan iyakar da masana'antar ke cewa zai iya haifar da jinkiri da karancin sassa.
rows.reference: Idan UK ta bar EU ba tare dayarjejeniya ba ranar 29 ga watan Maris, za’a iya samun matsaloli a iyaka wanda masana’antar ta ce yakan iya kawo jinkiri da rashin isashen sassa.

rows.source: It would be impossible for Toyota to hold more than a day's worth of inventory at its Derbyshire plant, the company said, and so production would be stopped.
rows.output: Ba zai yiwu Toyota ta rike fiye da kwanaki guda na ajiyar kaya a masana'antar Derbyshire ba, a cewar kamfanin, kuma don haka za a daina samarwa.
rows.reference: Ba zai yiyu Toyota ta rike fiye da kayan aiki na kwana daya a masana’antar ta na Derbyshire, kamfanin ta ce, dan haka aiki zai saya.

rows.source: Mr Clark said Theresa May's Chequers plan for future relations with the EU is "precisely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border."
rows.output: Mista Clark ya ce shirin Chequers na Theresa May na dangantaka da EU a nan gaba "an tsara shi da kyau don kauce wa wadannan duban a kan iyaka."
rows.reference: Mr Clark ya ce tsarin binciken Theresa May na dagantakan gaba da EU an “asalin tsara shi dan kauyce wa wadannan binciken a iyaka.”

rows.source: "We need to have a deal. We want to have the best deal that will allow as I say not just the success at present to be enjoyed but for us to grasp this opportunity," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.
rows.output: "Muna buƙatar samun yarjejeniya. Muna son samun mafi kyawun yarjejeniya da za ta ba mu damar, kamar yadda na ce ba kawai samun nasara a yanzu ba, amma don mu ɗauki wannan damar," ya gaya wa BBC Radio 4's Today program.
rows.reference: “Mu na bukatar mu samu yarjejeniya. Mu na so mu samu mafi kyakkyawan yarjejeniya da zai bamu daman kamar yadda na fada ba kawai nasaran da zamu ji dadin shi a halin yanzu ba amma mu samu yin amfani da wannan daman,” ya fada a tsarin Yau na Radiyon BBC 4.

rows.source: "The evidence from not just Toyota but other manufacturers is that we need to absolutely be able to continue what has been a highly successful set of supply chains."
rows.output: "Shaidar da ba ta fito daga Toyota kadai ba, amma daga sauran masana'antun, ita ce cewa dole ne mu ci gaba da abin da ya kasance wani shiri mai nasara na samar da kayayyaki."
rows.reference: “Hujjan da ba na Toyota ba kawai amma har da na wasu makera shi ne mu na asalin bukatar mu ci gaba da abun da yake nasarraren samar da kayaki.”

rows.source: Toyota was unable to say how long production would be stopped, but in the longer term, warned that added costs would reduce the plant's competitiveness and eventually cost jobs.
rows.output: Toyota ba zai iya cewa tsawon lokacin da ake dakatar da samarwa ba, amma a cikin dogon lokaci, ya yi gargadin cewa karin kudade za su rage gasar gasar da masana'antar ke da shi kuma a karshe za su yi asarar ayyuka.
rows.reference: Toyota ta kasa fadan tsawon lokacin da za a sayar da aiki, amma a hangen gaba, sun bada gargadin cewa farashi zai rage karfin gasar masana’antar kuma hakan zai kai ga asarar ayyuka.

rows.source: Peter Tsouvallaris, who has worked at Burnaston for 24 years and is the Unite union convenor at the plant, said his members are increasingly concerned: "In my experience once these jobs go they never come back.
rows.output: Pita Tsouvallaris, wanda ya yi aiki a Burnaston na shekaru 24 kuma shugaban kungiyar kwadago ta Unite ne a masana'antar, ya ce mambobinsa suna kara damuwa: "A cikin kwarewata, da zarar wadannan ayyukan sun tafi, ba su dawo ba.
rows.reference: Peter Tsouvallaris, wanda yayi aiki a Burnaston na tsawon shekaru 24 kuma shi ne kakakin kungiyar hadin kai a masana’antar, yace mambobin su na ci gaba da damuwa: “A cikin kwarewata da zaran wadannan ayyukan sun tafi ba sa taba dawowa.

rows.source: A government spokesperson said: "We have put forward a precise and credible plan for our future relationship with the EU."
rows.output: Wani mai magana da yawun gwamnati ya ce: "Mun gabatar da wani tsari mai kyau da kuma gaskiya game da dangantakarmu ta gaba da EU."
rows.reference: Wani kakakin gwamnati ya ce: “Mun mika tsarin daidai kuma na gaskiya don alakar mu ta gaba da EU.”

rows.source: Trump meeting with Rosenstein may be delayed again, says White House
rows.output: Taron Trump da Rosenstain na iya jinkirin sake jinkiri, in ji fadar White House
rows.reference: Haduwar Trump da Rosenstein zai iya samun jinkiri kuma, inji White House

rows.source: Donald Trump's high-stakes meeting with deputy attorney general Rod Rosenstein could be "pushed back another week" as the fight over supreme court nominee Brett Kavanaugh continues, the White House said on Sunday.
