rows.output: N'akwụkwọ ozi nke Medium bipụtara na Satọde, Berners-Lee dere na Inrupt's "ọrụ bụ inye ike azụmahịa na gburugburu ebe obibi iji nyere aka chebe ịdị mma na ịdị mma nke webụ ọhụrụ a na-ewu na Solid."
rows.reference: Na mbipụta emere na Medium na Satọde, Berners-Lee dere na “ebumnuche Inrupt bụ inye ike azụmahịa na gburugburu inyere aka chekwaa ntụkwasị obi na ịdị mma weebu ọhụrụ ahụ arụrụ na Solid.”

rows.source: In 1994, Berners-Lee transformed the Internet when he established the World Wide Web Consortium at Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
rows.output: N'afọ 1994, Berners-Lee gbanwere Ịntanetị mgbe ọ guzobere World Wide Web Consortium na Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
rows.reference: Na 1994, Berners-Lee gbanwere Ịntanetị mgbe ọ mepụtara World Wide Web Consortuim na Massachusetts Institue of Technology.

rows.source: In recent months, Berners-Lee has been an influential voice in the net neutrality debate.
rows.output: N'ime ọnwa ndị na-adịbeghị anya, Berners-Lee enweela olu na-emetụta arụmụka banyere nnwere onwe nke ịntanetị.
rows.reference: N’ọnwa ndị adịbeghị anya, Berners-Lee bụ olu na-ada ụda na arụmarụ ụka nnwere onwe ọrụ ịntanetị.

rows.source: Even while launching Inrupt, Berners-Lee will remain the Founder and Director of World Wide Web Consortium, the Web Foundation and the Open Data Institute.
rows.output: Ọbụna mgbe ọ na-ewepụta Inrupt, Berners-Lee ga-anọ onye guzobere na onye nduzi nke World Wide Web Consortium, Web Foundation na Open Data Institute.
rows.reference: Ọbulagodi mgbe a na-ebuputa Inrupt, Berners-Lee ga-anọrọ dịka onye Mmepụta na Onye Isi nke World Wide Web Consortuim, Web Foundation na Open Data Institute.

rows.source: "I'm incredibly optimistic for this next era of the web," Berners-Lee added.
rows.output: "Ana m enwe obi ụtọ nke ukwuu maka oge ọhụrụ a nke webụ," Berners-Lee gbakwụnyere.
rows.reference: “A na m enwe olile anya nke ukwuu maka oge na-abịa n’ihu nke weebu,” Berners-Lee gbakwunyere.

rows.source: Bernard Vann: WW1 Victoria Cross cleric celebrated
rows.output: Bernard Vann: Onye ụkọchukwu nke mmeri Victoria Cross n'oge Agha Ụwa Mbụ
rows.reference: Bernard Vann: Emere emume onye ụkọchukwu Victoria Cross WW1

rows.source: The only Church of England cleric to win a Victoria Cross during World War One as a combatant has been celebrated in his hometown 100 years on.
rows.output: Onye ụkọchukwu Church of England naanị ya meriri Cross Victoria n'oge Agha Ụwa Mbụ dị ka onye agha ka a na-eme ememe n'obodo ya afọ 100 ka e mesịrị.
rows.reference: Emeela emume nke naanị ụkọchukwu Church of England nwetara mmeri Victoria Cross n’oge World War One dị ka onye agha n’obodo ya ka afọ gbara 100.

rows.source: Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann won the award on 29 September 1918 in the attack at Bellenglise and Lehaucourt.
rows.output: Onye isi ọchịagha Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann nwetara ihe nrite ahụ na 29 Septemba 1918 n'oge mwakpo a wakporo Bellenglise na Lehaucourt.
rows.reference: Lt Col Ụkọchukwu Bernard Vann nwetara awọdụ na 29, Septemba 1918 na mbuso agha emere na Bellenglise na Lehaucourt.

rows.source: However, he was killed by a sniper four days later and never knew he had won the highest British military honour.
rows.output: Ọbụna, e gburu ya site n'aka onye na-egbu ndị mmadụ n'ime ụbọchị anọ ka e mesịrị, ọ dịghịkwa ama na ọ meriri onyinye agha kachasị elu nke ndị Bekee.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, mgbọ ọkaibe n’ịgba egbe tụrụ ya ka ụbọchị anọ gachara na ọ maghị ncha ncha na etubere ya ugo ndị agha kachasị na Britain.

rows.source: A commemorative stone was unveiled by his two grandsons at a parade in Rushden, Northamptonshire, on Saturday.
rows.output: A na-eme ememe nkume ka ewepụtara site n'aka ụmụ nwa ya nwoke abụọ n'oge ọgba aghara na Rushden, Northamptonshire, na Satọde.
rows.reference: Ụmụ ụmụ ya ndị nwoke abụọ kpughere okwute iji na-eme ncheta ya na ngarube emere na Rushden, Northamptonshire, na Satọde.

rows.source: One of his grandsons, Michael Vann, said it was "brilliantly symbolic" the stone would be revealed exactly 100 years on from his grandfather's award-winning feat.
rows.output: Otu n'ime ụmụ nwa nwa ya nwoke, Michael Vann, kwuru na ọ bụ "ihe atụ nke ọma" na a ga-ekpughe nkume ahụ kpọmkwem afọ 100 ka ihe nna nna ya rụpụtara merie.
rows.reference: Otu n’ime nwa nwa ya Michael Vann, kwuru na ọ bụ “ihe nrịbama pụrụ iche nke ukwuu” na a ga-ekpughe okwute ahụ ka afọ gbara 100 kpọmkwem site na mgbe nna ya ochie kpara ike o jiri nweta awọdụ.

rows.source: According to the London Gazette, on 29 September 1918 Lt Col Vann led his battalion across the Canal de Saint-Quentin "through a very thick fog and under heavy fire from field and machine guns."
rows.output: N'ime akwụkwọ akụkọ London Gazette, na 29 Septemba 1918, Lt Col Vann duuru ndị ọchịagha ya n'ofe Canal de Saint-Quentin "site na nnukwu ọchịchịrị na ọkụ ọkụ site na ubi na igwe igwe."
rows.reference: Dabere na London Gazette, na 29 Septemba 1918 Lt Col Vann kpọọrọ ndị otu agha ya gafee Canal de Saint-Quentin “n’etiti urukpuru ojii yana n’ime nnukwu ọkụ ọgbụgba sitere na ama yana egbe.”

rows.source: He later rushed up to the firing line and with the "greatest gallantry" led the line forward before rushing a field-gun single-handed and knocked out three of the detachment.
rows.output: Mgbe e mesịrị, ọ gbagoro n'ahịrị ọkụ ma duzie ahịrị ahụ n'ihu tupu ọ gbaa ọkụ ọkụ n'otu aka ma kwatuo mmadụ atọ n'ime ndị ọrụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọ mechara gbara ọsọ gbabanye na ndị na-akwa mgbọ ma “kpaa ike ọkpara” duru ahịrị na-aga ihu tupu ọ chụrụ egbe naanị ya were kụpụ mmadụ ndị agha atọ nọpụrụ iche.

rows.source: Lt Col Vann was killed by a German sniper on 4 October 1918 - just over a month before the war ended.
rows.output: Mgbe ụbọchị anọ nke ọnwa Ọktoba afọ 1918, a gburu Lt Col Vann site n'aka onye na-egbu ndị Jamanị.
rows.reference: Onye ọkaibe n’ịgba egbe nke Germany gburu Lt Col Vann na 4 Oktoba 1918 - naanị otu ọnwa tupu agha akwụsị.

rows.source: Michael Vann, 72, said his grandfather's actions were "something that I know that I could never live up to but something which is humbling."
rows.output: Michael Vann, 72, kwuru na ihe nna nna ya mere "ihe bụ ihe m maara na enweghị m ike ịdị ndụ, mana ihe na-eme ka obi sie m ike."
rows.reference: Michael Vann, 72 kwuru na omume nna ya ochie mere “bụ ihe ọ maara na ya agaghị emenwu ma ncha mana ọ bụ ihe na-eme mmadụ obi umeala.”

rows.source: He and his brother Dr James Vann also laid a wreath after the parade, which was led by the Brentwood Imperial Youth Band.
rows.output: Ọ na nwanne ya bụ Dọkịta James Vann, tinyere okpu agha mgbe emechara emume ahụ, nke ndị otu Brentwood Imperial Youth Band na-edu.
rows.reference: Ya na nwanne ya nwoke Dr James Vann tụkwasara ihe ifuru ncheta ka emechara ngarube ahụ, bụ nke Imperial Youth Band Brentwood duru na ya.

rows.source: Michael Vann said he was "feeling very honoured to play a part in the parade" and added "the valour of a genuine hero is being demonstrated by the support that is going to be given by a lot of people."
rows.output: Mikael Vann kwuru na ọ na-enwe "mmetụta nke ukwuu nke ịbụ onye na-eme ihe n'ime ngagharị iwe" ma tinye "omume nke dike n'ezie na-egosi site n'ịkwado ndị ọtụtụ ndị ga-enye."
rows.reference: Michael Vann kwuru na “obi dị ya mma nke ukwuu na nkwanyị ugwu isonye na ngarube ahụ” wee kwukwaa sị na “a na-egosi site na nkwado nke ndị mmadụ kwanyere ike nke dike n’ezie kpara.”

rows.source: MMA fans stayed up all night to watch Bellator 206, they got Peppa Pig instead
rows.output: Ndị na-akwado MMA nọrọ abalị niile ka ha na-ekiri Bellator 206, ha nwetara Peppa Pig
rows.reference: Ndị nkwado MMA mụrụ anya abalị niile iji kiri Bellator 206, kama ha nwetara Peppa Pig

rows.source: Imagine this, you have stayed up all night to watch the a packed Bellator 206 only to be denied watching the main event.
rows.output: Chee echiche nke a, ị nọrọ abalị dum na-echere ịhụ asọmpi Bellator 206 nke juru ebe niile, ma a jụrụ gị ịhụ ihe omume bụ isi.
rows.reference: Chegodi nke a, ịmụrụ anya abalị niile ka ikirie Bellator 206 juputara ejuputa, naanị ka agọnarị gị ikiri isi emume.

rows.source: The bill from San Jose contained 13 fights, including six on the main card and was being shown live through the night in the UK on Channel 5.
rows.output: Iwu ahụ sitere na San Jose nwere ọgụ iri na atọ, gụnyere isii n'akwụkwọ isi ma na-egosi ndụ n'abalị ahụ na UK na Channel 5.
rows.reference: Akwụkwọ ozi sitere San Jose nwere mgba 13, tinyere isii dị na isi kaadị wee na-egosi ya ka ọ na-eme abalị niile na Uk na Channel 5.

rows.source: At 6am, just as Gegard Mousasi and Rory MacDonald were preparing to face each other, viewers in the UK were left stunned when the coverage changed to Peppa Pig.
rows.output: N'elekere 6 nke ụtụtụ, n'oge a na-akwado ịlụ ọgụ n'etiti Gegard Mousasi na Rory MacDonald, ndị na-ekiri na UK nwere ihe ijuanya mgbe ihe ngosi ahụ gbanwere na Peppa Pig.
rows.reference: N’elekere 6 ụtụtụ, ozugbo Gegard Mousasi na Rory MacDonald chọrọ icherịta onwe ha ihu n’ihu, ndị nkiri nọ UK nwere mgbagwoju anya ka nweta ahụ gbanwere bụrụ Peppa Pig.

rows.source: Some were unimpressed after they had stayed awake until the early hours especially for the fight.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ enweghị mmasị mgbe ha nọrọ n'ụra ruo n'isi ụtụtụ karịsịa maka ọgụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọ masịghị ụfọdụ ka ha mụchagoro anya abalị ruo isi ụtụtụ tụmadị maka mgba ahụ.

rows.source: One fan on Twitter described the switch to the children's cartoon as "some sort of sick joke."
rows.output: Otu onye na-eso ụzọ Twitter kọwara mgbanwe ahụ gaa na ihe nkiri ụmụaka dị ka "ụdị ụjọ."
rows.reference: Otu onye nkwado na Twitter kọwara mgbanwe banye n’ihe nkiri ụmụaka ahụ ka “nnukwu njakịrị atọghị ọchị.”

rows.source: "It's government regulation that at 6 a.m. that content was not suitable so they had to switch to children's programming, " said Dave Schwartz, Bellator senior vice president of marketing and communication, when asked about the transmission.
rows.output: "Ọchịchị na-achịkwa na n'elekere isii nke ụtụtụ, ọdịnaya ahụ adịghị mma, ya mere ha ga-agbanwe gaa na mmemme ụmụaka, " ka Dave Schwartz, onye isi oche nke Bellator na-ahụ maka ahịa na nkwukọrịta kwuru, mgbe a jụrụ ya gbasara mgbasa ozi ahụ.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụ iwu gọọmentị na ka ọ kụrụ elekere 6 ụtụtụ na ihe nkiri ahụ adịghị mma maka ụmụaka, ya mere ha jiri banye n’ihe mmemme ụmụaka,” Dave Schwartz kwuru, senịọ na-esote onye isi maka ahịa na mgbasa ozi Bellator, mgbe ajụrụ maka ngosi ihe nkiri ahụ.

rows.source: ""Peppa the pig," yes."
rows.output: "Peppa ezi," ee."
rows.reference: “”Peppa the Pig,” ee.”

rows.source: Bellator company president Scott Coker said that they are going to work on their scheduling to include UK viewers in the future.
rows.output: Onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Bellator Scott Coker kwuru na ha ga-arụ ọrụ na nhazi oge ha iji tinye ndị na-ekiri UK n'ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: Onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Bellator, Scott Coker kwuru na ha ga-arụ ọrụ na nhazi ha ka ewere gbakwunye ndị nkiri UK n’ọdịnihu.

rows.source: "I think that when I think about the replay, I think that we can probably work it out," Coker said.
rows.output: "Ekwenyere m na mgbe m chere maka ịmegharị ihe, ekwenyere m na anyị nwere ike ịrụkọ ọrụ ọnụ," ka Coker kwuru.
rows.reference: “A na m eche mgbe m na-eche maka mmegharị ya, A na m eche na anyị nwere ike eleghị anya dozie ya,” Coker kwuru.

rows.source: "But it's six in the morning on a Sunday there and we won't be able to work this out until Sunday our time, Monday their time.
rows.output: "Mana ọ bụ ụtụtụ ụbọchị Sọnde n'ebe ahụ, anyị agaghị enwe ike ịrụ ọrụ a ruo mgbe Sọnde, ụbọchị Sọnde, ruo mgbe ụbọchị Mọnde, ụbọchị Mọnde ha.
rows.reference: “Mana ọ bụ elekere nke isii n’ụtụtụ Sọnde ebe ahụ na anyị enweghị ike idozi ya ruo Sọnde nke anyị, Mọnde nke ha.

rows.source: But we are working on it.
rows.output: Mana anyị na-arụ ọrụ na ya.
rows.reference: Mana anyị na-arụ ọrụ na ya.

rows.source: Believe me, when it switched over there were a lot of texts going back and forth and they all were not friendly.
rows.output: Kwere m, mgbe ọ gbanwere, e nwere ọtụtụ ederede na-aga n'ihu na nke ọzọ, na ha niile adịghị enwe obi ụtọ.
rows.reference: Kwenyere m, mgbe ọ gbanwere ebe ahụ, enwere ọtụtụ ederede gara ihu na azụ nke na ha niile abụghị nke enyi na enyi.

rows.source: We were trying to fix it, we thought it was a technical glitch.
rows.output: Anyị na-agbalị idozi ya, anyị chere na ọ bụ mmejọ teknụzụ.
rows.reference: Anyị nọ na-agbalị idozi ya, anyị chere na ọ bụ mmebi siri na teknụzụ.

rows.source: But it wasn't, it was a governmental issue.
rows.output: Mana ọ bụghị, ọ bụ okwu gọọmentị.
rows.reference: Mana ọ bụghị, ọ bụ okwu gbasara ndị gọọmentị.

rows.source: I can promise you the next time it's not going to happen.
rows.output: Enwere m ike ịkwa gị nkwa na oge ọzọ, ọ gaghị eme.
rows.reference: A ga m ekwe gị nkwa na ọ gaghị eme mgbe ọzọ.

rows.source: We'll keep it down to five fights instead of six - like we normally do - and we tried to overdeliver for the fans and we just went over.
rows.output: Anyị ga-eme ka ọ bụrụ ọgụ ise kama isii - dị ka anyị na-eme mgbe niile - ma anyị gbalịrị ịnye ihe karịrị ihe ndị na-akwado ya chọrọ ma anyị gara n'ihu.
rows.reference: Anyị ga-ewetu ya ka ọ bụrụ mgba ise kama isii - dịka anyị na-emekarị - na anyị na-agba mbọ inyezu ndị nkwado ihe ha chọrọ were gafezie.

rows.source: It's an unfortunate situation."
rows.output: "Ọ bụ ọnọdụ dị mwute."
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ọnọdụ mwute.”

rows.source: Desert Island Discs: Tom Daley felt 'inferior' over sexuality
rows.output: Desert Island Discs: Tom Daley chere na ọ dị 'nke dị ala' banyere mmekọahụ
rows.reference: Desert Island Discs: Ọ metụtara Tom Daley ka “onye adịghị mma “ n’ihe gbasara ụdị mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị

rows.source: Olympic diver Tom Daley says he grew up feeling inferior to everyone because of his sexuality - but that gave him the motivation to become a success.
rows.output: Onye na-egwu mmiri Olympic Tom Daley kwuru na ọ tolitere na-enwe mmetụta nke ịbụ onye na-adịghị mma n'ihi okike ya - mana nke ahụ nyere ya ihe ọ ga-eme ka ọ bụrụ onye ọchụnta ego.
rows.reference: Onye na-amanye na mmiri nke Olympic Tom Daley kwuru na ya toputara na mmetụta na ya adịghị mma na-ebe onye ọ bụla nọ n’ihi ụdị mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị ya- mana nke ahụ nyere ya mkpali ịbụ onye mere nke ọma.

rows.source: The 24-year-old said he did not realise until he went to secondary school that "not everyone is like me."
rows.output: Onye dị afọ iri abụọ na anọ kwuru na ọ maghị na "ọ bụghị onye ọ bụla dị ka m" ruo mgbe ọ gara ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị.
rows.reference: Nwata ahụ gbara afọ 24 kwuru na ya amataghị ruo mgbe ọ gara skuul sekọndịrị na “ọ bụghị onye ọ bụla dị ka ya.”

rows.source: Speaking on the first Radio 4 Desert Island Discs presented by Lauren Laverne, he said he spoke out about gay rights to give others "hope."
rows.output: N'okwu banyere ihe omume Radio 4 Desert Island Discs nke Lauren Laverne gosipụtara, o kwuru na o kwuru okwu banyere ikike nwoke nwere mmasị nwoke iji nye ndị ọzọ "olileanya."
rows.reference: Mgbe ọ na-ekwu okwu na Radio 4 Desert Island Discs nke izizi, nke Lauren Laverne gosipụtara, o kwuru na ya kwuputara gbasara ikike ndị na-enwe mmekọrịta nwoke na nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị na nwanyị iji nye ndị ọzọ “olile anya.”

rows.source: He also said becoming a parent made him care less about winning the Olympics.
rows.output: O kwukwara na ịbụ nne na nna mere ka ọ ghara ịkpachara anya n'ịmụ asọmpi Olimpik.
rows.reference: O kwukwara na ịbụ nna mere ya o tinyechaghị mmụọ n’imeri na Olympics.

rows.source: The regular presenter of the long-running show, Kirsty Young, has taken a number of months off because of illness.
rows.output: Onye na-egosi ihe ngosi ahụ mgbe niile, Kirsty Young, ewepụla ọtụtụ ọnwa n'ihi ọrịa.
rows.reference: Onye ngosi ihe mmemme ahụ kwa mgbe nke megoro ogologo oge, Kirsty Young, enwerela ọnwa ole ma ole n’ihi ahụ ọnwụnwụ.

rows.source: Appearing as a castaway on Laverne's first programme, Daley said he felt "less than" everyone else growing up because "it wasn't socially acceptable to like boys and girls."
rows.output: Na-apụta dị ka onye a zọpụtara na mmemme mbụ nke Laverne, Daley kwuru na ọ na-enwe mmetụta "erughị eru" ka ndị ọzọ na-eto eto n'ihi na "ọ bụghị ihe a na-anabata n'ozuzu ya ịhụ ụmụ nwoke na ụmụ nwanyị n'anya."
rows.reference: Na-apụta dịka onye ajụrụ ajụ n’ihe mmemme izizi nke Laverne, Daley kwuru na ọ metụtara ya dịka “onye erughị” ka ndị ọzọ mgbe ọ na-etolite etolite n’ihi “anabataghị na mmekọrịta ọha inwe mmasị na nwoke na nwanyị.”

rows.source: He said: "To this day, those feelings of feeling less than, and feeling different, have been the real things that have given me the power and strength to be able to succeed."
rows.output: O kwuru: "N'ime ụbọchị a, mmetụta nke inwe mmetụta na-adịghị mma, na inwe mmetụta dị iche, bụ ihe ndị dị adị nke nyere m ike na ike iji nwee ike ịga nke ọma."
rows.reference: O kwuru: “Ruo taa, mmetụta ahụ nke na emetụta ka onye erughị eru, na mmetụta ịdị iche, bụ ihe ndị nyere m ike iji mee nke ọma.”

rows.source: He wanted to prove that he was "something," he said, so that he did not disappoint everyone when they eventually found out about his sexuality.
rows.output: Ọ chọrọ igosi na ọ bụ "ihe," ka o kwuru, ka ọ ghara ịkpasu onye ọ bụla iwe mgbe ha chọpụtara banyere mmekọahụ ya n'ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Ọ chọro ka ya gosi na ya bụ “ihe”, o kwuru, ka ya ghara ịgbawa mmadụ niile obi mgbe ha ga-achọpụta gbasara ụdị mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị ya.

rows.source: The two-time bronze Olympic medallist has become a high-profile LGBT campaigner and used his appearance at this year's Commonwealth Games in Australia to appeal for more countries to decriminalise homosexuality.
rows.output: Onye mmeri ọla nchara ugboro abụọ na asọmpi Olimpik, aghọwo onye na-akwado LGBT nke a ma ama ma jiri ọbịbịa ya na egwuregwu Commonwealth nke afọ a na Australia rịọ ka mba ndị ọzọ na-akwụsị ịkpa ókè nwoke na nwanyị.
rows.reference: Onye mmeri ọla nchara ugboro abụọ na Olympics abụrụla onye ndọrọndọrọ LGBT gbagotere, ma were mpụta ya na Commonwealth Games na Australia were rịọ ka ọtụtụ mba ndị ọzọ wepu ịda iwu dị na mmekọrịta nwoke na nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị na nwanyị.

rows.source: He said he spoke out because he felt lucky to be able to live openly without ramifications and wanted to give others "hope."
rows.output: O kwuru na ọ na-ekwu okwu n'ihi na ọ na-enwe obi ụtọ ibi ndụ n'ụzọ doro anya na-enweghị ihe ọ bụla na-eme ya, ma chọọ inye ndị ọzọ "olileanya."
rows.reference: O kwuru na ya kwuputara okwu n’ihi na ọ chere na ya nwere chiọma inwe ike na-ebi ndụ ghe oghe na-enweghị ndapụta ọ bụla ma chọọ inye ndị ọzọ “olile anya.”

rows.source: The three-time world champion said falling in love with a man - US film-maker Dustin Lance Black, who he met in 2013 - "caught me by surprise."
rows.output: Onye mmeri ụwa ugboro atọ kwuru na ịhụnanya ya na nwoke - onye na-ese ihe nkiri US bụ Dustin Lance Black, onye ọ zutere na 2013 - "jidere m n'ụjọ."
rows.reference: Onye mmeri ugboro atọ ahụ n’ụwa kwuru na ịhụ nwoke n’anya - onye na-eme ihe nkiri US, Dustin Lance Black, bụ onye nke ya zutere na 2013 - “mere ya na ntụmadị.”

rows.source: Daley married the Oscar winner, who is 20 years his senior, last year but he said the age gap had never been an issue.
rows.output: Daley lụrụ onye meriri Oscar, onye dị afọ iri abụọ karịa ya, n'afọ gara aga mana o kwuru na oghere afọ adịghị mgbe ọ bụla bụ nsogbu.
rows.reference: Daley lụrụ onye ahụ were mmeri Oscar, bụ onye jiri afọ 20 were tọọ ya, n’afọ gara aga mana o kwuru na ndịiche dị n’afọ ha enwebeghị mgbe ọ pụtara okwu.

rows.source: "When you go through so much at such a young age" - he went to his first Olympics aged 14 and his father died of cancer three years later - he said that it was hard to find someone the same age who had experienced similar highs and lows.
rows.output: "Ọ bụrụ na ị na-agafe ọtụtụ ihe n'afọ ndụ gị" - ọ gara n'egwuregwu Olympic mbụ ya dị afọ iri na anọ, nna ya nwụrụ n'ihi ọrịa kansa afọ atọ ka e mesịrị - o kwuru na ọ siri ike ịchọta onye n'otu afọ ahụ nke nwere ahụmahụ yiri ya.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ịgabigara ọtụtụ ihe n’oge ịbụ nwata” - ọ gara Olympics ya nke izizi ka ọgbara afọ 14, nna ya nwụrụ n’ihi ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ ka afọ atọ gachara - o kwuru na o siri ike ịhụ onye ya na ya gbara otu afọ nke nwegoro ụdị ahụmihe dị elu ma dịkwa ala ka ya.

rows.source: The couple became parents in June, to a son called Robert Ray Black-Daley, and Daley said his "whole perspective" had changed.
rows.output: Di na nwunye ahụ ghọrọ ndị nne na nna na June, nwa nwoke aha ya bụ Robert Ray Black-Daley, Daley kwuru na echiche ya "gbanwere kpamkpam."
rows.reference: Mmadụ abụọ ahụ bụrụ nna nwa nwoke akpọrọ Robert Ray Black-Daley na Juun- nke na Daley kwuru na “ka ya si ahụta ihe” gbanwere.

rows.source: "If you had asked me last year, it was all about 'I need to win a gold medal'," he said.
rows.output: "Ọ bụrụ na ị jụrụ m n'afọ gara aga, ọ bụ ihe niile gbasara 'Achọrọ m imeri ihe nrite ọla edo'."
rows.reference: “Ọ bụrụ na ịjụrụ m n’afọ gara aga, ọ bụ naanị gbasara “Inwe mmeri ọla edo’. o kwuru.

rows.source: "You know what, there are bigger things than Olympic gold medals.
rows.output: "Ị maara ihe, e nwere ihe ndị ka ibu karịa ọla edo Olympic.
rows.reference: “Ọ kwa ịma, na-enwere ihe ndị karịrị ọla edo Olympics.

rows.source: My Olympic gold medal is Robbie."
rows.output: "Ogwe ọla ọla m bụ Robbie."
rows.reference: Ọla edo m bụ Robbie.”

rows.source: His son has the same name as his father Robert, who died in 2011 aged 40 after being diagnosed with brain cancer.
rows.output: Nwa ya nwere otu aha dị ka nna ya bụ́ Robert, onye nwụrụ na 2011 mgbe ọ dị afọ iri anọ ka a chọpụtara na ọ nwere ọrịa kansa nke ụbụrụ.
rows.reference: Nwa ya nwoke nwere otu aha dị ka nna ya Robert, bụ onye nwụrụ na 2011 ka ọgbara afọ 40, ka achọpụtara na ọ nwere ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ nke ụbụrụ.

rows.source: Daley said his dad did not accept he was going to die and one of the last things he had asked was if they had their tickets yet for London 2012 - as he wanted to be on the front row.
rows.output: Daley kwuru na nna ya anabataghị na ọ ga-anwụ ma otu n'ime ihe ikpeazụ ọ rịọrọ bụ ma ha nwere tiketi ha ka ha gaa London 2012 - n'ihi na ọ chọrọ ịnọ n'ahịrị nke mbụ.
rows.reference: Daley kwuru na nna ya ekwetaghị na ọ ga-anwụ, na otu n’ime ihe ikpeazụ ọ jụrụ bụ ma ha gbatala tịketị ha maka London 2012 - dịka ọ chọrọ ịnọ n’ịhu ihu.

rows.source: "I couldn't say to him 'you're not going to be around to be on the front row dad'," he said.
rows.output: "Enweghị m ike ịgwa ya 'ị gaghị anọ ebe a ka ị bụrụ n'ihu ahịrị papa'."
rows.reference: “Enweghị m ike ịgwa ya na ọ gaghị anọ ndụ ịnọ n’ihu ihu’.” o kwuru.

rows.source: "I was holding his hand as he stopped breathing and it wasn't until he'd actually stopped breathing and he was dead that I finally acknowledged he wasn't invincible," he said.
rows.output: "Ana m ejide aka ya ka ọ kwụsị ịkụ ume, ọ bụghị ruo mgbe ọ kwụsịrị ịkụ ume n'ezie ma nwụọ mgbe ahụ ka m kwetara na ọ bụghị onye a na-apụghị imeri emeri," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Eji m ya aka ka ọ kwụsịrị iku ume na ọ bụ mgbe ọ kwụsịrị iku ume n’ezie ma nwụọ ka M kwetara na ọ bụghị anwụ anwụ,” o kwuru.

rows.source: The following year Daley competed at the 2012 Olympics and won bronze.
rows.output: N'afọ na-esote, Daley sonyere na asọmpi Olimpik nke afọ 2012 wee nweta ọla nchara.
rows.reference: N’afọ na-esote ya, Daley sọrọ mpi na 2012 Olympics were rite ọla nchara.

rows.source: "I just knew that this is what I had dreamt of my whole life - to dive in front of a home crowd at an Olympic Games, there was no better feeling," he said.
rows.output: "Amakwa m na nke a bụ ihe m na-arọ nrọ ná ndụ m niile - ịwụli elu n'ihu ìgwè mmadụ n'ụlọ n'oge asọmpi Olimpik, enweghị mmetụta ka mma," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “A maara m na nke a bụ ihe m rọgoro na nrọ ndụ m niile - ịmanye na mmiri n’ihu igwe mmadụ ndị ụlọ m na Olympics Game, enweghị mmetụta karịrị ya,” o kwuru.

rows.source: It also inspired his first song choice - Proud by Heather Small - which had resonated with him in the build up to the Olympics and still gave him goosebumps.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, ọ kpaliri egwu mbụ ya - Obi ike nke Heather Small - nke kpalitere ya n'oge a na-ewu ewu maka asọmpi Olimpik ma ka na-eme ka ọ na-ama jijiji.
rows.reference: Ọ kpalitere nhọrọ egwu ya izizi - Proud site na Heather Small - bụ nke metụtara ya n’oge nkwadobe nke Olympics ma na-enyekwa ya akpata oyi.

rows.source: Desert Island Discs is on BBC Radio 4 on Sunday at 11:15 BST.
rows.output: Desert Island Discs dị na BBC Radio 4 na Sọnde na 11:15 BST.
rows.reference: Desert Island Discs dị na BBC Radio 4 na Sọnde na 11:15 BST.

rows.source: Out-of-form Mickelson benched on Ryder Cup Saturday
rows.output: Mickelson nọ n'èzí ụdị ya ka a na-ahapụ ya n'otu egwuregwu Ryder Cup n'ụbọchị Satọde
rows.reference: Ahapụrụ Mickelson ahụ ezuchaghị oke n’oche na Ryder Cup na Satọde

rows.source: American Phil Mickelson will set a record on Sunday when he plays his 47th Ryder Cup match, but he will have to turn his form around to avoid it being an unhappy milestone.
rows.output: Phil Mickelson onye America ga-edobe ndekọ na Sọnde mgbe ọ na-egwu egwuregwu Ryder Cup nke iri anọ na asaa ya, ma ọ ga-achọ ịgbanwe ụdị ya ka ọ ghara ịbụ ihe na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Onye America Phil Mickelson ga-etinye ndekọ na Sọnde mgbe ọ ga-akụ egwuregwu Ryder Cup nke ugboro 47 ya, mana ọ ga-atụgharị ụdị ya iji zenarị ịbụ ihe mmezu agaghị enye anụrị.

rows.source: Mickelson, playing in the biennial event for a record 12th time, was benched by captain Jim Furyk for Saturday's fourballs and foursomes.
rows.output: Mickelson, na-egwu egwuregwu a na-eme kwa afọ abụọ maka ndekọ ugboro iri na abụọ, ka onyeisi Jim Furyk nọchiri anya ya n'egwuregwu anọ n'ụbọchị Satọde.
rows.reference: Kaptịn Jim Furyk nọchiri Mickelson, ịkụ n’ihe mmemme a na-eme otu ugboro n’afọ abụọ nke ugboro 12 ya, na Satọde maka bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ na agba mmadụ anọ.

rows.source: Instead of being at the center of the action, as he so often has been for the United States, the five-times major winner split his day between being a cheerleader and working on his game on the range in the hope of rectifying what ails him.
rows.output: N'adịghị ka ọ na-adị mgbe ọ na-eme ihe n'etiti ndị mmadụ, dị ka ọ na-adịkarị maka United States, onye mmeri ugboro ise n'ọkwa dị elu kewara ụbọchị ya n'etiti ịbụ onye na-akwado ya na ịrụ ọrụ n'ọhịa ya n'olileanya nke idozi ihe na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Kama ịnọ n’etiti ihe na-eme, ka o si anọbu maka ndị United States, onye mmeri ugboro ise ahụ kere ụbọchị ya ịbụ onye na-akụ aka ma na-edozikwa egwuregwu ya n’ama ahụ n’olile anya imezi ihe na-arịa ya.

rows.source: Never the straightest of drivers even at the peak of his career, the 48-year-old is not an ideal fit for the tight Le Golf National course, where the long rough routinely punishes errant shots.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụ onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala kacha mma, ọbụna n'oge kachasị elu nke ọrụ ya, onye dị afọ 48 abụghị ezigbo mma maka ụzọ ụgbọ ala dị warara nke Le Golf National, ebe ogologo ahịhịa na-akpagbu ụgbọ ala na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Ọ nwebeghị mgbe ọ bụ onye na-akụ ihe gara larịị ọbụlagodi mgbe ọ nọ n’isi ọrụ egwuregwu ya, nwoke a gbara afọ 48 adabaghị n’ụdị ama Le Golf National kpara mkpa, ebe ama ahụ toro ogologo na-ata ọkụkụ etoghi ogologo ahụhụ.

rows.source: And if the course on its own is not daunting enough, Mickelson, in the ninth match on Sunday, faces accurate British Open champion Francesco Molinari, who has teamed up with rookie Tommy Fleetwood to win all four of their matches this week.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ọdịdị nke onwe ya adịghị egwu nke ukwuu, Mickelson, na egwuregwu nke itoolu na Sọnde, na-eche onye mmeri British Open nke ziri ezi, Francesco Molinari ihu, onye ya na onye ọhụrụ Tommy Fleetwood emeriela egwuregwu anọ niile n'izu a.
rows.reference: Na ọ bụrụgodi na ama ahụ anaghị atụ egwu n’onwe ya, Mickelson, na egwuregwu nke itoolu na Sọnde ga-ezute onye mmeri British Open Francesco Molinari na-akụ nke ọma, bụ onye ya na onye ọhụrụ Tommy Fleetwood jikọrọ ọnụ merie egwuregwu anọ ha niile n’izu a.

rows.source: If the Americans, four points down starting the 12 singles matches, get off to a hot start, Mickelson's match could prove absolutely crucial.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ndị America, isi anọ n'azụ na-amalite egwuregwu 12 nke otu, na-amalite nke ọma, egwuregwu Mickelson nwere ike ịbụ ihe dị mkpa n'ezie.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ndị America, jiri akara anọ n’akpụ n’azụ malite egwuregwu 12 agba nke otu onye, bido n’ọkụ ọkụ, egwuregwu Mickelson nwere ike ịdị oke mkpa.

rows.source: Furyk expressed confidence in his man, not that he could say much else.
rows.output: Furyk kwuputara obi ike n'ime mmadụ ya, ọ bụghị na ọ nwere ike ikwu ihe ọzọ.
rows.reference: Furyk kwuputara ntụkwasị obi na onye nke ya, ọ bụghị na ọ nwere ihe ọzọ ọ nwere ike ikwu.

rows.source: "He fully understood the role that he had today, gave me a pat on the back and put his arm around me and said he would be ready tomorrow," Furyk said.
rows.output: "Ọ dị ya mkpa ịghọta ọrụ ya taa, kụrụ m aka n'azụ, tinye aka m n'ubu m wee sị na ọ ga-adị njikere echi."
rows.reference: “Ọ họtara ọrụ ọ nwere taa nke ọma, tie m aka n’azụ were konye m aka wee sị, ọ ga-adị nkwadebe echi,” Furyk kwuru.

rows.source: "He's got a lot of confidence in himself.
rows.output: "O nwere okwukwe nke ukwuu n'ime onwe ya.
rows.reference: “Ọ nwere nnukwu ntụkwasị obi n’onwe ya.

rows.source: He's a Hall of Famer and he's added so much to these teams in the past, and this week.
rows.output: Ọ bụ onye nọ n'ụlọ ezumezu ma tinye ọtụtụ ihe n'ime otu ndị a n'oge gara aga, na n'izu a.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ onye nọ na Hall of Fame, na o tinyekwala ọtụtụ ihe na ndị otu a n’oge gara aga na n’izu a.

rows.source: I probably didn't envision him playing two matches.
rows.output: Enwere m ike ọ gaghị aghọta na ọ na-egwu egwuregwu abụọ.
rows.reference: Eleghị anya atụghị m anya na ọ ga-akụ egwuregwu abụọ.

rows.source: I envisioned more, but that's the way it worked out and that's the way we thought we had to go.
rows.output: M tụrụ anya ihe ndị ọzọ, ma nke ahụ bụ otú o si mee, na nke ahụ bụ otú anyị chere na anyị ga-eme.
rows.reference: Atụrụ m anya karịa, mana ọ bụ otu a ka o siri dapụta ma bụrụkwa otu anyị chere na anyị ga-esi gaa.

rows.source: He wants to be out there, just like everyone else."
rows.output: Ọ chọrọ ịnọ ebe ahụ, dị ka onye ọ bụla ọzọ."
rows.reference: Ọ chọrọ ịnọ n’ihu ebe ahụ, dị ka onye ọ bụla.”

rows.source: Mickelson will pass Nick Faldo's record for the most Ryder Cup matches played on Sunday.
rows.output: Mickelson ga-eru ndekọ Nick Faldo maka egwuregwu Ryder Cup kachasị n'ime ụbọchị Sọnde.
rows.reference: Mickelson ga-agafe ndekọ Nick Faldo maka egwuregwu Ryder Cup kacha na Sọnde.

rows.source: It could mark the end of a Ryder Cup career that has never quite matched the heights of his individual record.
rows.output: Ọ nwere ike ịbụ njedebe nke ọrụ Ryder Cup nke na-enwetaghị elu nke ndekọ onye ọ bụla.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ike bụrụ ngwucha ọrụ egwuregwu Ryder Cup ya bụ nke na-erughị elu ndekọ nkeonwe ya.

rows.source: Mickelson has 18 wins, 20 losses and seven halves, though Furyk said his presence brought some intangibles to the team.
rows.output: Mickelson nwere mmeri iri na asatọ, mfu iri abụọ na ọkara asaa, ọ bụ ezie na Furyk kwuru na ọnụnọ ya wetara ụfọdụ ihe na-adịghị ahụkebe n'òtù ahụ.
rows.reference: Mickelson nwere mmeri 18, mmefu 20 na onye laba onye laba asaa, agbanyeghị na Furyk kwuru ọnụnọ ya butere ihe enweghi ike nkọwa n’otu ahụ.

rows.source: "He's funny, he's sarcastic, witty, likes to poke fun at people, and he's a great guy to have in the team room," he explained.
rows.output: "Ọ na-atọ ọchị, ọ na-akpa ọchị, ọ na-akpa ọchị, na-amasị ịkwa ndị mmadụ ụta, ọ bụkwa ezigbo nwoke inwe n'ime ụlọ ọrụ," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ na-akpa ọchị, na-eme akaja, na-ekwu okwu ọchị, ọ na-amasị ya ịkpa ndị mmadụ ọchị, ọ bụ ezigbo mmadụ inwe n’ime ụlọ ndị otu a,” ọ kọwara.

rows.source: "I think the younger players had fun having a go at him, as well, this week, which was fun to see.
rows.output: "Ekwenyere m na ndị egwuregwu na-eto eto nwere obi ụtọ ịnwale ya, n'otu oge ahụ, n'izu a, nke na-atọ ụtọ ịhụ.
rows.reference: “Echere m na ndị egwuregwu ndị obere nwere obi anụrị ịkpasu ya n’izu a, bụ ihe nyere obi anụrị ịhụ.

rows.source: He provides a lot more than just play."
rows.output: Ọ na-enye ọtụtụ ihe karịa naanị egwuregwu."
rows.reference: Ọ na-enye ihe karịrị naanị ịkụ egwuregwu.”

rows.source: Europe captain Thomas Bjorn knows big lead can soon disappear
rows.output: Onye isi Europe Thomas Bjorn maara na nnukwu ụzọ isi nwere ike ịla n'iyi ngwa ngwa
rows.reference: Kaptịn Europe Thomas Bjorn maara na iji nnukwu akara buru ụzọ nwere ike fuo n’oge adịghị anya

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows from experience that a sizeable lead heading into the last-day singles in the Ryder Cup can easily turn into an uncomfortable ride.
rows.output: Thomas Bjorn, onye isi ndị Europe, maara site n'ahụmahụ ya na ọbụna ọdịda nke ukwuu n'ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke ndị otu na Ryder Cup nwere ike ịghọ njem na-enweghị atụ.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn, kaptịn Europe, maara site na ahụmihe na iji nnukwu akara buru ụzọ na-abanye agba nke otu onye n’ụbọchị nke ikpeazụ na Ryder Cup nwere ike tugharịa bụrụ ụgbọ agaghị atọ ụtọ.

rows.source: The Dane made his debut in the 1997 match at Valderrama, where a side captained by Seve Ballesteros held a five-point advantage over the Americans but only just got over the finishing line with their noses in front by the narrowest of margins, winning 14½-13½.
rows.output: Onye Danish mere mpụta mbụ ya na egwuregwu 1997 na Valderrama, ebe otu ndị Seve Ballesteros na-achịkwa isi ise n'elu ndị America, ma ha jisiri ike gafee ahịrị njedebe na imi ha n'ihu site na obere oghere, merie 14½-13½.
rows.reference: Onye Denmark ahụ pụtara izizi na egwuregwu 1997 na Valderrama, ebe akụkụ nke Seven Ballesteros bụ Captain jiri akara ise gafee ndị America mana ha nwere ike ịgafe ebe ngwucha naanị na imi ha dị n’ihu site na ntakịrị oghere, were merie 14½-13½.

rows.source: "You keep reminding yourself that we had a big lead at Valderrama; we had a big lead at Brookline, where we lost, and at Valderrama, where we won, but only just," said Bjorn, pictured, after watching the Class of 2018 win 5-3 both on Friday and yesterday to lead 10-6 at Le Golf National.
rows.output: "Ị na-echetara onwe gị na anyị nwere nnukwu ụzọ n'ihu na Valderrama; anyị nwere nnukwu ụzọ n'ihu na Brookline, ebe anyị tufuru, na Valderrama, ebe anyị meriri, ma ọ bụ naanị obere oge," ka Bjorn kwuru, ka ọ na-ekiri Class nke 2018 meriri 5-3 na Fraịde na ụnyaahụ iji duzie 10-6 na Le Golf National.
rows.reference: “Ị ga-agba mbọ ichetere onwe gị n’iji nnukwu akara aga na Valderrama; anyị ji nnukwu akara aga na Brookline, ebe emeriri anyi, na Valderrama ebe anyị meriri mana ọ bụ ntakịrị ihe,” Bjorn kwuru, esetere ka elelechara mgbe Klaasị 2018 meriri 5-3 na Fraịde yana ụnyahụ, iji 10-6 aga na Le Golf National.

rows.source: So history will show me and everybody on that team that this is not over.
rows.output: Ya mere, akụkọ ihe mere eme ga-egosi mụ na onye ọ bụla nọ n'òtù ahụ na nke a abụghị njedebe.
rows.reference: Yabụ na hịstrị ga-egosi m na onye ọ bụla n’otu ahụ na nke a agwụbeghị.

rows.source: You go full bore tomorrow.
rows.output: Ị ga-aga n'ihu n'ụzọ zuru oke echi.
rows.reference: Ị ga-agbalị si ike echi.

rows.source: Get out there and do all the right things.
rows.output: Pụọ n'ebe ahụ mee ihe niile ziri ezi.
rows.reference: Pụọ ebe ahụ mee ihe niile kwesịrị ekwesị.

rows.source: This is not over till you've got the points on the board.
rows.output: Nke a abụghị ihe ọ bụla ruo mgbe ị nwetara isi ihe dị na bọọdụ.
rows.reference: Nke a agwụbeghị ruo mgbe inwetara akara ahụ na bọdụ.

rows.source: We have a goal, and that is to try to win this trophy, and that's where the focus stays.
rows.output: Anyị nwere ebumnuche, na nke ahụ bụ ịgbalị imeri iko a, na nke ahụ bụ ebe uche na-adị.
rows.reference: Anyị nwere ebumnuche, bụ ka anyị gbalịa nweta iko mmeri a, ya bụ ebe ahụ ka anya anyị tụkwasara.

rows.source: I've said all along, I focus on the 12 players that are in our side, but we are so well aware of what's standing across on the other side - the greatest players in the world."
rows.output: Anọwo m na-ekwu, na-elekwasị anya na ndị egwuregwu iri na abụọ nọ n'akụkụ anyị, mana anyị maara nke ọma ihe dị n'akụkụ nke ọzọ - ndị egwuregwu kachasị ukwuu n'ụwa."
rows.reference: Ekwubuola m kemgbe na, A na m elekwasa anya na ndị egwuregwu 12 nọ n’akụkụ anyị, mana anyị maara nke ọma ihe kwụ n’akụkụ nke ọzọ - ndị egwuregwu kachasị na mba ụwa.”

rows.source: Delighted how his players have performed on a tough golf course, Bjorn added: "I would never get ahead of myself in this.
rows.output: N'ezie, ka ndị egwuregwu m si eme nke ọma n'ogige gọọlfụ siri ike, Bjorn gbakwụnyere: "Agaghị m enwe ọganihu n'elu onwe m n'ime nke a.
rows.reference: N’obi anụrị ka ndị egwuregwu ya siri mee na ama gọlfụ siri ike, Bjorn gbakwunyere: “Agaghị m agbanarị onwe m n’ọsọ na nke a.

rows.source: Tomorrow's a different beast.
rows.output: Echi bụ anụ ọhịa dị iche.
rows.reference: Echi bụ ajọ anụ dị iche.

rows.source: Tomorrow is the individual performances that come forward, and that is a different thing to do.
rows.output: Echi bụ ihe ngosi nke onye ọ bụla na-abịa n'ihu, na nke ahụ bụ ihe dị iche iche ime.
rows.reference: Echi bụ mmemme otu onye nke na-abịa n’ihu, na nke ahụ bụ ihe dị iche ime.

rows.source: It's great to be out there with a partner when things are going good, but when you're out there individually, then you're tested to the full of your capacity as a golfer.
rows.output: Ọ dị mma ịnọ ebe ahụ na onye mmekọ gị mgbe ihe na-aga nke ọma, ma mgbe ị nọ ebe ahụ naanị gị, mgbe ahụ, a na-atụ gị n'ọkụ nke ikike gị dị ka onye na-egwu gọlfụ.
rows.reference: Ọ dị mma inwe onye mmekọrịta n’ihu ebe ahụ mgbe ihe na-aga nke ọma, mana mgbe ịnọ naanị gị n’ihu ebe ahụ, mgbe ahụ ka a ga-anwale gị n’uju dịka onye na-akụ gọlfụ.

rows.source: That's the message that you need to get across to players, is get the best out of yourself tomorrow.
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ ozi ị ga-ekwupụta ndị egwuregwu, bụ inweta ihe kacha mma n'ime onwe gị echi.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ bụ ozi ịkwesịrị ime ka ndị na-eme egwuregwu mara, bụ wepụta n’ime onwe gị nke kacha mma echi.

rows.source: Now, you leave your partner behind and he has to go and get the best out of himself, as well."
rows.output: Ugbu a, ị hapụ onye òtù gị n'azụ ma ọ ga-aga n'ihu ma nweta ihe kacha mma n'ime ya, dị ka ọ dị."
rows.reference: Ugbu a, ịhapụrụ onye mmekọrịta gị n’azụ ọ ga-agakwa wepụta onwe ya nke kacha mma.”

rows.source: In contrast to Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk will be looking for his players to perform better individually than they did as partners, the exceptions being Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who picked up three points out of four.
rows.output: N'adịghị ka Bjorn, onye iro Jim Furyk ga-achọ ka ndị egwuregwu ya rụọ ọrụ nke ọma karịa ka ha mere dị ka ndị mmekọ, naanị ihe ndị dị iche bụ Jordan Spieth na Justin Thomas, ndị nwetara isi ihe atọ n'ime anọ.
rows.reference: Na ndịiche Bjorn, nọmba ncherịta ihu nke Jim Furyk ga-achọ ka ndị egwuregwu ya mee nke ọma n’onwe ha karịa ka ha nwere onye mmekọrịta, ewezuga Jordan Spieth na Justin Thomas bụ ndị nwetere akara atọ n’ime anọ.

rows.source: Furyk himself has been on both ends of those big last-day turnarounds, having been part of the winning team at Brookline before ending up a loser as Europe pulled off the "Miracle at Medinah."
rows.output: Furyk n'onwe ya enweela ahụmahụ abụọ n'akụkụ ndị ahụ buru ibu nke ụbọchị ikpeazụ, ebe ọ bụ akụkụ nke otu mmeri na Brookline tupu ọ ghọọ onye meriri na Europe na-eme "Mmiri n'ime Medinah."
rows.reference: Furyk n’onwe ya anọrọla na ngwucha nnukwu ụbọchị ntugharị ahụ, ka o osochara n’otu meriri na Brookline tupu ọ bụrụ onye emeriri ka Europe mere ihe ebube “Miracle at Medinah.”

rows.source: "I remember every damn word of it," he said in reply to being asked how Ben Crenshaw, the captain in 1999, had rallied his players heading into the last day.
rows.output: "Ana m echeta okwu ọ bụla, n'agbanyeghị na ọ na-ewute m," ka o kwuru n'azọpụta ka a jụrụ ya ka Ben Crenshaw, onye isi ndị otu na 1999, si kwado ndị otu ya ka ha na-aga n'ụbọchị ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: “Echetara m okwu ya niile,” ọ zara ka ajụrụ ya ka Ben Crenshaw kaptịn 1999 siri chịkọba ndị otu ya n’ịbanye ụbọchị ikpeazụ.

rows.source: "We have 12 important matches tomorrow, but you'd like to get off to that fast start like you saw at Brookline, like you saw at Medinah.
rows.output: "Anyị nwere egwuregwu iri na abụọ dị mkpa echi, mana ị ga-achọ ịpụ ngwa ngwa dị ka ị hụrụ na Brookline, dị ka ị hụrụ na Medinah.
rows.reference: “Anyị nwere egwuregwu 12 dị mkpa echi niile, mana ọ ga-adị mma ịmalite n’ike dịka ịhụrụ na Brookline, dịka ịhụrụ na Medinah.

rows.source: When that momentum gets going one way, it puts a lot of pressure on those middle matches.
rows.output: Mgbe ike ahụ na-aga n'otu ụzọ, ọ na-etinye nnukwu nrụgide na egwuregwu ndị dị n'etiti.
rows.reference: Mgbe ọ gabara otu ụzọ n’ike, ọ na-akwanye nnukwu nkwanye na egwuregwu ndị etiti ahụ.

rows.source: We set up our line-up accordingly and put the guys out in the fashion that we felt like, you know, we're trying to make some magic tomorrow."
rows.output: Anyị haziri usoro anyị dịka ọ dị mkpa ma tinye ndị nwoke ahụ n'usoro anyị chere na anyị ga-eme ụfọdụ anwansi echi."
rows.reference: Anyị na-ahazi ahịrị anyị ka ọ kwesịrị ma tinye ndị nke anyị n’ụdị masịrị anyị, ịma, anyị na-agbalị ime ihe anwansi echi niile.”

rows.source: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter the other Europeans in the top half of the order.
rows.output: Thomas enyere ọrụ ịgbalị idu agha ahụ ma chere Rory McIlroy ihu na egwuregwu kachasị elu, ebe Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood na Ian Poulter bụ ndị Europe ndị ọzọ nọ na ọkara elu nke usoro.
rows.reference: Enyela Thomas ọrụ ịgbalị ibu ụzọ na mgba ahụ wee cherịta Rory McIlroy ihu n’isi egwuregwu ahụ, yana Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood na Ian Poulter na ndị Europe ndị ọzọ nọ na mgbago usoro ahụ.

rows.source: "I went with this group of guys in this order because I think it covers all the way through," said Bjorn of his singles selections.
rows.output: "Agara m na otu ndị nwoke a n'usoro a n'ihi na echere m na ọ na-ekpuchi ụzọ niile."
rows.reference: “Ejiri m otu ụmụ nwoke ndị a were gaa n’ihi na E chere m na enwetechara m ihe niile,” Bjorn kwuru maka nhọrọ agba nke otu onye ya.

rows.source: Germany's new warship postponed yet again
rows.output: Egwu ọgụ Germany ọhụrụ a na-egbu oge ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ebugharịrị ngwa ọgụ ọhụrụ Germany ọzọkwa

rows.source: German Navy's newest frigate should have been commissioned in 2014 to replace ageing Cold War-era warships, but it won't be there until at least the next year due to faulty systems and snowballing cost, local media reported.
rows.output: N'afọ 2014, a ga-ebido ụgbọ mmiri ọhụrụ nke ndị agha mmiri German iji dochie ụgbọ mmiri ochie nke oge agha oyi, mana ọ gaghị abịa ruo opekata mpe afọ na-esote n'ihi usoro ndị na-adịghị mma na ọnụ ahịa na-ebuli elu, dị ka mgbasa ozi obodo si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ekwesịrị itinye n’ọrụ Frigate ọhụrụ nke Ndị Agha Mmiri nke Germany na 2014 iji nọchie ngwa ọgụ oge Cold War kabagoro nka, mana ọ gaghị anọ ebe ahụ ruo opekempe afọ na-abịa n’ihi sistem adịghị mma yana ọnụahịa dị oke ọnụ, ụlọ mgbasa ozi nke obodo kwuputara.

rows.source: Commissioning of the "Rheinland-Pfalz," the lead ship of the brand new Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates, has now been postponed until the first half of 2019, according to Die Zeit newspaper citing a military spokesman.
rows.output: Ntọhapụ nke "Rheinland-Pfalz," ụgbọ mmiri mbụ nke klaasị Baden-Wuerttemberg, a na-egbu oge ugbu a ruo n'etiti 2019, dị ka akwụkwọ akụkọ Die Zeit si kwuo na-ekwu okwu ndị agha.
rows.reference: Ebugharịala itinye n’ọrụ nke “Rheinland-Pfalz,” isi ụgbọ nke Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigate ọhụrụ ka o ruo ọkara afọ mbu nke 2019, dabere na akwụkwọ akụkọ Die Zeit, na-arụtụ onye nkwuchite okwu ndị agha aka.

rows.source: The vessel should have joined the Navy in 2014, but the troubling post-delivery issues plagued the fate of the ambitious project.
rows.output: Ụgbọ mmiri ahụ kwesịrị ịbanye n'ụgbọ mmiri n'afọ 2014, mana nsogbu ndị na-esochi ịrụ ụgbọ mmiri ahụ gbochiri ọrụ a na-eme atụmatụ.
rows.reference: Ụgbọ ahụ kwesịrị isonye Ndị Agha Mmiri na 2014, mana ihe nsogbu mbute ya sochiri oke atụmatụ ahụ.

rows.source: The four Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels the Navy ordered back in 2007 will come as replacement to the ageing Bremen-class frigates.
rows.output: Ndị ụgbọ mmiri anọ Baden-Wuerttemberg klas nke ụgbọ mmiri ahụ zụrụ azụ na 2007 ga-abịa dị ka ihe nnọchi maka ụgbọ mmiri Bremen klas na-eto eto.
rows.reference: Ụgbọ Baden-Wuerttemberg-class anọ Ndị Agha Mmiri tụrụ ahịa ya na 2007 ga-abịa dịka nnọchi anya Bremen-class frigate kabagoro nka.

rows.source: It is understood they will feature a powerful cannon, an array of anti-aircraft and anti-ship missiles as well as some stealth technologies, such as reduced radar, infrared and acoustic signatures.
rows.output: Ọ dị ka ha ga-egosipụta nnukwu ọkụ ọkụ, ụdị ụgbọ elu na ụgbọ mmiri, na ụfọdụ teknụzụ nzuzo, dị ka mbelata radar, infrared na akara ụda.
rows.reference: Emere ka aghọta na ha ga-enwe isi egbe siri ike nke ukwuu, ngwa ọgụ ụgbọ elu dị iche iche na ogbunigwe ụgbọ mmiri yana ụfọdụ teknụzụ nzuzo, dị ka radar eweturu ewetu, infrared na ndakọrịta ụda.

rows.source: Other important features include longer maintenance periods - it should be possible to deploy the newest frigates for up to two years away from home ports.
rows.output: Ihe ndị ọzọ dị mkpa gụnyere oge nlekọta ogologo oge - ọ kwesịrị ikwe omume ịkwado ụgbọ mmiri kachasị ọhụrụ maka ihe ruru afọ abụọ pụọ n'ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri.
rows.reference: Nrụọrụ ndị ọzọ dị mkpa tinyere oge nrụkwa ya tere aka - ọ kwesịrị na ọ ga-ekwe omume itinye n’ọrụ frigate ndị ọhụrụ ahụ ihe ruru afọ abụọ pụọ na ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri.

rows.source: However, continuous delays mean that the cutting-edge warships - said to allow Germany to project power overseas - will already become outdated by the time they enter service, Die Zeit notes.
rows.output: Ọbụna, igbu oge na-aga n'ihu pụtara na ụgbọ mmiri ọgbara ọhụrụ a - nke a na-ekwu na ọ ga-eme ka Germany nwee ike ịgbasa ike ya n'èzí - ga-adịla ochie tupu ha abanye n'ọrụ, Die Zeit na-ekwu.
rows.reference: Kosiladị, igbu oge niile a pụtara na ngwa ọgụ ahụ pụrụ iche - nke ekwuru na ọ ga-enye Germany oghere igosi ike na mba ofesi -ga-abụ ihe megoro ochie mgbe ha ga-amalite ọrụ, Die Zelt tụrụ aka.

rows.source: The ill-fated F125 frigate made headlines last year, when the German Navy officially refused to commission the vessel and returned it to Blohm & Voss shipyard in Hamburg.
rows.output: Nke a na-akpata ọdachi F125 frigate mere kaadị isiokwu n'afọ gara aga, mgbe ndị agha mmiri German jụrụ ịnabata ụgbọ ahụ n'ọrụ ma laghachi Blohm & Voss shipyard na Hamburg.
rows.reference: Frigate F125 ahụ juputara na nsogbu pụtara n’isi akụkọ n’afọ gara aga mgbe Ndị Agha Mmiri nke Germany jụrụ itinye ụgbọ ahụ n’ọrụ wee bughachi ya na ọdụ nrụpụta ụgbọ mmiri Blohm & Voss dị na Hamburg.

rows.source: This was the first time the Navy has returned a ship to a shipbuilder after delivery.
rows.output: Nke a bụ oge mbụ ndị ọrụ mmiri lọghachiri ụgbọ mmiri n'ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri mgbe e nyefere ya.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ nke mbụ Ndị Agha Mmiri na-ebughachi ụgbọ mmiri azụ na ndị rụpụtara ya ka ebutechara ya.

rows.source: Little was known about the reasons behind the return, but German media cited a number of crucial "software and hardware defects" that made the warship useless if deployed on a combat mission.
rows.output: Obere ihe a maara banyere ihe mere ha ji alọghachi, mana mgbasa ozi German kwuru ọnụ ọgụgụ dị mkpa nke "mmejọ ngwanrọ na ngwaọrụ" nke mere ụgbọ mmiri ahụ enweghị ike ịrụ ọrụ ma ọ bụrụ na ebugara ya n'ọrụ agha.
rows.reference: Ntakịrị ka amatara maka ihe kpatara eji bughachi ya, mana ndị ụlọ mgbasa ozi Germany rụtụrụ aka ọnụọgụ ihe ole ma ole “mmebi ngwanro na ngwaike “ dị oke mkpa, nke mere na ngwa ọgụ ahụ abaghị uru ma ọ bụrụ na-ebupu ya ka ọ gaa agha.

rows.source: Software deficiencies were particularly important as the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels will be operated by a crew of some 120 sailors - just half of the manpower on older Bremen class frigates.
rows.output: Mmejọ nke ngwanrọ bụ ihe dị mkpa karịsịa ka ụgbọ mmiri Baden-Wuerttemberg klas ga-achịkwa site n'aka ndị ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri nke dị ihe dị ka ndị ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri 120 - naanị ọkara nke ndị ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri nke ụgbọ mmiri Bremen ochie.
rows.reference: Ezughị oke ngwanro dị oke mkpa ebe ọ bụ ndị na-akwọ ụgbọ mmiri 120 ga-akwọ Baden-Wuerttemberg-class ahụ - naanị ọkara mmadụ na-akwọ Bremen class frigate ndị ochie.

rows.source: Also, it emerged that the ship is dramatically overweight which reduces its performance and limits the Navy's ability to add future upgrades.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, ọ pụtara ìhè na ụgbọ mmiri ahụ na-ebu ibu nke ukwuu nke na-ebelata arụmọrụ ya ma na-egbochi ndị agha mmiri ka ha tinye mmelite ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa, ọ pụtakwara na ụgbọ mmiri ahụ buru oke ibu nke weturu ike ọrụ ya ma gbachie ndị Agha Mmiri ịgbakwunye ihe nkwalite n’ọdịnihu.

rows.source: The 7,000-ton "Rheinland-Pfalz" is believed to be twice as heavy as similar-class ships used by the Germans in the Second World War.
rows.output: Puku asaa n'arọ "Rheinland-Pfalz" ka ekwuru na ọ dị okpukpu abụọ ibu ka ụgbọ mmiri klaasị yiri nke ndị Jamanị ji n'oge Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.
rows.reference: Ekwenyere na 7,000-ton “Rheinland-Pfalz jiri ugboro abụọ karịa ibu ụdị ụgbọ mmiri ndị yana ya n’otu klaasị nke ndị Germany jiri na Second World War.

rows.source: Aside from faulty hardware, the price tag of the entire project - including the training of the crew - is also becoming an issue.
rows.output: N'akụkụ ngwaọrụ ndị na-adịghị mma, ọnụ ahịa ọrụ niile - gụnyere ọzụzụ ndị ọrụ - na-aghọkwa nsogbu.
rows.reference: Ewezuga ngwaike adịghị mma, ọnụego atụmatụ ọrụ ahụ niile - tinyere ịzụpụta ndị ga-akwọ ya - na-apụtakwa okwu.

rows.source: It is said to have reached staggering €3.1billion ($3.6bn) - up from initial €2.2 billion.
rows.output: E kwuru na ọ ruru ihe dị ịtụnanya €3.1 ijeri ($3.6 ijeri) - site na mbido €2.2 ijeri.
rows.reference: Ekwuru na oruola ihe mmaja ijeri €3.1 (ijeri $3.6) - gbagoo site na ijeri €2.2 izizi.

rows.source: Problems gripping the newest frigates become especially of importance in light of recent warnings that Germany's naval power is shrinking.
rows.output: Ihe ndị na-eme ka ụgbọ mmiri ọhụrụ ahụ ghara ịdị mma na-aghọ nke ukwuu nke ọma n'ihi ịdọ aka ná ntị na-adịbeghị anya na ike ụgbọ mmiri Germany na-ebelata.
rows.reference: Nsogbu jidere frigate ọhụrụ ndị ahụ pụbara oke mkpa n’ihi ịdọ aka ntị emere n’oge adịghị anya na ike Ndị Agha Mmiri nke Germany na-ebeleta.

rows.source: Earlier this year, Hans-Peter Bartels, chief of the German parliament's defense committee, acknowledged the Navy is actually "running out of deployment-capable ships."
rows.output: N'afọ a, Hans-Peter Bartels, onye isi ndị otu ndị omebe iwu nke Germany, kwetara na ụgbọ mmiri ndị agha na-efunahụ ụgbọ mmiri ndị nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ.
rows.reference: Na mbido afọ a, Hans-Peter Bartels, onye isi ọgbakọ nchekwa ndị ọmebe iwu nke Germany, kwuputara na n’ezie Ndị Agha Mmiri “enwezughịzi ụgbọ mmiri enwere ike zipu n’ọrụ.”

rows.source: The official said the issue has snowballed over time, because old ships were decommissioned but no replacement vessels were provided.
rows.output: Onye ọrụ gọọmentị ahụ kwuru na okwu ahụ etolitekwuru n’oge, n’ihi na ụgbọ mmiri ochie kwụsịrị ọrụ, ma enyeghị ụgbọ mmiri ndị ọzọ dochie ha.
rows.reference: Onye ọrụ ahụ kwuru na okwu ahụ abawanyela ọsọọsọ ka n’oge na-aga, n’ihi na ewepụrụ ụgbọ mmiri ndị ochie n’ọrụ mana enweghị ụgbọ ewepụtara iji nọchie ha.

rows.source: He lamented that none of the of the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates were able to join the Navy.
rows.output: Ọ na-ewute ya na ọ dịghị nke ụgbọ mmiri Baden-Wuerttemberg klas nwere ike ịbanye na ndị agha mmiri.
rows.reference: O bekuru mbeku na ọ nweghị Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigate nke nwere ike isonye Ndị Agha Mmiri.

rows.source: National Trust eavesdrops on secret life of bats
rows.output: Ndị National Trust na-ege ntị n'ime ndụ nzuzo nke ụmụ oke
rows.reference: National Trust tinyere ntị na ndụ nzuzo nke ụsụ

rows.source: New research being carried out at an estate in the Scottish Highlands aims to reveal how bats use the landscape in their hunt for food.
rows.output: Nnyocha ọhụrụ a na-eme n'ugbo dị na ugwu Scotland na-achọ igosi ka ụmụ anụmanụ na-eji ala eme ihe n'ịchụ nta nri.
rows.reference: Nyocha ọhụrụ a an-eme n’otu ogige dị na Scottish Highlands chọrọ igosipụta otu ụsụ siri eji gburgburu ahụ akpa nri.

rows.source: It is hoped the findings will shed new light on the behaviour of the unique flying mammals and help guide future conservation activities.
rows.output: Enwere olile anya na ihe ndị a ga-egosi ìhè ọhụrụ banyere àgwà nke anụ mamma na-efe efe pụrụ iche ma nyere aka ịhazi ihe ndị a ga-eme n'ọdịnihu iji chekwaa ha.
rows.reference: A na-atụ anya na nchọpụta ahụ ga-agbakwasa ihie na omume ụmụ-anụmanụ a na-anụ ara pụrụ iche were nyere aka n’ihazi ọrụ nchekwa ọdịnihu.

rows.source: The study by scientists at the National Trust for Scotland will follow common and soprano pipistrelles as well as brown long-eared and Daubenton bats at Inverewe Gardens in Wester Ross.
rows.output: Nnyocha nke ndị ọkà mmụta sayensị na National Trust for Scotland ga-eso pipistrelle nkịtị na soprano, yana pipistrelle ogologo ntị aja aja na Daubenton na Inverewe Gardens na Wester Ross.
rows.reference: Mmụta ahụ ndị nyocha sayensị National Trust for Scotland na-eme ga-esoro ụsụ pipistrelles ama ama na soprano pipistrelles yana brown long-eared na Daubenton na Inverewe Gardens dị na Wester Ross.

rows.source: Special recorders will be placed at key locations around the property to track bat activities throughout the season.
rows.output: A ga-ebu ụzọ tinye ndekọ pụrụ iche n'ebe dị mkpa n'ime ihe onwunwe ahụ iji soro ọrụ bat n'oge oge.
rows.reference: A ga-edebe igwe ndekọ pụrụ iche n’akụkụ ebe dị mkpa n’okirikiri ogige ahụ iji sochie omume ụsụ ndị a n’ime oge niile.

rows.source: NHS staff and volunteers will also carry out mobile surveys using hand-held detectors.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ na ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo NHS ga-eme nyocha ndị na-aga n'ihu site na iji ndị na-achọpụta ihe n'aka.
rows.reference: Ndị ọrụ NHS na ndị wepụtara onwe ha ga-emekwa nyocha mkpagharị site na n’iji igwe nchọpụta a na-eji n’aka.

rows.source: Expert sound analysis of all recordings will ascertain the frequency of the bat calls and which species are doing what.
rows.output: Nyocha ụda ọkachamara nke ndekọ niile ga-achọpụta ugboro nke oku bat na ụdị ndị na-eme ihe.
rows.reference: Nyocha ụda nke ọkammara nke ndekọ niile ga-egosi ugboro ole ụsụ n’akpọ oku na ihe ụdị nke ọ bụla na-eme.

rows.source: A habitat map and report will then be produced to create a detailed landscape-scale picture of their behaviour.
rows.output: Maapụ ebe obibi na akụkọ ga-esi na ya pụta iji mepụta ihe oyiyi zuru ezu nke ala nke omume ha.
rows.reference: A ga-emepụta mapụ ebe obibi na ndekọba iji mebe ihe eserese gburugburu nke omume ha n’uju.

rows.source: Rob Dewar, nature conservation adviser for NTS, hopes the results will reveal which areas of habitat are most important to the bats and how they are used by each of the species.
rows.output: Rob Dewar, onye ndụmọdụ nchekwa okike maka NTS, na-atụ anya na nsonaazụ ga-egosi ebe obibi ndị dị mkpa maka anụ ọhịa ahụ na otu ha si eji ebe obibi ọ bụla eme ihe site n'ụdị ọ bụla.
rows.reference: Rob Dewar, onye ndụmọdụ banyere nchekwa ekereụwa maka NTS, nwere olile anya na nsonazụ ndị a ga-egosi akụkụ ebe obibi ahụ kacha dị ụsụ mkpa na ka ụdị nke ọ bụla si eji ya eme ihe.

rows.source: This information will help determine the benefits of habitat management work such as meadow creation and how best to maintain woodlands for bats and other associated species.
rows.output: Nke a ga-enyere aka ikpebi uru nke ọrụ njikwa ebe obibi dị ka imepụta ubi na otu esi eme ka ọhịa dị mma maka ụmụ oke na ụdị ndị ọzọ metụtara.
rows.reference: Ozi nke a ga-enyere aka ime mkpebi n’uru ọrụ njikwa ebe obibi dị ka mmepụta ala ahịhịa yana otu kacha mma iji chekwaa ala osisi maka ụsụ na ụdị ndị ọzọ metụtara ha.

rows.source: Bat populations in Scotland and across the UK have declined considerably over the past century.
rows.output: Ndị bat na Scotland na n'ofe UK agbadala nke ukwuu n'ime narị afọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ ụsụ na Scotland yana UK agbadaala nke ukwuu n’ime afọ iri gara aga.

rows.source: They are under threat from building and development work that affects roosts and loss of habitat.
rows.output: Ha nọ n'okpuru iyi egwu sitere n'iwu ụlọ na ọrụ mmepe nke na-emetụta ebe a na-ehi ụra na ọnwụ nke ebe obibi.
rows.reference: Ha nọ n’ihe iyi egwu sitere na ọrụ ịrụ ụlọ na mmepe nke na-emetụta ebe ụra na ofufu ebe obibi.

rows.source: Wind turbines and lighting can also pose a risk, as can flypapers and some chemical treatments of building materials, as well as attacks by pet cats.
rows.output: igwe ọkụ na ọkụ eletrik nwekwara ike ịkpata ihe ize ndụ, dị ka akwụkwọ ụgbọ elu na ụfọdụ ọgwụgwọ kemịkalụ nke ihe owuwu, yana mwakpo nke nwamba nkeonwe.
rows.reference: Turbine Ikuku na inye ihie nwere ike ibute ihe ize ndụ, yana flypaper na ụfọdụ kemikal nchekwa ngwaọrụ eji arụ ụlọ, yana kwa mbuso agha sitere na nwamba na-ebi n’ụlọ.

rows.source: Bats are not actually blind.
rows.output: Ndị oke bekee anaghị aṅụrị.
rows.reference: N’ezie ụsụ ekpughị isi.

rows.source: However, due to their nocturnal hunting habits their ears are more useful than their eyes when it comes to catching prey.
rows.output: Ọbụna, n'ihi àgwà ha na-achụ nta n'abalị, ntị ha bara uru karịa anya ha mgbe ọ na-abịa ịkụ azụ.
rows.reference: Kosiladị, n’ihi omume ịkpa nri n’abalị, ntị ha dị mkpa karịa anya ha mgbe oruru n’inwude anụ oriri.

rows.source: They use a sophisticated echo-location technique to pinpoint bugs and obstacles in their flight path.
rows.output: Ha na-eji usoro ịchọpụta ụda dị elu chọpụta ahụhụ na ihe mgbochi n'ụzọ ụgbọ elu ha.
rows.reference: Ha na-eji usoro nchọpụta ndaghachi ụda were nweta ahụhụ na ihe mgbachi dị n’ụzọ ofufe ha.

rows.source: The NTS, which is responsible for the care of more than 270 historical buildings, 38 important gardens and 76,000 hectares of land around the country, takes bats very seriously.
rows.output: Nke NTS, nke na-ahụ maka nlekọta ihe karịrị ụlọ akụkọ ihe mere eme 270, ogige 38 dị mkpa na hectare 76,000 nke ala gburugburu obodo ahụ, na-ewere ụmụ oke n'ụzọ dị oke mkpa.
rows.reference: NTS, bụ ndị ọ dị n’aka ilekọta ihe karịrị ụlọ ochie 270, ubi 38 dị mkpa na hectare ala 76,000 n’okirikiri obodo, kpọrọ ụsụ oke mkpa.

rows.source: It has ten trained experts, who regularly carry out surveys, roost inspections and sometimes rescues.
rows.output: O nwere ndị ọkachamara iri nke ọma zụrụ azụ, ndị na-eme nyocha mgbe niile, nyocha n'elu osisi, na mgbe ụfọdụ na-azọpụta.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ndị ọkammara iri azụrụ azụ bụ ndị na-eme nyocha kwa mgbe, na-enyocha ebe ụra ma mee nzọpụta mgbe ụfọdụ.

rows.source: The organisation has even set up Scotland's first and only dedicated bat reserve at Threave estate in Dumfries and Galloway, which is home to eight of Scotland's ten bat species.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ etinyela ebe nchekwa bat nke mbụ na naanị ya na Scotland na ala Threave na Dumfries na Galloway, bụ́ nke bụ ụlọ nke ụdị bat iri n'ime ụdị bat iri nke Scotland.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ edobela ebe pụrụ iche na Scotland izizi ewepụtara maka ụsụ n’ogige Threave dị na Dumfries na Galloway, bụ be ụdị ụsụ asatọ n’ime iri enwere na Scotland bi.

rows.source: Estate manager David Thompson says the estate is the ideal territory for them.
rows.output: Onye njikwa ala David Thompson kwuru na ala ahụ bụ ebe kacha mma maka ha.
rows.reference: Onye njikwa ogige ahụ David Thompson kwuru na ogige ahụ bụ ebe kacha mma maka ha.

rows.source: "Here at Threave we have a great area for bats," he said.
rows.output: "N'ebe a na Threave, anyị nwere ebe dị ukwuu maka ụmụ anụmanụ bat."
rows.reference: “Na Threaves ebe a, anyị nwere akụkụ mara mma maka ụsụ,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "We've got the old buildings, lots of veteran trees and all the good habitat.
rows.output: Anyị nwere ụlọ ndị ochie, ọtụtụ osisi ndị agha na ebe obibi niile dị mma.
rows.reference: “Anyị nwere ụlọ ochie, osisi kagoro nka na ebe obibi niile dị mma.

rows.source: But there is much about bats that is still unknown, so the work we do here and at other properties will help us understand more about what they need to thrive."
rows.output: Mana e nwere ọtụtụ ihe gbasara ụmụ oke na-amaghị, ya mere ọrụ anyị na-eme ebe a na n'ụlọ ndị ọzọ ga-enyere anyị aka ịghọta ihe ha chọrọ iji nwee ọganihu."
rows.reference: Mana a ka nwere ọtụtụ ihe gbasara ụsụ amatabeghị, ya mere na ọrụ anyị na-arụ ebe a yana n’ogige ụlọ ndị ọzọ ga-enyere anyị aka ịghọta karịa banyere ihe ha chọrọ iji n’ebi nke ọma.”

rows.source: He stresses the importance of checking for bats before carrying out maintenance within properties as it is possible unwitting destruction of a single maternity roost could kill up to 400 females and young, possibly wiping out an entire local population.
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwusi ike mkpa ọ dị ịlele bat tupu ha emee mmezi n'ime ihe onwunwe, n'ihi na ọ ga-ekwe omume na ha ga-emebi nke ọma nke otu ebe ịmụ nwa nwere ike igbu ụmụ nwanyị na ụmụaka ruru 400, nke nwere ike ikpochapụ ụdị ndị bi n'ógbè ahụ kpamkpam.
rows.reference: O kwukwara mkpa ọ dị ilele maka ụsụ tupu emebe ndozi n’ogige ụlọ maka enwere ike mebie n’amaghị ama otu ebe ụra nne na nwa, nwere ike gbuo ihe ruru ndị nwanyị 400 na ụmụ ha, nwere ike ikpochapu ọnụọgụ niile bi ebe ahụ.

rows.source: Bats are protected and it is illegal to kill, harass or disturb them or destroy their roosts.
rows.output: Ndị bat na-echekwa ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ iwu na-akwadoghị igbu, ịkpagbu, ma ọ bụ ịkpagbu ha ma ọ bụ mebie ebe ha na-ehi ụra.
rows.reference: Echekwabara ụsụ na ọ bụ mpụ igbu, mekpa ha ahụ ma ọ bụ nye ha nsogbu ma ọ bụ mebie ebe ụra ha.

rows.source: Elisabeth Ferrell, Scottish officer for the Bat Conservation Trust, has encouraged the public to pitch in to help.
rows.output: Elisabeth Ferrell, onye ọrụ Scotland maka Bat Conservation Trust, agwala ọha na eze ka ha tinye aka n'inyere aka.
rows.reference: Elisabeth Ferrell, onye ọrụ Scot maka Bat Conservation Trust, enyela ndị ọhaneze nkwado ka ha tinye aka.

rows.source: She said: "We still have a lot to learn about our bats and for many of our species we just don't know how their populations are faring."
rows.output: O kwuru: "Anyị ka nwere ọtụtụ ihe anyị ga-amụta banyere anụ ọhịa anyị na maka ọtụtụ n'ime ụdị anyị, anyị amaghị ka ndị mmadụ ha na-eme."
rows.reference: O kwuru: “Anyị ka nwere ọtụtụ ihe anyị ga-amụ banyere ụsụ anyị yana ọtụtụ ụdị anyị, nke anyị amaghị ka ọnụọgụ ha si ebi.”

rows.reference: Ndị ọka iwu ya adịla nkwadobe ịgba akwụkwọ akụkọ Germany, Der Spiegel akwụkwọ, bụ ndị biputara ebubo ahụ.

rows.source: The Portugal and Juventus forward has been accused of raping an American woman, named as Kathryn Mayorga, in a Las Vegas hotel room in 2009.

rows.source: He is alleged to have then paid her $375,000 to keep quiet about the incident, Der Spiegel reported on Friday.
rows.output: O kwuru na o kwụrụ ya $375,000 ka ọ ghara ikwu banyere ihe ahụ, Der Spiegel kọrọ na Fraịde.
rows.reference: Eboro ebubo na ọ kwụrụ ya $375,000 iji mee ya ka ọ nọrọ nwayọọ gbasara ihe mere, Der Spiegel kwuputara na Fraịde.

rows.source: Speaking in an Instagram Live video to his 142 million followers hours after the claims were reported, Ronaldo, 33, slammed the reports as "fake news."
rows.output: N'oge vidiyo Instagram Live, Ronaldo, dị afọ 33, kọwara akụkọ ahụ dị ka "akụkọ ụgha," awa ole na ole ka e kwuru na ọ mere.
rows.reference: Mgbe ọ na-agwa nde 142 ndị na-eso ya okwu na vidiyo Instagram Live ka ekwuputachara ebubo ahụ, Ronaldo, 33, kpọrọ akụkọ ahụ “akụkọ ụgha.”

rows.reference: Ihe ha kwuru taa, akụkọ ụgha,” onye mmeri Ballo d’Or ugboro ise ahụ kwuru na igwefoto.

rows.source: I am a happy man and all good," the player added, smiling.

rows.reference: A bụ m onye anụrị juputara obi ma dịkwa mma,” onye egwuregwu ahụ gbakwunyere, na-achị ọchị.

rows.source: Ronaldo's lawyers are preparing to sue Der Spiegel over the allegations, which they have called "an inadmissible reporting of suspicions in the area of privacy," according to Reuters.
rows.output: Ndị ọka iwu Ronaldo na-akwado ịgba akwụkwọ megide Der Spiegel maka ebubo ndị ahụ, nke ha kpọrọ "akụkọ na-enweghị ikike banyere nchegbu n'ógbè nke nzuzo," dị ka Reuters si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ndị ọka iwu Ronaldo na-akwadobe ịgba Der Spiegel akwụkwọ n’ihi ebubo ahụ, bụ nke ha kpọrọ “akụkọ agaghị anabata maka nyocha banyere ndụ nzuzo,” dabere na Reuters.

rows.source: Lawyer Christian Schertz said the player would seek compensation for "moral damages in an amount corresponding to the gravity of the infringement, which is probably one of the most serious violations of personal rights in recent years."
rows.output: Onye ọka iwu Christian Schertz kwuru na onye ọkpụkpọ ahụ ga-achọ ụgwọ maka "mmebi omume na ego dabara na ịdị njọ nke mmebi ahụ, nke bụ ikekwe otu n'ime mmebi ikike onwe onye kachasị njọ n'ime afọ ndị na-adịbeghị anya."
rows.reference: Onye ọka iwu Christian Schertz kwuru na onye egwuregwu ahụ ga-anara ego iti aka n’obi maka “ mmebi ụkpụrụ n’ọnụego dabara n’ihe emebiri, bụ eleghị anya otu n’ime ịda iwu kachasị nke ikike nkeonwe n’afọ adịghị anya.”

rows.source: The alleged incident is said to have taken place in June 2009 at a suite at the Palms Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.
rows.output: Ihe a na-ekwu na-ekwu na ihe ahụ mere n'ọnwa Juun afọ 2009 n'otu ụlọ nkwari akụ nke Palms Hotel and Casino dị na Las Vegas.
rows.reference: Ekwuru na ihe ebubo ahụ mere na Juun 2009 n’ime ụlọ Palms Hotel and Casino dị na Las Vegas.

rows.source: After meeting in a nightclub, Ronaldo and Mayorga reportedly went back to the player's room, where he allegedly anally raped her, according to papers filed at Clark County District Court in Nevada.
rows.output: Mgbe ha zutere n'otu ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ, a na-ekwu na Ronaldo na Mayorga laghachiri n'ọnụ ụlọ onye ọkpụkpọ, ebe a na-ekwu na ọ na-eme ya n'azụ, dịka akwụkwọ ndị e debere n'ụlọ ikpe Clark County District Court dị na Nevada si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ka ha zutechara n’ụlọ ịgba egwu, Ronaldo na Mayorga laghachiri azụ n’ime ụlọ onye egwuregwu ahụ, ebe ọ dakporo ya n’ike site na ike, dabere na akwụkwọ agbara na Clark County District Court dị na Nevada.

rows.source: Mayorga claims Ronaldo fell to his knees after the alleged incident and told her he was "99 percent" a "good guy" let down by the "one percent."
rows.output: Mayorga na-ekwu na Ronaldo dara n'ikpere ya mgbe ihe a na-ebo ebubo mere, ma gwa ya na ya bụ "99 pasent" "onye ọma" dara ada site na "otu pasent."
rows.reference: Mayorga kwuputara na Ronaldo mere nsekpu ala ka ọ mechara ihe ebubo ahụ were gwa ya na ọ bụ “pesentị 99” “ezigbo mmadụ” “ otu pesentị mechuru ihu.”

rows.source: The documents claim that Ronaldo confirmed the pair had sex, but that it was consensual.
rows.output: A na-ekwu na akwụkwọ ndị ahụ na-ekwu na Ronaldo kwadoro na di na nwunye ahụ nwere mmekọahụ, mana na ọ bụ nke a na-achọsi ike.
rows.reference: Akwụkwọ ahụ na-ekwuputa na Ronaldo kwenyere na ha nwere mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị mana onye ọ bụla kwenyere.

rows.source: Mayorga also claims she went to the police and had photographs taken of her injuries at a hospital, but later agreed to an out-of-court settlement because she felt "terrified of retaliation" and was worried about "being publicly humiliated."
rows.output: Mayorga na-ekwu na ọ gara n'ụlọ ọrụ ndị uwe ojii ma nwee foto ewere maka mmerụ ahụ ya n'ụlọ ọgwụ, ma emesịa kweta n'ụlọ ikpe n'èzí ụlọ ikpe n'ihi na ọ na-atụ egwu "ịbụ ndị a na-akparị mmadụ n'ihu ọha" na ọ na-echegbu onwe ya banyere "ịbụ ndị a na-akparị mmadụ n'ihu ọha."
rows.reference: Mayorga kwuputakwara na ya gara na ndị uwe ojii na esetere foto mmerụ ahụ ya n’ụlọ ọgwụ, mana emechara ya kwenye ikpebi n’agaghị ụlọ ikpe n’ihi “n’ujo mmegwara tụrụ ya” na “echiche chebere ya maka imebọ ya n’ọhaeze.”

rows.source: The 34-year-old says she is now seeking to overturn the settlement as she continues to be traumatized by the alleged incident.
rows.output: Onye dị afọ iri atọ na anọ na-ekwu na ọ na-achọ ugbu a ịtụgharị nkwekọrịta ahụ ka ọ na-aga n'ihu na-echegbu onwe ya maka ihe a na-ebo ebubo.
rows.reference: Nwata nwanyị a gbara afọ 34 kwuru na ya-chọrọ ka atụgharịa mkpezi ahụ ebe ọ ka na-enwe ihe mgbu sitere n’ihe ebubo ahụ.

rows.source: Ronaldo was on the verge of joining Real Madrid from Manchester United at the time of the alleged assault, and this summer moved to Italian giants Juve in a €100 million deal.
rows.output: Ronaldo nọ n'akụkụ ịbanye na Real Madrid site na Manchester United n'oge ebubo mwakpo ahụ, ma n'oge okpomọkụ a, ọ kwagara na ndị Juve n'otu nde euro.
rows.reference: Ronaldo na-achọ ka ọ banye Real Madrid site na Manchester United oge ndakpo ahụ mere, na n’oge okpomọkụ a, ọ gara nnukwu otu Italy, Juve na nkwekọrịta nde €100.

rows.source: Brexit: UK 'would forever regret' losing carmakers
rows.output: Brexit: UK 'ga-akwa ụta ruo mgbe ebighị ebi' ịla n'iyi ndị na-eme ụgbọ ala
rows.reference: Brexit: UK “ga na-enwe nwute dịrị gaba ma ndị na-arụ ụgbọ ala funari ha

rows.source: The UK "would regret it forever" if it lost its status as a world leader in car manufacturing after Brexit, Business Secretary Greg Clark has said.
rows.output: Ndị UK "ga-akwa ụta ya ruo mgbe ebighị ebi" ma ọ bụrụ na ha tufuo ọnọdụ ha dị ka onye ndu ụwa na-emepụta ụgbọ ala mgbe Brexit gasịrị, onye na-ahụ maka azụmahịa Greg Clark kwuru.
rows.reference: UK “ga-enwe nwute dịịrị gaba” ma ọ bụrụ na o tufuo ọkwa ya dị ka onye ọchịchị n’ịrụpụta ụgbọ ala n’ụwa ma Brexit gachaa, Ọde Akwụkwọ Azụmahịa Greg Clark kwuru.

rows.source: He added it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.
rows.output: Ọ gbakwunyere na ọ na-ewute ya na Toyota UK gwara BBC na ọ bụrụ na Britain hapụrụ EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta, na ha ga-akwụsị mmepụta nwa oge na ụlọ ọrụ ha dị na Burnaston, nso Derby.
rows.reference: Ọ gbakwunyere na ọ bụ ihe “na-atụ uche” na Toyota UK gwara BBC na ọ bụrụ na Britain apụọ na EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta, na ha ga-akwụsị nwa oge ịrụpụta ihe n’ụlọ nrụpụta dị na Burnaston, n’akụkụ Derby.

rows.source: "We need a deal," Mr Clark said.
rows.output: "Anyị chọrọ nkwekọrịta," Maazị Clark kwuru.
rows.reference: “Anyị chọrọ nkwekọrịta,” Mr Clark kwuru.

rows.source: The Japanese carmaker said the impact of border delays in the event of a no-deal Brexit could cost jobs.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ụgbọ ala Japan kwuru na mmetụta nke igbu oge ókèala n'oge ọ bụla na-enweghị nkwekọrịta Brexit nwere ike ịkpata ọrụ efu.
rows.reference: Onye ọrụ ụgbọ ala nke Japan ahụ kwuru na ndapụta nke igbu oge n’oke ala ma ọ bụrụ na enweghị nkwekọrịta Brexit nwere ike napụ ọrụ.

rows.source: The Burnaston plant - which makes Toyota's Auris and Avensis - produced nearly 150,000 cars last year of which 90% were exported to the rest of the European Union.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Burnaston - nke na-eme Toyota's Auris na Avensis - mepụtara ihe dị ka 150,000 ụgbọ ala n'afọ gara aga nke 90% n'ime ha ebugara na mba ndị ọzọ nke European Union.
rows.reference: Ụlọ nrụpụta nke Burnaston - bụ nke na-arụpụta Toyota Auris na Avensis - rụpụtara ihe ruru ụgbọ ala 150,000 n’afọ gara aga nke ebupuru 90% ya na mba European Union ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: "My view is that if Britain crashes out of the EU at the end of March we will see production stops in our factory," said Marvin Cooke, Toyota's managing director at Burnaston.
rows.output: "Nleba anya m bụ na ọ bụrụ na Britain dara na EU na njedebe nke Maachị, anyị ga-ahụ nkwụsị mmepụta na ụlọ ọrụ anyị," ka Marvin Cooke, onye isi njikwa Toyota na Burnaston kwuru.
rows.reference: “Echiche m bụ na ọ bụrụ na Britain apụọ na EU na ngwucha Maachị, anyị ga-ahụ na nrụpụta kwụsịrị n’ụlọ nrụpụta anyị” Marvin Cooke onye isi njikwa Toyota na Burnaston kwuru.

rows.source: Other UK car manufacturers have raised fears about leaving the EU without agreement on how cross-border trade will function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.output: Ndị ọzọ na-emepụta ụgbọ ala na UK ekwupụtala nchegbu banyere ịpụ na EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta banyere otu ahia n'ofe ókèala ga-esi arụ ọrụ, gụnyere Honda, BMW na Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.reference: Ndị ọzọ na-arụpụta ụgbọ ala na UK na-atụ egwu banyere ịhapụ EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta ka azụmahịa na-agafe oke ala ga-esi rụọ ọrụ, tinyere Honda, BMW na Jaguar Land Rover.

rows.source: BMW, for example, says it will close its Mini plant in Oxford for a month following Brexit.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na BMW, dịka ọmụmaatụ, na-ekwu na ọ ga-emechi ụlọ ọrụ Mini ya na Oxford maka otu ọnwa mgbe Brexit gasịrị.
rows.reference: BMW, maka ọmụmatụ, kwuru na ya ga-emechi Obere ụlọ nrụpụta ya dị na Oxford maka otu ọnwa ma emechaa Brexit.

rows.source: The main concerns relate to what carmakers say are supply chain risks in the event of a no-deal Brexit.
rows.output: Nchegbu bụ isi metụtara ihe ndị na-eme ụgbọ ala na-ekwu na ihe ize ndụ nke eriri nri na ihe ize ndụ nke ọdịda Brexit.
rows.reference: Mkpatụta kacha gbasara ihe ndị na-arụ ụgbọ ala kwuru bụ n’ihe egwu mbunye ahịa ma ọ bụrụ na enwetaghị nkwekọrịta.

rows.source: Toyota's production line is run on a "just-in-time" basis, with parts arriving every 37 minutes from suppliers in both the UK and the EU for cars made to order.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Toyota na-arụ ọrụ n'usoro "naanị n'oge", ebe akụkụ na-abata kwa nkeji iri atọ na asaa site n'aka ndị na-eweta ya na UK na EU maka ụgbọ ala ndị e mere n'usoro.
rows.reference: A na-eme nrụpụta na Toyota n’ahiri usoro “ọ bịa ozugbo”, ebe akụkụ ụgbọ ala na-eji nkeji 37 nwere esi n’aka ndị mbunye ahịa abịa, ma UK na EU maka ụgbọ ala atụrụ ahịa ya.

rows.source: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be disruption at the border which the industry says could lead to delays and shortages of parts.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na UK hapụ EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta na 29 Maachị, enwere ike ịnwe nsogbu na ókèala nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-ekwu na ọ nwere ike ibute igbu oge na ụkọ nke akụkụ.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na UK ahapụ EU n’enwetaghị nkwekọrịta na Maachị 29, enwere ike inwe ọgbaghara n’oke ala bụ nke ụlọ nrụpụta kwuru na ọ nwere ike bute igbu oge yana ezughị ezu akụkụ ụgbọ ala.

rows.source: It would be impossible for Toyota to hold more than a day's worth of inventory at its Derbyshire plant, the company said, and so production would be stopped.
rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ ihe na-agaghị ekwe omume maka Toyota ịnọgide na-echekwa ngwaahịa karịa otu ụbọchị n'ụlọ ọrụ Derbyshire, ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kwuru, na ya mere, mmepụta ga-akwụsị.
rows.reference: Ọ gaghị ekwe omume na Toyota ga-ahapụ ngwaahịa  karịrị nke otu ụbọchị n’ụlọ nrụpụta ha dị na Derbyshire, ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kwuru, yamere na nrụpụta ga-akwụsị.

rows.source: Mr Clark said Theresa May's Chequers plan for future relations with the EU is "precisely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border."
rows.output: Mazi Clark kwuru na atụmatụ Chequers nke Theresa May maka mmekọrịta n'ọdịnihu na EU "dị n'ụzọ ziri ezi iji zere nlele na ókè."
rows.reference: Mr Clark kwuru na atụmatụ Chequers nke Theresa May maka mmekọrịta ha na EU n’ọdịnihu bụ “nke emebere ka ọ zenarị nyocha niile ahụ n’oke ala.”

rows.source: "We need to have a deal. We want to have the best deal that will allow as I say not just the success at present to be enjoyed but for us to grasp this opportunity," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.
rows.output: "Anyị kwesịrị inwe nkwekọrịta. Anyị chọrọ inwe nkwekọrịta kacha mma nke ga-eme ka, dịka m na-ekwu, ọ bụghị naanị ihe ịga nke ọma ugbu a ka a ga-erite uru, kama ka anyị jiri ohere a mee ihe."
rows.reference: “Anyị chọrọ inwe nkwekọrịta.   Anyị chọrọ inwe nkwekọrịta kacha mma ga-enye anyị oghere dịka m na-ekwu, nke abụghị naanị inweta ọganihu ugbu a ma ka anyị jidekwa oghere a,” ọ gwara ihe mmemme BBC Radio 4 Today.

rows.source: "The evidence from not just Toyota but other manufacturers is that we need to absolutely be able to continue what has been a highly successful set of supply chains."
rows.output: "Ọgụgụ isi sitere na Toyota na ndị nrụpụta ndị ọzọ na-egosi na anyị kwesịrị ịga n'ihu n'usoro nnyefe nke rụpụtara nke ọma."
rows.reference: “Akaebe sitere n’abụghị naanị Toyota ma ndị ọzọ na-eme nrụpụta bụ na ekwesịrị ịga n’ihu soro usoro mbunye ahịa nke na-aga nke ọma kpamkpam.”

rows.source: Toyota was unable to say how long production would be stopped, but in the longer term, warned that added costs would reduce the plant's competitiveness and eventually cost jobs.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Toyota enweghị ike ikwu ogologo oge mmepụta ga-akwụsị, mana n'oge dị ogologo, ha dọrọ aka ná ntị na ụgwọ ndị ọzọ ga-ebelata asọmpi ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ma n'ikpeazụ, ọ ga-efunahụ ọrụ.
rows.reference: Toyota enweghị ike ikwu ogologo oge ole a ga-akwụsị ime nrụpụta, mana n’ote aka, ha na-adọ aka na ntị mgbakwunye ọnụego ga-ebelata ike asompi ya na emechaa a ga-anapụ ọrụ.

rows.source: Peter Tsouvallaris, who has worked at Burnaston for 24 years and is the Unite union convenor at the plant, said his members are increasingly concerned: "In my experience once these jobs go they never come back.
rows.output: Pita Tsouvallaris, onye rụrụ ọrụ na Burnaston ruo afọ iri abụọ na anọ na onye isi otu ndị ọrụ na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, kwuru na ndị otu ya na-echegbu onwe ha: "N'ime ahụmahụ m, otu oge ndị a na-efunahụ ọrụ, ha anaghị alaghachi azụ.
rows.reference: Peter Tsouvallaris, bụ onye rụgoro ọrụ na Burnaston afọ 24, bụrụkwa onye nchịkọba otu ndị ọrụ n’ụlọ nrụpụta ahụ, kwuru na ndị otu ya na-atụ uche nke ukwuu: “N’ahụmihe m, ozugbo ọrụ ndị a lara, ha anaghị alaghachi azụ.

rows.source: A government spokesperson said: "We have put forward a precise and credible plan for our future relationship with the EU."
rows.output: Onye nnọchite anya gọọmentị kwuru: "Anyị ewepụtala atụmatụ ziri ezi na nke a pụrụ ịdabere na ya maka mmekọrịta anyị n'ọdịnihu na EU."
rows.reference: Otu onye nkwuchite okwu gọọmentị kwuru:  “Anyị eweputala atụmatụ doro anya were ntụkwasị obi maka mmekọrịta anyị na EU n’ọdịnihu.

rows.source: Trump meeting with Rosenstein may be delayed again, says White House
rows.output: Mgbe Trump na-eme nzukọ na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme na-eme
rows.reference: Enwere ike budaa oge nzụkọ Trump na Rosenstein ọzọ, White House kwuru
