rows.source: Donald Trump's high-stakes meeting with deputy attorney general Rod Rosenstein could be "pushed back another week" as the fight over supreme court nominee Brett Kavanaugh continues, the White House said on Sunday.
rows.output: Mgbe Donald Trump zutere onye ọka iwu nke abụọ bụ Rod Rosenstein nwere ike "gbatị ọzọ izu" ka a na-alụ ọgụ maka onye a họpụtara maka ụlọ ikpe kachasị elu bụ Brett Kavanaugh, White House kwuru na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Enwere ike ibuda nzụkọ ahụ dị oke mkpa nke Donald Trump na osote onye isi ọka ikpe Rod Rosenstein nwere “izu ọzọ na-abịa” ebe mgba maka onye nhọpụta ụlọ ikpe kachasị elu Brett Kavanaugh na-aga n’ihu, White House kwuru na Sọnde.

rows.source: Rosenstein oversees the work of special counsel Robert Mueller, who is investigating Russian election interference, links between Trump aides and Russia and potential obstruction of justice by the president.
rows.output: Rosenstein na-elekọta ọrụ onye ọka iwu pụrụ iche Robert Mueller, onye na-enyocha mmetụta ntuli aka Russia, njikọ dị n'etiti ndị enyemaka Trump na Russia na ikekwe igbochi ikpe ziri ezi nke onye isi ala.
rows.reference: Rosenstein na-ahụ maka ọrụ pụrụ iche Robert Mueller bụ onye na-eme nyocha ntinye aka ndị Russia na ntuli aka, njikọ dị n’etiti ndị inyeaka Trump na Russia yana mgbachi nke inweta ikpe nkwumọtọ sitere na onye isi ala.

rows.source: Whether or not Trump will fire the deputy attorney general, and thereby endanger Mueller's independence, has fuelled Washington gossip for months.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ na Trump ga-achụpụ onye ọka iwu nke abụọ, na n'ụzọ ahụ na-etinye ihe ize ndụ na nnwere onwe nke Mueller, ọ na-akpali asịrị Washington kemgbe ọtụtụ ọnwa.
rows.reference: Ma Trump a ga-achụ ka ọ ga-ahapụ osote onye isi ọka ikpe ahụ, n’ihi ya tinye nnwere onwe Mueller n’ihe egwu, mụnyere ọkụ na asịrị Washington n’ọtụtụ ọnwa.

rows.source: Earlier this month, the New York Times reported that Rosenstein discussed wearing a wire to record conversations with Trump and the possibility of removing the president via the 25th amendment.
rows.output: N'ọnwa gara aga, New York Times kwuru na ọ na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iyi ihe ndekọ ọkụ iji dee mkparịta ụka ya na Trump na ohere nke ịwepụ onye isi ala site na Nkeji edemede nke 25.
rows.reference: Na mbido ọnwa a, New York Times kwuputara na Rosenstein kwuru maka iyi eriri okwu iji dekọba nrụrịta ụka Trump na iwepu onye isi ala site n’ụzọ mmegharị 25th.

rows.source: Rosenstein denied the report.
rows.output: Rosenstein gọnarịrị akụkọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Rosenstein gọnarịrị akụkọ a.

rows.source: But last Monday he went to the White House, amid reports he was about to resign.
rows.output: Mana n'izu gara aga, ọ gara n'ụlọ White House, n'etiti akụkọ na ọ na-eme atụmatụ ịgba arụkwaghịm.
rows.reference: Mana Mọnde gara aga ọ gara na White House, n’etiti mkpesa na ọ chọrọ irutu.

rows.source: Instead, a meeting with Trump, who was then at the United Nations in New York, was announced for Thursday.
rows.output: Kama nke ahụ, e kwupụtara nzukọ na Trump, onye ahụ bụ onye United Nations na New York, maka Tọzdee.
rows.reference: Kama, ekwuputere nzụkọ n’etiti Trump, onye nke nọ na United Nations na New York maka Tọsde.

rows.source: Trump said he would "prefer not" to fire Rosenstein but then the meeting was delayed to avoid a clash with the Senate judiciary committee hearing in which Kavanaugh and one of the women who have accused him of sexual misconduct, Dr Christine Blasey Ford, both testified.
rows.output: Trump kwuru na ọ ga-amasị ya "ịghara ịrụ ọrụ" ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị, ma emesịa, nzukọ ahụ kwụsịrị iji zere esemokwu na ọgbakọ ndị omeiwu Sineti na-eme, ebe a na-ekpe ikpe Kavanaugh na otu n'ime ụmụ nwanyị atọ na-ekwu na ọ na-eme mmekọahụ, Dr Christine Blasey Ford, na-ekwu okwu.
rows.reference: Trump kwuru na “ọ gaghị amasị” ya ịchụ Rosentein mana mgbe ahụ egbuturu oge nzụkọ ahụ iji zere ịkụkọta n’ọnụnụ ọgbakọ ndị ọkaikpe Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu nke Kavanaugh na otu n’ime ụmụ nwanyị ndị boro ya ebubo nke omume arụrụ ala, Dk Christine Blasey Ford, ha abụọ nyere akaebe.

rows.source: On Friday, Trump ordered a one-week FBI investigation of claims against Kavanaugh, further delaying a full Senate vote.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Fraịde, Trump nyere iwu nyocha FBI nke otu izu banyere ebubo eboro Kavanaugh, na-eme ka ịtụ vootu zuru oke nke Senate kwụsị.
rows.reference: Na Fraịde, Trump tiri iwu nke nyocha FBI n’otu-izu maka ebubo chere Kavanaugh, nke gbukwuru oge nke ntuli aka Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu n’uju.

rows.source: Trump's press secretary, Sarah Sanders, appeared on Fox News Sunday.
rows.output: Onye ode akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi Trump, Sarah Sanders, pụtara na Fox News Sunday.
rows.reference: Ọdee Akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi nke Trump, Sarah Sanders, pụtara na Fox News na Sọnde.

rows.source: Asked about the Rosenstein meeting, she said: "A date for that hasn't been set, it could be this week, I could see that pushing back another week given all of the other things that are going on with the supreme court.
rows.output: Mgbe a jụrụ ya gbasara nzukọ ahụ nke Rosenstein, o kwuru: "E nwebeghị ụbọchị maka nke ahụ, ọ nwere ike ịbụ n'izu a, enwere m ike ịhụ nke ahụ na-eme ka ọ bụrụ izu ọzọ n'ihi ihe niile ọzọ na-eme na ụlọ ikpe kachasị elu.
rows.reference: Ajụrụ ya maka nzụkọ Rosentein, o kwuru: “Atọọla ụbọchị maka nke ahụ, ọ nwere ike ịbụ n’izu na abịa, m na ahụ ka nke ahụ laghachiri otu izu n’ihi ihe niile na eme ugbu a na ụlọ ikpe kachasị n’obodo.

rows.source: But we'll see and I always like to keep the press updated."
rows.output: Mana anyị ga-ahụ ma m na-amasị m ịnọgide na-enwe mmelite ndị mgbasa ozi."
rows.reference: Mana anyị ga-ahụ, ọ na amasị m oge niile ịme ka ndị mgbasa ozi mara ihe na eme ozugbo.”

rows.source: Some reporters would contest that assertion: Sanders has not held a White House press briefing since 10 September.
rows.output: Ndị nta akụkọ ụfọdụ ga-ekwu na nkwupụta ahụ bụ: Sanders enwebeghị nnọkọ ndị nta akụkọ White House kemgbe 10 Septemba.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndi nta akụkọ ga-adọkpụ ngozusike ahụ: Sanders emebeghị nchịkọta akụkọ nke White House kemgbe Septemba 10.

rows.source: Host Chris Wallace asked why.
rows.output: Onye ọbịa Chris Wallace jụrụ ihe kpatara ya.
rows.reference: Onye nlekọta Chris Wallace jụrụ ihe kpatara ya.

rows.source: Sanders said the scarcity of briefings was not due to a distaste for TV reporters "grandstanding," although she said: "I won't disagree with the fact that they grandstand."
rows.output: Onye isi ala Sanders kwuru na ụkọ nke ọgbakọ ndị nta akụkọ abụghị n'ihi enweghị mmasị n'ebe ndị nta akụkọ telivishọn nọ "na-eme ihe ngosi," n'agbanyeghị na o kwuru: "Agaghị m ekwenye na eziokwu na ha na-eme ihe ngosi."
rows.reference: Sanders kwuru na ụkọ nchịkọta akụkọ bụ n’ihi nleda anya maka “nnukwu ọchụchọ nlebanye anya” nke ndị nta akụkọ TV,” agbanyeghi na o kwuru: “Agaghị m ekwenye n’ezie ha na ha na achọ oke nlebanye anya.”

rows.source: She then suggested direct contact between Trump and the press will increase.
rows.output: O wee kwuo na ọ ga-akpọrọ onyeisiala Trump na ndị mgbasa ozi ga-akawanye mma.
rows.reference: Ọ tụnyere nkwukọrịta ozugbo n’etiti Trump na ndị mgbasa ozi ga-agbagote.

rows.source: "The president does more Q&A sessions than any president has prior to him," she said, adding without citing evidence: "We've looked at those numbers."
rows.output: Onye isi ala na-eme ọtụtụ oge ajụjụ na azịza karịa onye isi ala ọ bụla na mbụ, ọ kwuru, na-agbakwụnye na-enweghị ịkpọpụta ihe akaebe: "Anyị leba anya n'ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ahụ."
rows.reference: “Onye isi ala na enwe oge njụrịkọta ajụjụ ọnụ karịa onye isi ala ọ bụla bịara tupu ya,” o kwuru, tinye na arụtụghị aka n’ihe akaebe: “Anyị elenyela anya na nọmba ndị a.”

rows.source: Briefings will still happen, Sanders said, but "if the press has the chance to ask the president of the United States questions directly, that's infinitely better than talking to me.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ga-aga n'ihu, Sanders kwuru, mana "ọ bụrụ na ndị mgbasa ozi nwere ohere ịjụ onye isi ala United States ajụjụ ozugbo, nke ahụ ka mma karịa ikwu okwu na m."
rows.reference: Nchịkọta akụkọ ga na eme, Sanders kwuru, mana “ọ bụrụ na ndị mgbasa ozi nwee ohere ịjụ onye isi ala nke United States ajụjụ ozugbo, nke ahụ ka ịgwa m okwu mma karịa.

rows.source: We try to do that a lot and you've seen us do that a lot over the last few weeks and that's going to take the place of a press briefing when you can talk to the president of the United States."
rows.output: Anyị na-agbalị ime nke ahụ ọtụtụ oge na ị hụla anyị na-eme nke ahụ ọtụtụ oge n'ime izu ole na ole gara aga na nke ahụ ga-anọchi anya nnọkọ ndị nta akụkọ mgbe ị nwere ike ịgwa onye isi ala United States okwu."
rows.reference: Anyị na anwa ịme nke ahụ ọtụtụ oge, unu ahụla ka anyị mere nke ahụ n’izu ole ma ole gara aga, nke ahụ ga-anọchikwa nchịkọta akụkọ mgbe ị nwere ike ịgwa onye isi ala nke United States okwu.”

rows.source: Trump regularly takes questions when leaving the White House or participating in open sessions or press conferences with visiting dignitaries.
rows.output: Trump na-ajụ ajụjụ mgbe ọ na-apụ n'ụlọ ọcha ma ọ bụ na-ekere òkè na nnọkọ mepere emepe ma ọ bụ nnọkọ ndị ọbịa.
rows.reference: Trump kwa oge na aza ajụjụ mgbe ọ na ahapụ White House ma ọ bụ sonye n’oge njụajụjụ ma ọ bụ ọgbakọ ndị mgbasa ozi mgbe enwere ndị mbịambịa ndị ọchịchị.

rows.source: Solo press conferences are rare.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ndị na-ahụ maka mgbasa ozi na-eme nke ọma bụ ihe na-adịghị ahụkebe.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ mgbasa ozi naanị ya anaghị adịkebe.

rows.source: In New York this week the president perhaps demonstrated why, making a freewheeling and at times bizarre appearance before gathered reporters.
rows.output: N'obodo New York n'izu a na-eme ihe ngosi nke onye isi ala, nke nwere ike igosi ihe kpatara ya, na-eme ihe ngosi n'efu na mgbe ụfọdụ ihe na-adịghị mma n'ihu ndị nta akụkọ gbakọtara.
rows.reference: Na New York n’izu a onye isi ala ikekwe kọwara ihe kpatara ya, na eme mpụta na adịghị mma, oge ụfọdụ mpụta jọrọ njọ n’ihu ndị nta akụkọ.

rows.source: Health secretary writes to EU workers at NHS Scotland over Brexit fears
rows.output: Onye isi ala ahụike dere akwụkwọ ozi nye ndị ọrụ EU na NHS Scotland n'ihi nchegbu Brexit
rows.reference: Ọde Akwụkwọ Ahụike degara ndị ọrụ EU akwụkwọ na NHS Scotland maka ihe egwu Brexit

rows.source: The Health Secretary has written to EU staff working in Scotland's NHS to express the country's gratitude and wish for them to stay on post-Brexit.
rows.output: Onye isi ala ahụike ezipụla akwụkwọ ozi nye ndị ọrụ EU na-arụ ọrụ na NHS Scotland iji gosipụta ekele obodo ahụ na ọchịchọ ha ka ha nọrọ n'ọkwa mgbe Brexit gasịrị.
rows.reference: Ọde Akwụkwọ Ahụike edegala akwụkwọ maka ndị ọrụ EU na arụ ọrụ na NHS nke Scotland iji gosi ekele nke obodo ahụ ma rịọ ka ha nọrọ mgbe Brexit gachara.

rows.source: Jeane Freeman MSP sent a letter with less than six months to go until the UK withdraws from the EU.
rows.output: Onye omeiwu Jeane Freeman zigara ozi n'ime ọnwa isii tupu UK apụọ na EU.
rows.reference: Jeane Freeman MSP zigara leta n’ime ọnwa isiii iji ruo mgbe ndị UK ga-apụ na EU.

rows.source: The Scottish Government has already committed to meet the cost of settled status applications for EU citizens working in its devolved public services.
rows.output: Gọọmentị Scotland ekwela nkwa ịkwụ ụgwọ maka itinye akwụkwọ maka ọnọdụ edoziri maka ndị obodo EU na-arụ ọrụ na ọrụ ọha na eze ya nke etiti.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị ndị Scotland ewepụtala onwe ha iji kpuchie ụgwọ nke akwụkwọ anamachọihe ọkwa ndị bigoro n’obodo maka ndị amaala EU n’ọrụ ọhaneze ya ekewara ekewa.

rows.source: In her letter, Ms Freeman wrote: "Over the summer, negotiations between the UK and EU on withdrawal have continued, heading towards expected decisions this autumn.
rows.output: N'akwụkwọ ozi ya, Oriakụ Freeman dere: "N'oge okpomọkụ, mkparịta ụka dị n'etiti UK na EU gbasara ịpụ, na-aga n'ihu n'ụzọ nke a na-atụ anya na mkpebi n'oge mgbụsị akwụkwọ.
rows.reference: Na leta ya, Nwada Freeman dere: “N’oge ọkọchị, ụbụbọ n’etiti UK na EU na nsepụ aka agaala n’ihu, na aga irute mkpebi atụrụ anya n’ọtọm a.

rows.source: But the UK Government has also been stepping up its preparations for a possible no-deal scenario.
rows.output: Mana gọọmentị UK na-akwadokwa nkwadebe ya maka ọnọdụ enweghị nkwekọrịta nwere ike ime.
rows.reference: Mana Gọọmentị UK na ewelitekwa nkwadobe ya maka ọnọdụ enweghị nkwekọrịta ọ bụla.

rows.source: I know this must be a very unsettling time for all of you.
rows.output: Amaara m na nke a ga-abụ oge na-akụda mmụọ nke ukwuu nye unu niile.
rows.reference: Ama m na nke a ga-abụ oge mgbakasị ahụ maka unu niille.

rows.source: That is why I wanted to reiterate now how much I value the contribution of every member of staff, regardless of their nationality.
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere m ji chọọ ịmaliteghachi ugbu a otú m si eche banyere uru dị ukwuu nke onyinye onye ọ bụla n'ime ndị ọrụ, n'agbanyeghị mba ha.
rows.reference: Ya kpatara m ji chọọ ikwuputegharị ugbu a nnukwu ugwu m na akwanyere ndị ọrụ niile maka enyemaka ha, agbanyeghị obodo ha.

rows.source: Colleagues from across the EU, and beyond, bring valuable experience and skills that strengthen and improve the work of the health service, and benefit the patients and communities we serve.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ibe anyị sitere n'ofe EU, na n'èzí, na-eweta ahụmahụ bara uru na nka nke na-eme ka ọrụ ahụike dịkwuo mma, ma na-erite uru ndị ọrịa na obodo anyị na-eje ozi.
rows.reference: Ndị ibe m si n’ofe EU, ma gafere, na eweta ahụmịhe na nka dị mkpa na agbatị ma melite ọrụ nke ọrụ ahụike, ma nyere ndị ọrịa na ogbe anyị na arụrụ ọrụ aka.

rows.source: Scotland is absolutely your home and we very much want you to stay here."
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị mgbe ị ga-ahapụ Scotland, ọ bụ ebe obibi gị n'ezie, anyị na-achọkwa ka ị nọrọ ebe a."
rows.reference: Scotland bụ be gị n’ezie, anyị chọrọ ka unu nọrọ ebe a.”

rows.source: Christion Abercrombie Undergoes Emergency Surgery After Suffering Head Injury
rows.output: Christion Abercrombie na-eme ọgwụgwọ mberede mgbe ọ merụrụ ahụ n'isi
rows.reference: Christion Abercrombie Na Agabiga Ịwa Ahụ Mberede Ka Ọ Nwechara Mmerụ Ahụ N’isi

rows.source: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie underwent emergency surgery after suffering a head injury in Saturday's 31-27 defeat to the Vanderbilt Commodores, the Tennessean's Mike Organ reported.
rows.output: Nwa nwoke Tennessee State Tigers bụ Christion Abercrombie mere ọgwụgwọ mberede mgbe ọ merụrụ ahụ n'isi n'oge mmeri 31-27 na Satọde megide ndị Commodores Vanderbilt, dị ka Tennessean's Mike Organ si kwuo.
rows.reference: Onye azụ nke Tennessee State Tigers Christion Abercrombie mere ịwa ahụ mberede ka ọ nwechara mmerụ ahụ n’ihi na mmeri 31-27 n’aka Vanderbilt Commodores, Mike Organ nke Tennessee kpesara.

rows.source: Tennessee State head coach Rod Reed told reporters the injury happened shortly before halftime.
rows.output: Onye isi nchịkwa Tennessee State bụ Rod Reed gwara ndị nta akụkọ na mmerụ ahụ mere n'oge na-adịghị anya tupu ọkara oge.
rows.reference: Onye isi ndu Tennessee State bụ Rod Reed gwara ndị nta akụkọ na ahụ mmerụ ahụ mere obere oge ka agachara ọkara oge egwuregwu.

rows.source: "He came to the sideline and just kind of collapsed there," Reed said.
rows.output: "Ọ bịara n'akụkụ ma daa n'ebe ahụ," ka Reed kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ bịara n’akụkụ wee tụsa ebe ahụ, “Reed kwuru.

rows.source: Trainers and medical personnel gave Abercrombie oxygen on the sideline before placing him on a stretcher and taking him back for further evaluation.
rows.output: Ndị nkuzi na ndị ọrụ ahụike nyere Abercrombie oxygen n'akụkụ ebe a na-egwu egwuregwu tupu ha etinye ya n'elu akwa ụra ma kpọga ya n'azụ maka nyocha ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ndị ọzụzụ na ndị ahụike nyere Abercrombie oxygen n’akụkụ ahụ tupu edowe ya n’ihe ndọkpụrụ wee buru ya laghachi maka nyocha ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: An official from Tennessee State told Chris Harris of WSMV in Nashville, Tennessee, that Abercrombie was out of surgery at Vanderbilt Medical Center.
rows.output: Onye ọrụ gọọmentị si Tennessee State gwara Chris Harris nke WSMV na Nashville, Tennessee, na Abercrombie si na ụlọ ọgwụ Vanderbilt Medical Center pụta.
rows.reference: Otu onye ọrụ si na Tennessee State gwara Chris Harris nke WSMV dị na Nashville, Tennessee, na Abercrombie apụtala n’ụlọ ịwa ahụ na Vanderbilt Medical Center.

rows.source: Harris added that there are "no details on type/extent of injury yet" and Tennessee State is trying to figure out when the injury occurred.
rows.output: Harris gbakwunyere na enweghị nkọwa banyere ụdị/ogologo mmerụ ahụ ma Tennessee State na-agbalị ịchọpụta mgbe mmerụ ahụ mere.
rows.reference: Harris tinyere na “enwebeghị nkọwapụta n’ụdịrị/ogo nke ahụ mmerụ ahụ” na ndị Tennessee State na anwa ịmata mgbe ahụ mmerụ ahụ mere.

rows.source: Abercrombie, a redshirt sophomore, is in his first season with Tennessee State after transferring from Illinois.
rows.output: Abercrombie, onye nke abụọ na-eyi uwe ọbara ọbara, nọ na oge mbụ ya na Tennessee State mgbe ọ gbanwere site na Illinois.
rows.reference: Abercrombie, onye nke abụọ na kọleji na eyi uwe ọbara ọbara, nọ n’afọ nke izizi ya na Tennessee State ka o sichara Illinois gafete.

rows.source: He had five total tackles Saturday before exiting the game, which brought his season total to 18 tackles.
rows.output: O nwere mkpokọta ise na Satọde tupu ọ pụọ na egwuregwu ahụ, nke mere ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ya n'oge a bụrụ iri na asatọ.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere mgbakọta mgbochi ise na Satọde tupu ọ pụọ n’egwuregwu ahụ, nke wetere mgbakọ afọ asọmpi ya na mgbochi 18.

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK
rows.output: Ndị na-azụ ahịa si mba ọzọ ga-akwụ ụgwọ ụtụ isi stampụ dị elu mgbe ha zụrụ ihe onwunwe na UK
rows.reference: A ga-agba ndị azụmahịa ofesi ụgwọ ọrụ stampụ ka dị elu mgbe ha zụtara akụ n’ime UK

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK with the extra cash used to help the homeless under new Tory plans
rows.output: Ndị na-azụ ahịa si mba ọzọ ga-akwụ ụgwọ stampụ dị elu mgbe ha zụrụ ihe onwunwe na UK, ebe ego a na-enweta ga-enyere ndị na-enweghị ebe obibi aka n'okpuru atụmatụ Tory ọhụrụ.
rows.reference: A ga-agba ndị azụmahịa ofesi ụgwọ ọrụ stampụ ka dị elu mgbe ha zụtara akụ n’ime UK ma jiri ego ahụ mara n’elu wee nyere ndị na enweghị ụlọ aka n’okpuru atụmatụ Tory

rows.source: The move will neutralise the success of Corbyn's drive to attract young voters
rows.output: Mgbanwe a ga-akpochapụ ihe ịga nke ọma nke mbọ Corbyn na-eme iji dọta ndị ntuli aka na-eto eto
rows.reference: Omume ahụ ga-emebi ọganihu nke agbamume Corbyn ịdọta ndị ntuli aka na etolite

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on those who are not paying tax in the UK
rows.output: Ụtụ isi stampụ ga-akwụ ụgwọ ndị na-akwụghị ụtụ isi na UK
rows.reference: A ga-agba ụgwọ mwelite ọrụ stampụ n’isi ndị na anaghị akwụ ụgwọ ụtụ isi na UK

rows.source: The Treasury expects it raise up to £120 million a year- to help the homeless
rows.output: Ụlọ Ọrụ Ego na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ebute ihe ruru nde £120 kwa afọ- iji nyere ndị na-enweghị ebe obibi aka
rows.reference: Ụlọ Akụ na atụ anya ka ọ gbagote nde £120 kwa afọ - iji nyere ndị na enweghị ụlọ aka

rows.source: Foreign buyers are set to be charged a higher stamp duty rate when they buy property in the UK - with the extra cash used to help the homeless, Theresa May will announce today.
rows.output: Ndị na-azụ ahịa si mba ọzọ ga-akwụ ụgwọ ụtụ isi stampụ dị elu mgbe ha zụrụ ihe onwunwe na UK - ebe ego ọzọ a na-enweta ga-enyere ndị na-enweghị ebe obibi aka, Theresa May ga-ekwupụta taa.
rows.reference: A na achọ ịgba ndị azụmahịa ofesi ụgwọ ọrụ stampụ dị elu mgbe ha zụtara akụ n’ime UK - a ga-eji ego mara n’elu wee nyere ndị na enweghị ụlọ aka, Theresa May ga-ekwupute nke a taa.

rows.source: The move will be seen as an attempt to neutralise the success of Jeremy Corbyn's drive to attract young voters with pledges to provide more affordable housing and target high earners.
rows.output: Mgbanwe a ga-ahụ dị ka mbọ iji mebie ihe ịga nke ọma nke ịkwọ ụgbọala Jeremy Corbyn iji dọta ndị ntuli aka na-eto eto na nkwa inye ụlọ ndị na-erite uru na ịtụ anya ndị na-enweta ego dị elu.
rows.reference: A ga-ahụta nke ahụ ka ọnwụnwa iji mebie ọganihu nke agbamume Jeremy Corbyn iji dọta ndị ntuli aka na etolite eto site na iji nkwa ịnyekwu ụlọ dị ọnụ ala ma chụwa ndị na erite nnukwu ụgwọ ọnwa.

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on individuals and firms not paying tax in the UK, with the extra money boosting the Government's drive to combat rough sleeping.
rows.output: Ụtụ isi stampụ ahụ ga-akwụ ụgwọ n'ahụ ndị mmadụ na ụlọ ọrụ na-akwụghị ụtụ isi na UK, na ego ọzọ a ga-eme ka gọọmentị na-agba mbọ ịlụso ụra n'okporo ámá ọgụ.
rows.reference: A ga-agba ụgwọ ọrụ stampụ n’isi ndị mmadụ na ụlọ ọrụ ndị na anaghị akwụ ụgwọ ụtụ isi na UK, ego mara n’elu ga-ebuwanye mbọ Gọọmentị iji luso enweghị ụlọ agha.

rows.source: The surcharge - which is in addition to the present stamp duty, including the higher levels introduced two years ago on second homes and buy-to-lets - could be as much as three per cent.
rows.output: Ụgwọ ọzọ - nke dị n'elu ụtụ isi stampụ dị ugbu a, gụnyere ọkwa dị elu e webatara afọ abụọ gara aga na ụlọ nke abụọ na ụlọ ịkwụ ụgwọ - nwere ike ịbụ ihe ruru pasent atọ.
rows.reference: Mgbakwunye ụgwọ ahụ - nke bụ mgbakwunye n’ọrụ stampụ dị ugbu a, gụnyere ọkwa ndị dị elu ebubatara n’afọ abụọ gara aga n’ụlọ nke abụọ yana ịzụta-maka-ịgbazinye - nwere ike irucha pasentị atọ.

rows.source: The Treasury expects the move to raise up to £120 million a year.
rows.output: Ụlọ Ọrụ Ego na-atụ anya na mmegharị ahụ ga-ebute ihe ruru nde £120 kwa afọ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ Akụ na atụ anya ka ọ gbagote nde £120 kwa afọ.

rows.source: An estimated 13 per cent of new-build London properties are bought by non-UK residents, driving up prices and making it harder for first-time buyers to get a foot on the housing ladder.
rows.output: N'ime ihe dị ka pasentị iri na atọ nke ụlọ ọhụrụ London, ndị na-abụghị ndị bi na UK na-azụta, na-ebuli ọnụ ahịa ma na-eme ka ọ dịkwuo ihe isi ike maka ndị na-azụ ụlọ mbụ ịbanye n'ọkwa ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ekpebiri na pasentị 13 bụ ndị na abụghị ndị bi na UK na azụta akụ ndị London arụrụ ọhụrụ, na ebugo ụgwọ ma na eme ka o sie ike maka ndị na eme nzụta izizi ha iji nweta ọganihu n’nzọụkwụ obibi ụlọ.

rows.source: Many wealthy areas of the country - particularly in the capital - have become "ghost towns" because of the high number of foreign buyers who spend most of their time out of the country.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ mpaghara ọgaranya nke mba ahụ - karịsịa n'isi obodo - aghọwo "obodo ndị mmụọ" n'ihi ọnụ ọgụgụ dị elu nke ndị na-azụ ahịa si mba ọzọ bụ ndị na-eji oge buru ibu n'èzí obodo ahụ.
rows.reference: Imirikiti mpaghara ndị nwere ego n’obodo ahụ - karịchara n’isi ala - nwere “ime obodo tọgbọ nkịtị” n’ihi ọnụọgụ nke ndị nzụta ofesi dị elu, ndị na anọ ọtụtụ oge ha na mpụga nke obodo ahụ.

rows.source: The new policy comes just weeks after Boris Johnson called for a stamp duty cut to help more young people own their first home.
rows.output: Nke a na-eme n'oge na-adịbeghị anya ka Boris Johnson kpọrọ oku ka e belata ụtụ isi stampụ iji nyere ọtụtụ ndị na-eto eto aka inwe ụlọ mbụ ha.
rows.reference: Iwu ọhụrụ ahụ na abịa n’izu ole ma ole ka Boris Johnson kpọchara oku maka mgbubi n’ọrụ stampụ iji nyere ndị ntorobịa aka ịnwe ụlọ izizi nke ha.

rows.source: He accused big construction firms of keeping property prices high by snapping up land but not using it, and urged Mrs May to abandon quotas on affordable homes to fix Britain's "housing disgrace."
rows.output: O boro ndị ụlọ ọrụ owuwu buru ibu ebubo na ha na-eme ka ọnụ ahịa ihe onwunwe dị elu site n’ịzụta ala ma ọ bụghị iji ya, ma gwa Oriakụ May ka ọ hapụ oke ụlọ dị ọnụ ala iji dozie “ihere ụlọ obibi Britain.”
rows.reference: O boro ndị nnukwu ụlọ ọrụ nrụpụta ebubo maka idowe akụ n’ọnụego dị elu site na ịnapụ ala mana ha anaghị eji ya, ma rịọ Nwada May ka ọ hapụ oke n’ụlọ ndị dị ọnụ ala iji dozie “ihere ụlọ obibi” nke Britain.

rows.source: Mr Corbyn has announced an eye-catching series of proposed housing reforms, including rent controls and an end to "no-fault" evictions.
rows.output: Mazi Corbyn ekwuputala usoro mgbanwe ụlọ na-adọrọ mmasị, gụnyere njikwa ụgwọ ụlọ na njedebe nke "enweghị mmejọ" ịpụpụ.
rows.reference: Maazị Corbyn ekwuputela usoro mmezi ụlọ obibi na adọta ntinye uche, gụnyere njikwa ụgwọ ụlọ yana nkwụsị nke nchụpụ “abụghị ụta mmadụ”.

rows.source: He also wants to give councils greater powers to build new homes.
rows.output: Ọ na-achọkwa inye ndị kansụl ike ka ha wuo ụlọ ọhụrụ.
rows.reference: Ọ chọkwara ịnyekwu ndị kansụl ikike iji rụpụta ụlọ ọhụrụ.

rows.source: Mrs May said: "Last year I said I would dedicate my premiership to restoring the British dream - that life should be better for each new generation.
rows.output: Nwunye May kwuru: "N'afọ gara aga, ekwuru m na m ga-etinye ọchịchị m n'ịkwado nrọ Britain - na ndụ kwesịrị ịdị mma maka ọgbọ ọ bụla ọhụrụ.
rows.reference: Nwada May kwuru: “Afọ gara aga m kwuru m ga-ewepụta ọchịchị m iji weghachite nrọ Britain - ndụ ahụ kwesịrị ka mma maka agbụrụ ọhụrụ ọ bụla.

rows.source: And that means fixing our broken housing market.
rows.output: Na nke ahụ pụtara ịrụzi ahịa ụlọ anyị gbajiri agbaji.
rows.reference: Ma nke ahụ pụtara idozi ahịa ụlọ obibi anyị mebiri emebi.

rows.source: Britain will always be open to people who want to live, work and build a life here.
rows.output: Britain ga-anọgide na-emeghe maka ndị chọrọ ibi, rụọ ọrụ na wuo ndụ ebe a.
rows.reference: Britain ga-ekpughere oge niile maka ndị mmadụ chọrọ ibi, rụọ ọrụ ma bido ndụ ebe a.

rows.source: However, it cannot be right that it is as easy for individuals who don't live in the UK, as well as foreign-based companies, to buy homes as hard-working British residents.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mma na ọ dị mfe ka ndị na-adịghị ebi na UK na ụlọ ọrụ mba ofesi nwee ike ịzụ ụlọ dịka ndị bi na UK na-arụsi ọrụ ike.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, ọ nweghị ike ịdị mma na ọ dị mfe maka ndị mmadụ na ebighi n’ime UK, yanakwa ụlọ ọrụ ndị ofesi, iji zụta ụlọ ka ndị obibi Britain na arụsị ọrụ ike.

rows.source: For too many people the dream of home ownership has become all too distant, and the indignity of rough sleeping remains all too real."
rows.output: N'ihi na ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ, nrọ nke inwe ụlọ nke ha abụrụla ihe dị anya nke ukwuu, na ihere nke ịrahụ ụra n'èzí ka dịkwa ezigbo eziokwu."
rows.reference: Maka ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ, nrọ nke ịnwe ụlọ nke ha bụzị ihe ọ nọ nso eru aka, mmetọ nke enweghị ebe obibi bụzị ihe dị ire.”

rows.source: Jack Ross: 'My ultimate ambition is to manage Scotland'
rows.output: Jack Ross: 'Ọchịchọ kachasị m bụ ijikwa Scotland'
rows.reference: Jack Ross: ‘Ọchịchọ m kachasị bụ ijikwa Scotland’

rows.source: Sunderland boss Jack Ross says his "ultimate ambition" is to become the Scotland manager at some stage.
rows.output: Onye njikwa Sunderland, Jack Ross, kwuru na ọchịchọ ya kachasị bụ ịbụ onye njikwa Scotland n'oge ụfọdụ.
rows.reference: Onye isi nke Sunderland Jack Ross kwuru na “ọchịchọ ya kachasị” bụ ịbụrụ onye ndu Scotland otu oge.

rows.source: The Scot, 42, is relishing the challenge of reviving the North-East club, who currently sit third place in League One, three points off the top.
rows.output: Onye Scotland dị afọ iri anọ na abụọ na-enwe mmasị n'ịzọpụta klọb North-East, bụ nke nọ ugbu a n'ọkwa nke atọ na League One, n'ime isi atọ nke ọkwa kachasị elu.
rows.reference: Onye Scotland ahụ, 42, na enwe obi ụtọ maka mgba nke iweghachite otu asọmpi North-East, ndị nọ ugbu a n’ọkwa atọ na League One, akara atọ n’okpuru nke isi.

rows.source: He moved to the Stadium of Light this summer after guiding St Mirren back to the Scottish Premiership last season.
rows.output: O kwagara n'ámá egwuregwu nke ìhè n'oge okpomọkụ a ka o duuru St Mirren laghachi na Scottish Premiership n'oge ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Ọ gara na Stadium of Light n’ọkọchị a ka o duchara St Mirren laghachite na Scottish Premiership n’afọ asọmpi gara aga.

rows.source: "I wanted to play for my country as a player.
rows.output: "Ọ chọrọ ịgba bọọlụ maka obodo m dịka onye ọkpụkpọ.
rows.reference: “Achọburu m ịgbara obodo m bọọlụ ka m bụ onye egwu.

rows.source: I got a B cap and that was it," Ross told BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.output: M nwetara B cap na nke ahụ bụ ya," Ross gwara BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.reference: Enwetara m cap B nke ahụ bụ ya,” Ross gwara Sportsound nke BBC Scotland.

rows.source: "But I grew up watching Scotland at Hampden a lot with my dad as a kid, and it is always something that has drawn me back.
rows.output: "Ma mụ na-eto eto na-ekiri Scotland na Hampden a otutu, na ọ bụ ihe na-adọrọ mmasị m mgbe niile.
rows.reference: “Mana etolitere m na elele Scotland na Hampden ọtụtụ oge, mụ na nna m ka m bụ nwata, ọ bụ ihe na adọghachi m oge niile.

rows.source: That opportunity would only come, though, if I am successful in club management."
rows.output: Nke ahụ ga-abịa nanị ma ọ bụrụ na m ga-aga nke ọma n'ọrụ nchịkwa klọb."
rows.reference: Ohere ahụ ga-abịa, agbanyeghị, ọ bụrụ na m mee nke ọma na njikwa otu egwuregwu.”

rows.source: Ross's predecessors as Sunderland manager include Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet and Paulo Di Canio.
rows.output: Ndị bu Ross n'ọkwa onye njikwa Sunderland gụnyere Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet na Paulo Di Canio.
rows.reference: Ndị bịara tupu Ross ka onye ndu Sunderland gụnyere Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gue Poyet na Paulo Di Canio.

rows.source: The former Alloa Athletic boss says he felt no trepidation in following such established names at such a big club, having previously rejected overtures from Barnsley and Ipswich Town.
rows.output: Onye bụbu onye njikwa Alloa Athletic kwuru na ọ nweghị nchegbu ọ bụla n'ịgbaso aha ndị a ma ama n'otu nnukwu klọb, ebe ọ jụrụ ịkpọ oku sitere na Barnsley na Ipswich Town.
rows.reference: Onye isi nke Alloa Athletic gara aga kwuru na ọ naghị enwe ụjọ n’isochi aha ndị ahụ ama ama n’ụdịrị nnukwu otu ahụ, ka ọ jụchara arịrịọ ndị si na Barnsley na Ipswich Town.

rows.source: "Success for me at the moment will be gauged by 'can I return this club to the Premier League?'
rows.output: "Ọganihu maka m ugbu a ga-ekpebi site na 'enwere m ike iweghachi klọb a na Premier League?'
rows.reference: “Ọganihu maka m n’oge a ka a ga-atụ site na “enwere m ike idughachi otu a na Premier League?’

rows.source: Because of the structure and facilities at this club, it undoubtedly belongs in the Premier League," he said.
rows.output: N'ihi nhazi na ihe eji eme ihe n'ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ a, ọ dịghị ihe ọ bụla na-ekwesịghị ekwesị na Premier League," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: N’ihi nyiwe na ụlọ nke otu a, na enweghị mgbagha kwesịrị ịnọ na Premier League,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "It is not an easy task to get it there, but I would probably only view myself as being successful here if I can get the club back there."
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị mfe ịrụ ọrụ a, mana ọ ga-abụ na m ga-ele onwe m anya na m nwere ihe ịga nke ọma ebe a ma ọ bụrụ na m nwere ike ịlaghachi n'òtù ahụ ebe ahụ."
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị ọrụ dị mfe iji laghachi ebe ahụ, mana enwere naanị ike ịhụta onwe m ka onye mere nke ọma ebe a ma ọ bụrụ na m nwere ike idughachi otu ahụ ebe ahụ.”

rows.source: Ross is only three years into his management career, after a period as assistant boss at Dumbarton and a 15-month spell on Hearts' coaching staff.
rows.output: Ross dị naanị afọ atọ n'ọrụ ọchịchị ya, mgbe oge dị ka onye enyemaka onye isi na Dumbarton na ọnwa iri na ise na ndị otu nchịkwa nke Hearts.
rows.reference: Ross nọ naanị afọ atọ n’ọrụ njikwa ya, ka obere oge gachara ka onye enyemaka na Dumbarton yana ọnụnọ ọnwa 15 n’otu ndị ọrụ Hearts.

rows.source: He then helped Alloa recover from relegation to the third tier, and transformed St Mirren from the brink of relegation to Championship title winners the following season.
rows.output: Mgbe ahụ, o nyere Alloa aka ịgbake site na mbelata na ọkwa nke atọ, ma gbanwee St Mirren site na ọnọdụ mbelata na ndị mmeri nke Championship n'afọ na-esote.
rows.reference: Ọ gara nyere Alloa aka ịlaghachite na mgbatu ha gara n’ọkwa nke atọ, ma tụgharịa St Mirren site n’isi nke mgbatu gaa na mmeri iko Championship n’afọ asọmpi sotere.

rows.source: And Ross says he feels more comfortable now than he ever did during his playing career at Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren and Hamilton Academical.
rows.output: Na Ross kwuru na ọ na-enwekwu ahụ iru ala ugbu a karịa ka ọ na-enwe n'oge ọ na-egwu egwuregwu na Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren na Hamilton Academical.
rows.reference: Ma Ross kwuru na ọ nwere obi ume ala ugbu a karia ka ọ nwere n’oge onye egwu ya na Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren na Hamilton Academical.

rows.source: "It was probably a real crossroads," he recalled, of taking charge of Alloa.
rows.output: "Ọ bụ ikekwe ebe dị mkpa," ka o chetara, banyere ịnara ọrụ Alloa.
rows.reference: “Ọ nwere ike ịbụ ezi njikọ,” ọ chetere, ịweghara ikike na Alloa.

rows.source: "I genuinely did believe management was the right fit for me, more so than playing.
rows.output: "Ekwenyere m n'ezie na njikwa bụ nhọrọ ziri ezi maka m, karịa ịgba bọọlụ.
rows.reference: “Ekwenyere n’ezie na njikwa bụ ihe ziri m nke ọma, karịa ịgba agba.

rows.source: It sounds bizarre because I did okay, made a reasonable living out of it, and enjoyed some reasonable highs.
rows.output: Ọ dị iche n'ihi na m mere nke ọma, nwetara ndụ dị mma n'ime ya, ma nwee ụfọdụ elu dị mma.
rows.reference: Ọ dara ka ihe ọjọọ n’ihi na m mere nke ọma, ebiri ezigbo ndụ na ya, ma nwee ọhụụ ụfọdụ ihe ndị elu dị mma.

rows.source: But playing can be tough.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-egwu egwuregwu nwere ike isi ike.
rows.reference: Mana ịgba agba na esi ike.

rows.source: There are a lot of things you have to get through on a weekly basis.
rows.output: Enwere ọtụtụ ihe ị ga-agafe kwa izu.
rows.reference: Enwere ọtụtụ ihe ị ga-agafere kwa izu.

rows.source: I still go through that in terms of the stresses and pressure of the job but management just feels right.
rows.output: M ka na-aga n'ihu nke ahụ n'ihe gbasara nrụgide na nrụgide nke ọrụ mana njikwa na-adị mma.
rows.reference: M ka na agafe nke ahụ n’okwu nke nsogbu na ndagide nke ọrụ ahụ mana njikwa dị mma n’anya.

rows.source: I always wanted to manage and now I am doing it, it feels the most comfortable I have been in my own skin throughout my entire adult life."
rows.output: M na-achọ mgbe niile ijikwa ma ugbu a, m na-eme ya, ọ na-adị m ka ọ dị m mma karịa ka m na-eyi uwe m n'oge ndụ m niile dị ka okenye."
rows.reference: Bido na mbụ achọrọ m ịme njikwa, ugbu a ana m eme ya, ọ kachasị enye m mmetụta obi ume ala, abụ m onwe m na ndụ okenye m niile.”

rows.source: You can listen to the full interview on Sportsound on Sunday, 30 September, on Radio Scotland between 12:00 and 13:00 BST
rows.output: Ị nwere ike ige ihe niile na ajụjụ ọnụ na Sportsound na Sọnde, 30 Septemba, na Radio Scotland n'etiti elekere iri na abụọ na elekere iri na atọ nke BST.
rows.reference: Ị nwere ike ịge njụajụjụ ọnụ ahụ n’uju na Sportsound na Sọnde, Septemba 30, na Radio Scotland n’oge 12:00 na 13:00 BST

rows.source: Perfect time for a pint is 5.30pm on a Saturday, survey finds
rows.output: Oge zuru oke maka otu iko bụ elekere ise nke iri atọ na puku na Satọde, nyocha chọpụtara.
rows.reference: Oge kachasị mma maka pint bụ 5:30 mgbede na Satọde, nyocha kwuru

rows.source: The summer heatwave has boosted takings for Britain's struggling pubs but heaped more pressure on restaurant chains.
rows.output: Okpomọkụ nke okpomọkụ emeela ka ọ dịkwuo mma maka ụlọ mmanya na-alụ ọgụ na Britain, ma mụbaa nrụgide na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.
rows.reference: Okpomọkụ ọkọchị etipuola ego maka ụlọ mmanya ndị Britain ndị na aghọ ada mana dosakwuo nsogbu n’elu ndị azụmahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.

rows.source: Pub and bar groups saw sales rise 2.7 per cent in July - but takings in restaurants were down 4.8 per cent, figures revealed.
rows.output: Ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ mmanya hụrụ mmụba nke 2.7 pasent na Julaị - mana ihe a na-enweta n'ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dara pasent 4.8, akwụkwọ akụkọ gosiri.
rows.reference: Otu ndị ụlọ mmanya hụrụ ka ahịa rịgoro pasentị 2.7 na Julaị - mana nrite n’ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dara pasentị 4.8, ọnụọgụ gosiri.

rows.source: Peter Martin, of business consultancy CGA, which compiled the figures, said: "Continued sunshine and England's longer than expected participation in the World Cup meant July followed a similar pattern to the previous month of June, when pubs were up 2.8 per cent, except that restaurants were hit even harder.
rows.output: Peter Martin, onye ọrụ azụmahịa nke CGA, bụ́ ndị chịkọtara ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ahụ, kwuru: "Anwụ na-acha n'ihu na England na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe a na-atụ anya ya na World Cup pụtara na Julaị soro ụdị ọnwa gara aga nke June, mgbe ụlọ mmanya na-arị elu 2.8 pasent, ewezuga na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na-ata ahụhụ karịa."
rows.reference: Peter Martin, nke ndị ndụmọdụ azụmahịa CGA, nke kpokọrọ ọnụọgụ ahụ, kwuru: “Anyanwụ ka dị yana nsonye England na World Cup toro ogologo ole atụrụ anya pụtara na Julaị sochiri otu usoro ka ọnwa nke Juun gara aga, mgbe ụlọ mmanya rịgoro pasentị 2.8, belụsọ na ndị ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ nwere nnukwu nhịahụ.

rows.source: The fall of 1.8 per cent in restaurant trading in June just got worse in July.
rows.output: Igbo: Mbelata nke 1.8 pasent na azụmahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na June ka njọ na Julaị.
rows.reference: Nrịda nke pasentị 1.8 n’azụmahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na Juun kawanyere njọ na Julai.

rows.source: Drink-led pubs and bars performed by far the strongest with like-for-likes up more than restaurants were down.
rows.output: Ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ mmanya ndị na-eme mmanya na-eme ihe kacha mma, na ndị dị ka ndị ọzọ na-ada ala.
rows.reference: Ụlọ mmanya kachasị mee nke ọma otu yitere ihe dị ka otu ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ si gbadaa.

rows.source: Food-led pubs also suffered in the sun, although not as dramatically as the restaurant operators.
rows.output: Ụlọ mmanya ndị na-eri nri nwekwara nsogbu n'ọkụ anyanwụ, ọ bụ ezie na ọ bụghị nke ukwuu dị ka ndị na-arụ ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ mmanya na ere nri tara ahụhụ n’anyanwụ, mana ọbụghị ka nke ndị na azụ ahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.

rows.source: It seems people just wanted to go out for a drink.
rows.output: Ọ dị ka ndị mmadụ na-achọsi ike ịpụ maka mmanya.
rows.reference: Ọ dị ka ndị mmadụ chọrọ ịpụ ṅwụọ mmanya.

rows.source: Across managed pubs and bars drink sales were up 6.6 per cent for the month, with food down three per cent."
rows.output: N'ofe ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ mmanya ndị a na-achịkwa, ahịa mmanya mụbara pasentị 6.6 maka ọnwa ahụ, ebe nri dara pasentị atọ."
rows.reference: N’ofe ụlọ mmanya ndị a na ejikwa ọrịre mmanya rịgoro pasentị 6.6 maka ọnwa ahụ, ebe nri rịdara pasenti atọ.”

rows.source: Paul Newman, of leisure and hospitality analysts RSM said: "These results continue the trend we've seen since the end of April.
rows.output: Paul Newman, onye nyocha oge ntụrụndụ na ọbịa RSM kwuru: "Nsonaazụ ndị a na-aga n'ihu na-aga n'ihu anyị hụrụ kemgbe njedebe nke Eprel.
rows.reference: Paul Newman, nke ntụrụndụ na nlekọta onye nyocha RSM kwuru: “Nsonaazụ ndị a sochiri usoro ahụ anyị hụrụ kemgbe ngwụcha nke Eprel.

rows.source: Weather and the impact of major social or sporting events remain the biggest factors when it comes to sales in the out-of-home market.
rows.output: Ihe ihu igwe na mmetụta nke nnukwu mmemme mmekọrịta ma ọ bụ egwuregwu ka bụ ihe kacha mkpa mgbe ọ na-abịa na ire ahịa n'èzí ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ihuigwe na mmetụta nke mmemme mmerịkọta ma ọ bụ egwuregwu ndị dị ukwuu ka bụkwa nnukwu mmetụta mgbe ọ bịara n’ọrịre n’ahịa ndị apụrụ n’ụlọ.

rows.source: It comes as no surprise that restaurant groups continue to struggle, albeit a sales drop of 4.8 per cent year-on-year will be particularly painful on top of ongoing cost pressures.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị ihe ijuanya na otu ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na-aga n'ihu na-agbasi mbọ ike, n'agbanyeghị na mbelata ire ere nke 4.8 pasent kwa afọ ga-adị oke egwu n'elu nrụgide ọnụahịa na-aga n'ihu.
rows.reference: Ọ naghị abịa ka ihe ntụnanya na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ gara n’ihu na aghọ ada, agbanyeghị nrịda ọrịre nke pasentị 4.8 kwa afọ kwa afọ ga-abụ ihe nnukwu mgbu n’elu ndagide ụgwọ na aga ugbu a.

rows.source: The long hot summer could not have come at a worse time for food-led operators and time will tell whether the more moderate temperatures we've experienced in August will provide some much-needed respite."
rows.output: Oge okpomọkụ na-ekpo ọkụ nke ukwuu enweghị ike ịbịa n'oge ka njọ maka ndị na-ahụ maka nri na oge ga-egosi ma okpomọkụ dị n'etiti nke anyị nwetara na Ọgọst ga-enye ụfọdụ ihe na-eme ka ọ dịkwuo mma."
rows.reference: Okpomọkụ ogologo ọkọchị ahụ enweghị ike ịbịa n’oge jọrọ njọ maka ndị na ere nri, mana oge ga-ekwu ma temprechọ dịtụ mma enwere na Ọgọst a ga-eweta ụfọdụ ezumike achọrọ.”

rows.source: Total sales growth across pub and restaurants, including new openings, was 2.7 per cent in July, reflecting the slow down in brand roll-outs.
rows.output: Mmụba nke ire ere n'ozuzu n'ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ, gụnyere mmeghe ọhụrụ, bụ 2.7 pasent na Julaị, na-egosipụta nkwụsịtụ na mgbasa ozi nke ika.
rows.reference: Mgbakọta ntolite ọrịre n’ofe ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ, gụnyere ndị mepere ọhụrụ, bụ pasentị 2.7 na Julaị, na egosi mgbatu na mbupute azụmahịa ọhụrụ.

rows.source: The Coffer Peach Tracker industry sales monitor for the UK pub, bar and restaurant sector collects and analyses performance data from 47 operating groups, with a combined turnover of over £9 billion, and is the established industry benchmark.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Coffer Peach Tracker na-achịkọta na nyocha data arụmọrụ sitere na 47 ụlọ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ, nwere mkpokọta ntụgharị nke ihe karịrị ijeri £9, ma bụrụkwa ihe nrịbama ụlọ ọrụ a na-ahụkarị.
rows.reference: Nyocha azụmahịa ụlọ ọrụ Coffer Peach Tracker maka ụlọ mmanya UK, ngalaba ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na anakọta ma nyochaa data arụmọrụ site na otu nrụọrụ 47, site na ịnwe ọmụrụnwa ekpokọtara gafere ijeri £9, nke ahụ bụ akara ụlọ ọrụ atọrọ.

rows.source: One in five children have secret social media accounts that they hide from their parents
rows.output: Otu n'ime ụmụaka ise nwere akaụntụ mgbasa ozi nzuzo nke ha na-ezobe n'aka ndị mụrụ ha
rows.reference: Otu n’ime ụmụaka ise nwere akaụntụ ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze ezoro ezo nke ha na ezonarị nne na nna ha

rows.source: One in five children - some as young as 11 - have secret social media accounts that they hide from their parents and teachers, survey reveals
rows.output: Otu n'ime ụmụaka ise - ụfọdụ dị ka afọ 11 - nwere akaụntụ mgbasa ozi nzuzo nke ha na-ezobe n'aka ndị mụrụ ha na ndị nkụzi, nyocha na-ekpughe
rows.reference: Otu n’ime ụmụaka ise - ụfọdụ erubeghị afọ 11 - nwere akaụntụ ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze ha na ezonarị nne na nna na ndị nkuzi ha, nyocha gosiri

rows.source: Survey of 20,000 secondary school pupils revealed growth in "fake Insta" pages
rows.output: Nnyocha nke 20,000 ụmụ akwụkwọ sekọndrị gosiri uto nke ibe "fake Insta"
rows.reference: Nyocha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndịrị 20,000 gosiri ntolite n’ibe “Insta adịgboroja”

rows.source: The news has heightened fears that sexual content is being posted
rows.output: Ihe ndị a kọrọ akọwara na ụjọ na-abawanye na ọdịnaya mmekọahụ na-ebipụta
rows.reference: Akụkọ ahụ agbalitela ụjọ na a na ebisa ọdịnaya mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị

rows.source: Twenty per cent of pupils said they have a "main" account to show parents
rows.output: Puku iri abụọ n'ime puku iri n'ime ụmụ akwụkwọ ahụ kwuru na ha nwere "isi" akaụntụ iji gosi ndị nne na nna ha
rows.reference: Pasentị iri abụọ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ kwuru na ha nwere “isi” akaụntụ iji gosi nne na nna

rows.source: One in five children - some as young as 11 - are creating social media accounts that they keep secret from adults.
rows.output: Otu n'ime ụmụaka ise - ụfọdụ dị ka afọ 11 - na-emepụta akaụntụ mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta nke ha na-echebe n'aka ndị okenye.
rows.reference: Otu n’ime ụmụaka ise - ụfọdụ na erubeghị afọ 11 - na emepụta akaụntụ ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze nke ha na ezonarị ndị okenye.

rows.source: A survey of 20,000 secondary school pupils revealed a rapid growth in "fake Insta" accounts - a reference to photo-sharing site Instagram.
rows.output: Nnyocha nke 20,000 ụmụ akwụkwọ sekọndrị gosiri na ọ na-eto ngwa ngwa n'ime akaụntụ "fake Insta" - nke na-ezo aka na webụsaịtị ịkekọrịta foto Instagram.
rows.reference: Nyocha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndịrị 20,000 gosiri ntolite ngwangwa n’akaụntụ “Insta adịgboroja” - nrụtụ aka na saịtị nkekọrịta-foto Instagram.

rows.source: The news has heightened fears that sexual content is being posted.
rows.output: Ihe ndị a kọrọ akọwara na ụjọ na-abawanye na ọdịnaya mmekọahụ na-ebipụta.
rows.reference: Akụkọ ahụ agbalitela ụjọ na a na ebisa ọdịnaya mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị.

rows.source: Twenty per cent of pupils said they operate a sanitised "main" account to show parents, while also having private ones.
rows.output: Puku iri abụọ n'ime puku iri na ise nke ụmụ akwụkwọ kwuru na ha na-arụ ọrụ aka "isi" nke a na-eme ka ọ dị ọcha iji gosi ndị mụrụ ha, ebe ha na-enwekwa nke onwe ha.
rows.reference: Pasentị iri abụọ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ kwuru na ha na ejikwa “isi” akaụntụ dị ọcha iji gosi nne na nna, ma na enwekwa nke nzuzo.

rows.source: One mother who stumbled across her 13-year-old's daughter's secret site found a teenager urging others to "rape me."
rows.output: Nne otu nne nke chọtara nwa ya nwanyị dị afọ iri na atọ n'ụlọ ọrụ nzuzo ya hụrụ otu nwa agbọghọ na-agba ndị ọzọ ume "ịkwa m."
rows.reference: Otu nne dakwutere saịtị nzuzo nke nwa nwanyị ya dị afọ 13 hụrụ ka otu nwa agbọghọ na akwa ndị ọzọ ka ha “nwakpuo ya.”

rows.source: The research, by Digital Awareness UK and the Headmasters" and Headmistresses" Conference (HMC) of independent schools, found 40 per cent of 11 to 18-year-olds had two profiles, with half of those admitting to keeping private accounts.
rows.output: Nnyocha ahụ, nke Digital Awareness UK na Nzukọ Ndị Isi Ụlọ Akwụkwọ (HMC) nke ụlọ akwụkwọ onwe ha mere, chọpụtara na 40 pasent nke ụmụaka dị afọ 11 ruo 18 nwere profaịlụ abụọ, ebe ọkara n'ime ha kwetara na ha na-edobe akaụntụ nzuzo.
rows.reference: Nyocha ahụ, si n’aka Digital Awareness UK yana Headmasters” and Headmistresses” Conference (HMC) nke ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe, hụrụ pasentị 40 nke ndị afọ 11 ruo 18 nwere profaịlụ abụọ, n’ebe ọkara kwenyere na ha nwere akaụntụ nzuzo.

rows.source: HMC chief Mike Buchanan said: "It's disturbing so many teenagers are tempted into creating online spaces where parents and teachers cannot find them."
rows.output: Onye isi HMC Mike Buchanan kwuru: "Ọ na-ewute na ọtụtụ ndị na-eto eto na-achọ ịmepụta oghere n'ịntanetị ebe ndị nne na nna na ndị nkuzi enweghị ike ịchọta ha."
rows.reference: Onye isi HMC Mike Buchanan kwuru: “Ọ na atụ ụjọ na ọtụtụ ndị ntorobịa na anwa ịmepụta oghere n’ịntanetị ebe ndị nne na nna na ndị nkuzi enweghị ike ịchọta ha.”

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle will be "voice for athletes" on Scottish Athletics board
rows.output: Eilidh Doyle ga-abụ "olu maka ndị na-eme egwuregwu" na bọọdụ Scottish Athletics
rows.reference: Eilidh Doyle ga-abụ “olu ndị asọmpi” na oche Ndị Asọmpi Scotland

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle has been elected to the board of Scottish Athletics as a non-executive director at the governing body's annual general meeting.
rows.output: Eilidh Doyle ahọpụtala ka ọ bụrụ onye nduzi na-abụghị onye na-ahụ maka ọrụ na Scottish Athletics na nzukọ izugbe nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kwa afọ.
rows.reference: Ahọpụtala Eilidh Doyle n’otu ndị isi oche nke Ndị Asọmpi Scotland ka onye nduzi na abụghị onye isi na nzụkọ ọgbakọ kwa afọ nke otu nchịkwa.

rows.source: Doyle is Scotland's most decorated track and field athlete and chairman Ian Beattie described the move as a great opportunity for those guiding the sport to benefit from her wide-ranging experience at international level over the past decade.
rows.output: Doyle bụ onye egwuregwu egwuregwu kachasị nwee ihe nrite na Scotland, na onyeisi oche Ian Beattie kọwara mmegharị ahụ dị ka ohere dị ukwuu maka ndị na-eduzi egwuregwu ahụ iji nweta ahụmahụ dị iche iche ya na ọkwa mba ụwa n'ime afọ iri gara aga.
rows.reference: Doyle bụ onye asọmpi nke Scotland kachasị nweta ihe nrite, onye isi Ian Beattle kọwara mmereme ahụ ka nnukwu ohere maka ndị ahụ na edu egwuregwu ahụ iji nwete elele n’ahụmịhe ya gbasara agbasa n’ọkwa ofesi gafere afọ iri gara aga.

rows.source: "Eilidh has massive respect across the Scottish, UK and world athletics community and we are sure athletics in Scotland would benefit hugely by bringing her on to the board," Beattie said.
rows.output: "Eilidh nwere nnukwu nkwanye ugwu n'etiti ndị Scotland, UK na obodo ịgba ọsọ n'ụwa niile, anyị kwenyere na ịgba ọsọ na Scotland ga-erite uru nke ukwuu site n'itinye ya n'òtù ndị ọchịchị."
rows.reference: “Eilidh nwere nsọpụrụ buru ibu n’ofe ogbe ndị asọmpi Scotland, UK na ụwa gburugburu, doro anyị anya na asọmpi na Scotland ga-enweta nnukwu elele site na ịwebata ya n’oche ha,” Beattie kwuru.

rows.source: Doyle said: "I am keen to act as a voice for athletes and I am hoping I can really contribute and help guide the sport in Scotland."
rows.output: Doyle kwuru: "Ana m enwe mmasị ịrụ ọrụ dị ka olu ndị na-eme egwuregwu ma enwere m olileanya na m nwere ike inye aka nke ukwuu ma duzie egwuregwu ahụ na Scotland."
rows.reference: Doyle kwuru: “Enwere m mmasị ịrụ ọrụ ka olu ndị asọmpi, m na atụ anya na m nwere ike ịnyere aka n’ezie ma nyere aka duzie egwuregwu n’ime Scotland.”

rows.source: The American, who won the 200 metres and 400 metres at the 1996 Games in Atlanta among his total of four Olympic golds and is now a regular BBC pundit, was left unable to walk after suffering a transient ischemic attack.
rows.output: Onye America ahụ, onye meriri 200 mita na 400 mita n'egwuregwu 1996 n'Atlanta n'etiti ọla edo Olympic anọ ya, ma bụrụ onye na-akọrọ BBC mgbe niile, enweghị ike ịga ije mgbe ọ nwetara ọrịa ischemic na-adịghị akwụsị akwụsị.
rows.reference: Onye America, meriri mita 200 na mita 400 na Egwuregwu 1996 na Atlanta n’ime mgbakọta nke ọla-edo Olympic ano ya, ugbu a bụ onye ọkachamara BBC, enwenwughi ike ịga ije ka ọ nwechara mbuso agha transient ischemic.

rows.source: He wrote on Twitter: "A month ago today I suffered a stroke.
rows.output: O dere na Twitter: "Otu ọnwa gara aga taa, enwere m ọrịa strok.
rows.reference: Ọ dere na Twitter: “Otu ọnwa gara aga taa enwere m ọrịa mkpọnwụ ahụ.

rows.source: I could not walk.
rows.output: Enweghị m ike ịga ije.
rows.reference: Enwenwughi ike ịga ije.

rows.source: Doctors said only time will tell if I will recover or to what degree.
rows.output: Ndị dọkịta kwuru na naanị oge ga-egosi ma m ga-agbake ma ọ bụ ruo n'ókè.
rows.reference: Ndị dọkịnta kwuru naanị oge ga-ekwu na m enwere ike ịlaghachite ma ọ bụ kedu oke m ga-eru.

rows.source: Its been grueling work but made a full recovery, re-learned how to walk and today doing agility drills!
rows.output: Ọrụ ahụ siri ike ma mgbake zuru oke, mụtara ịga ije ọzọ ma taa na-eme ọrụ mgbatị!
rows.reference: Ọ bụ nnukwu ọrụ mana alaghachitere m n’uju, mụgharịa otu esi aga ije ma taa m na eme ọrụ siri ike!

rows.source: Thanks for the messages of encouragement!"
rows.output: Daalụ maka ozi ndị na-akpali akpali!"
rows.reference: Daalụ maka ozi nke nkasị obi!”

rows.source: Breast pump advert comparing mothers to cows divides opinion online
rows.output: Mgbapụta ara na-ekwupụta na-ekewa echiche n'ịntanetị
rows.reference: Mgbasa ozi ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara na atụle ndị nne yana ehi kewara echiche n’ịntanetị

rows.source: A breast pump company has divided opinion online with an advert that compares nursing mothers to cows being milked.
rows.output: Otu ụlọ ọrụ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ dị mma n'ịntanetị na mgbasa ozi na-egosi na ị na-azụ nwa na ịnyịnya na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mmiri ara ehi na-eme ka mm
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara ekewaala echiche n’ịntanetị site na iji mgbasa ozi na atụle ndị nne yana ehi a na amị ara ha.

rows.source: To mark the launch of what is said to be the "world's first silent wearable breast bump," consumer tech company Elvie released a tongue-in-cheek music video-inspired advert to showcase the freedom the new pump gives to expressing mothers.
rows.output: Iji mee ememe mmalite nke ihe a na-ekwu na ọ bụ "ụwa mbụ na-adịghị ụda na-eyi uwe aka," ụlọ ọrụ teknụzụ na-eri ahịa Elvie wepụtara ihe onyonyo egwu na-akpali akpali iji gosi nnwere onwe nke igwe ọhụrụ ahụ na-enye ndị nne na-eme ihe.
rows.reference: Iji kapụta mbido nke ihe ekwuru ga-abụ “ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara a na eyi eyi zoro ezo nke izizi n’ụwa,” ụlọ ọrụ teknụzụ ndi ahia Elvie buputere mgbasa ozi vidiyo na egwu na atọ ọchi iji gosipụta nnwere onwe ihe mgbapụta ọhụrụ ahụ na enye ndi nne.

rows.source: Four real mothers dance in a hay-filled barn of cows to a track that includes lyrics like: "Yes, I milk myself, but you don't see no tail" and "In case you hadn't noticed these are not udders, they're my boobs."
rows.output: Mmadụ anọ nke bụ ezigbo nne na-eme egwu n'ime ụlọ ọrụ ahụhụ nke e ji ahịhịa juru, na-eme egwu nke gụnyere egwu dị ka: "Ee, m na-eme mmiri ara ehi n'onwe m, mana ị hụghị ọdụ ọdụ" na "N'ọnọdụ ị hụbeghị na ọ bụghị mmiri ara ehi, ọ bụ ụkwụ m."
rows.reference: Ezigbo ndị nne anọ gbara egwu n’ọba ehi nke nri ehi juru n’egwu nwere okwu ndị dị ka: “Ee, m na amịpụta mmiri ara m, mana ị gaghị ahụ ọdụdụ ọ bụla ”Ọ bụrụ na ị chọpụtabeghị ndị a abụghị ara ehi, ndị a bụ ara m.”

rows.source: The chorus continues: "Pump it out, pump it out, I'm feeding them babies, pump it out, pump it out, I'm milking my ladies."
rows.output: Abụ ahụ gara n'ihu: "Kwụpụ ya, kwụpụ ya, ana m eji nwa ọhụrụ na-eri nri, kwụpụ ya, kwụpụ ya, ana m eji ndị inyom m na-eri nri."
rows.reference: Isi egwu gara n’ihu: “Gbapụta ya, gbapụta ya, m na enye ụmụ ntakịrị nri, gbapụta ya, gbapụta ya, ụmụ nwanyị m, m na amịpụta mmiri ara.”

rows.source: However, the advert, which has been published on the firm's Facebook page, has caused controversy online.
rows.output: Ọbụna, mgbasa ozi ahụ, nke e bipụtara na ibe Facebook nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, akpatala esemokwu n'ịntanetị.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, mgbasa ozi ahụ, nke ebiputegoro n’ibe Facebook nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, ebutela nsogbu n’ịntanetị.

rows.source: With 77,000 views and hundreds of comments, the video has received mixed reactions from viewers, with many saying it makes light of the "horrors" of the dairy industry.
rows.output: N'ime 77,000, ndị na-ekiri na-enwekwa mmeghachi omume dị iche iche, ebe ọtụtụ ndị na-ekwu na ọ na-eme ka "ajọ ihe" nke ụlọ ọrụ mmiri ara ehi ghara ịdị njọ.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere nlele 77,000 yana narị ọnụọgụ nke okwu ntụkwasa, vidio ahụ enwetala ndapụta dị iche iche n’aka ndị nlele, ebe imirikiti na ekwu na ọ na eme ka “ihe egwu” nke ụlọ ọrụ mmiri ara ehi dị mfe n’anya.

rows.source: "Very poor decision using cows to advertise this product.
rows.output: "Ọ dị njọ nke ukwuu ịhọrọ ịzụ ahịa na anụ ụlọ iji kwado ngwaahịa a.
rows.reference: “Nnukwu ajọ mkpebi iji ehi wee gbasaa ozi ngwaahịa a.

rows.source: Like us they need to get pregnant and give birth in order to produce milk, except their babies are stolen from them within days of giving birth," one wrote.
rows.output: Dị ka anyị, ha kwesịrị ịmụ nwa ma mụọ nwa iji mụọ mmiri ara ehi, ewezuga na a na-awakpo ụmụ ha n’ime ụbọchị ole na ole ka e mesịrị ịmụ nwa.
rows.reference: Dị ka anyị ha ga-adị ime wee mụọ nwa iji mepụta mmiri ara, naanị na a na ezuru ụmụ ha n’ime ụbọchị ole ma ole ka ha mụchara nwa,” otu onye dere.

rows.source: The Elvie breast pump fits discreetly inside a nursing bra (Elvie/Mother)
rows.output: Ihe mkpofu ara Elvie dabara nke ọma n'ime uwe nwa ara (Elvie/Nne)
rows.reference: Ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara Elvie ahụ na ezo n’ime bra nwanyị na elekọta nwa (Elvie/Mother)

rows.source: Another commented: "Understandably traumatic for both mother and baby.
rows.output: Otu onye kwuru: "N'ezie, ọ na-ewute nke ukwuu maka nne na nwa.
rows.reference: Ọzọ dere: “Ihe nnukwu ụjọ aghọtara maka nne yana nwa.

rows.source: But yeah why not use them to advertise a breast pump for mothers who get to keep their babies?"
rows.output: Mana ee, gịnị kpatara na anyị agaghị eji ha na-eme ihe iji kwado igwe mmiri ara ehi maka ndị nne na-azụ ụmụ ha?"
rows.reference: Mana ee gịnị kpatara na ejighi ha iji gbasaa ozi ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara maka ndị nne nwere ohere idowe ụmụ ha?”

rows.source: Someone else added: "Such an out of touch advert."
rows.output: Onye ọzọ gbakwunyere: "Ihe mgbasa ozi dị otú ahụ adịghị njikọ."
rows.reference: Otu onye ọzọ tinyekwara” “Ụdịrị mgbasa ozi na enweghị isi.”

rows.source: Others defended the advert, with one woman admitting that she found the song "hilarious."
rows.output: Ndị ọzọ gbachitere mgbasa ozi ahụ, otu nwanyị kwetara na abụ ahụ "dị egwu."
rows.reference: Ndị ọzọ kwuchitere mgbasa ozi ahụ, otu nwanyị kwenyere na egwu ahụ tọrọ ya “ọchị.”

rows.source: "I think this is a genus idea.
rows.output: "Ekwenyere m na nke a bụ echiche nke ụdị.
rows.reference: “Echere m na nke a bụ alo mara oke mma.

rows.source: I would've had one if I was still breastfeeding.
rows.output: Ọ gaara m enwe otu ma ọ bụrụ na m ka na-azụ ụmụ.
rows.reference: Enwere m ike ịzụta otu ọ bụrụ na m na enye nwa ara.

rows.source: Pumping made me feel exactly like a cow.
rows.output: Iji mmiri na-eme ka m nwee mmetụta dị ka ehi.
rows.reference: Mgbapụta mere m dị ka ehi kpọmkwem.

rows.source: The advert is a little mad but I took it for what it was.
rows.output: Mgbasa ozi ahụ bụ ntakịrị ara mana m were ya dịka ọ dị.
rows.reference: Mgbasa ozi ahụ bụtụ ihe isi mgbaka mana enwere ya ka ọ dị.

rows.source: This is a genius product," one wrote.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ngwaahịa nke ọgụgụ isi," otu onye dere.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ ngwaahịa nnukwu ọgụgụ isi,” otu onye dere.

rows.source: Another commented: "This is a fun advert aimed at mums who pump (often in their workplaces or toilets) and feel like "cows."
rows.output: Otu onye kwuru: "Nke a bụ mgbasa ozi na-atọ ụtọ nke e mere maka ndị nne na-eme mmiri ara ehi (na-emekarị n'ọfịs ha ma ọ bụ ụlọ mposi) ma na-enwe mmetụta dị ka "ehi."
rows.reference: Ọzọ dere: “Nke a bụ mgbasa ozi ọhụụ ezubere maka ndi nne na eme mgbapụta (oge ụfọdụ n’ebe ọrụ ma ọ bụ ụlọ mposi ha) na ahụta onwe ha ka “ehi.”

rows.source: This is not an advert praising or judging the dairy industry."
rows.output: Nke a abụghị mgbasa ozi na-eto ma ọ bụ na-eme mkpebi banyere ụlọ ọrụ mmiri ara ehi."
rows.reference: Nke a abụghị mgbasa ozi na eto ma ọ bụ na ama ụlọ ọrụ mmiri ara ikpe.”

rows.source: At the end of the video the group of women reveal they've all been dancing with the discreet pumps tucked in their bras.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ vidiyo ahụ, otu ụmụ nwanyị ahụ kpughere na ha niile na-agba egwu na obere ọkụ ndị zoro ezo n'ime bras ha.
rows.reference: Na ngwụcha nke vidio ahụ otu nke ụmụ nwanyị ahụ gosiri na ha na agba egwu kemgbe mana enwere ihe mgbapụta zoro ezo n’ime bra ha.

rows.source: The concept behind the campaign is based on the insight that many women who breast-pump say they feel like cows.
rows.output: Echiche dị n'azụ mgbasa ozi ahụ dabere n'echiche na ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-eme mmiri ara ehi na-ekwu na ha na-enwe mmetụta dị ka ehi.
rows.reference: Nghọta nke kwadobere mgbasa ozi ahụ dabere na nghọta na imirikiti ụmụ nwanyị na agbapụta mmiri ara kwuru na ha na ahụta onwe ha ka ehi.

rows.source: The Elvie Pump however, is completely silent, has no wires or tubes and fits discreetly inside a nursing bra, giving women the freedom to move, hold their babies, and even go out while pumping.
rows.output: Elvie Pump, nke dị ọcha kpamkpam, enweghị eriri ma ọ bụ tii ma dabara nke ọma n'ime bra na-azụ nwa, na-enye ụmụ nwanyị ohere ịkwaga, jide ụmụ ha, ma ọbụna pụọ mgbe ha na-eme mmiri ara ehi.
rows.reference: Ihe Mgbapụta Elvie kaosiladị, zoro ezo kpamkpam, ọ nwere eriri ma ọ bụ okpoko ma zobaa n’ime bra onye na elekọta nwa, na enye ụmụ nwanyị ogere ịgagharị, jide nwa ha, ma pụọ ka ha na agbapụta mmiri ara.

rows.source: Ana Balarin, partner and ECD at Mother commented: "The Elvie Pump is such a revolutionary product that it deserved a bold and provocative launch.
rows.output: Ana Balarin, onye mmekọ na ECD na Nne kwuru: "Elvie Pump bụ ngwaọrụ na-emebi emebi nke ọma na ọ chọrọ mmalite siri ike na nke na-akpali akpali.
rows.reference: Ana Balarin, onye mmeko na ECD na Mother kwukwasara: “Ihe Mgbaputa Elvie bụ ụdị nnukwu ngwaahịa ọhụrụ kwesịrị mbupute na akpalite mmụọ.

rows.source: By drawing a parallel between expressing women and dairy cows we wanted to put breast pumping and all its challenges in the spotlight, while demonstrating in an entertaining and relatable way the incredible sense of freedom that the new pump will bring.
rows.output: Site n'ime ihe yiri nke ikwuputa ụmụ nwanyị na ehi na-eri mmiri ara ehi, anyị chọrọ ịkọwapụta mmiri ara ehi na ihe ịma aka niile ọ na-eweta, ebe anyị na-egosi n'ụzọ na-atọ ụtọ na nke a na-ahụ anya ihe ịtụnanya nke nnwere onwe nke igwe ọhụrụ ahụ ga-eweta.
rows.reference: Site na igosi ndịiche n’etiti ụmụ nwanyị na elekọta nwa yana ehi na amịpụta mmiri ara anyị chọrọ itinye mgbapụta mmiri ara yana aka mgba ya niile na mgbado anya, na egosipụtakwa ya ụzọ na enye ọhụụ ma bụrụ nke gaa eru ụlọ, mmetụta nke nnwere onwe dị ukwuu nke ihe mgbapụta ọhụrụ ahụ ga-ewete.

rows.source: This is not the first time the Elvie pump has made the headlines.
rows.output: Nke a abụghị oge mbụ Elvie pump pụtara n'isiokwu.
rows.reference: Nke a abụghị izizi ihe mgbapụta Elvie mere ihe mkpọtụ.

rows.source: During London Fashion Week, a mother of two appeared on the catwalk for designer Marta Jakubowski while using the product.
rows.output: N'oge London Fashion Week, nne nke abụọ pụtara n'elu ụgbọ okporo ígwè maka onye na-emepụta ihe Marta Jakubowski ebe ọ na-eji ngwaahịa ahụ eme ihe.
rows.reference: N’oge Izu Ekike London, nne ụmụaka abụọ pụtara na warawara ụzọ ịga ije maka onye ọmenka Marta Jakubowski ka ọ na eji ngwaahịa ahụ.

rows.source: Hundreds of Migrant Children Quietly Moved to a Tent Camp on the Texas Border
rows.output: Puku nke ụmụaka ndị na-akwaga mba ọzọ na-akwagharị n'udo gaa n'ogige ụlọikwuu dị n'akụkụ Texas
rows.reference: Narị Kwụrụ Narị nke Ụmụaka Gbabatara N’obodo Nwayọ Gara na Ogige Akanya na Oke Ala Texas

rows.source: The number of detained migrant children has spiked even though monthly border crossings have remained relatively unchanged, in part because harsh rhetoric and policies introduced by the Trump administration have made it harder to place children with sponsors.
rows.output: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụaka ndị na-akwaga mba ọzọ nọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ abawanyela n'agbanyeghị na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-akwaga mba ọzọ n'ọnwa ọ bụla agbanwebeghị nke ukwuu, n'otu akụkụ n'ihi okwu siri ike na amụma ndị ọchịchị Trump webatara nke mere ka ọ sie ike itinye ụmụaka n'aka ndị na-ahụ maka ha.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ nke ụmụaka ndị gbabatara n’obodo ejidere ejide agbagoola na agbanyeghị na ngafe oke ala kwa ọnwa agbanwebeghị nke ukwuu, n’ihi nkwupụta ike na iwu nke nchịkwa Trump webatara emeela ka o sikwuo ike idowe ụmụaka n’aka ndị nkwado.

rows.source: Traditionally, most sponsors have been undocumented immigrants themselves, and have feared jeopardizing their own ability to remain in the country by stepping forward to claim a child.
rows.output: N'ime oge gara aga, ọtụtụ ndị na-akwado ya bụ ndị na-akwaga mba ọzọ na-enweghị akwụkwọ, na-atụ egwu na ha ga-emebi ikike ha nwere ịnọgide na mba ahụ site n'ịbụ ndị na-ebu ụzọ kwuo na ha nwere nwa.
rows.reference: N’ọdịnala, imirikiti ndị nkwado bubu ndị mgbabata n’onwe ha enweghị ndekọ, ha nwere ụjọ imebi ikike nke ha iji nọrọ n’obodo ahụ site na ịbịa ihu iji zọrọ otu nwa.

rows.source: The risk increased in June, when federal authorities announced that potential sponsors and other adult members of their households would have to submit fingerprints, and that the data would be shared with immigration authorities.
rows.output: Ihe ize ndụ ahụ mụbara na June, mgbe ndị ọchịchị etiti kwupụtara na ndị nwere ike ịkwado na ndị ọzọ toro eto nke ezinụlọ ha ga-enwerịrị mkpịsị aka, na data ga-ekerịta na ndị ọrụ mbata na ọpụpụ.
rows.reference: Ihe egwu ahu gbagoro na Juun, mgbe ndị ikike etiti obodo kwuputere na ndị nkwado nwere ike ịbịa na ndị okenye nke ezinụlọ ha ndị ọzọ ga-enyefe mbisa mkpịsị aka, na a ga-ekekọrịta data ha n’etiti ndị ikike mbata na ọpụpụ.

rows.source: Last week, Matthew Albence, a senior official with Immigration and Customs Enforcement, testified before Congress that the agency had arrested dozens of people who applied to sponsor unaccompanied minors.
rows.output: N'izu gara aga, Matthew Albence, onye isi ọrụ na Immigration and Customs Enforcement, gbara ndị omebe iwu ume ka ha kwuo na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ejidela ọtụtụ mmadụ ndị rịọrọ ka ha kwado ụmụaka na-enweghị nne na nna.
rows.reference: Izu gara aga, Matthew Albence, otu onye isi na Mmanye Mbata na Ọpụpụ na Kọstọms, kwuru n’ihu Kọngress na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ejidela ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ ndị tinyere akwụkwọ ka ha bụrụ ndị nkwado maka ụmụ ntakịrị na enweghị ndị so ha.

rows.source: The agency later confirmed that 70 percent of those arrested did not have prior criminal records.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ mechara kwupụta na 70 pasent nke ndị a nwụchiri enweghị ndekọ mpụ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ mechara kwenye na pasentị 70 nke ndị ahụ ejidere enwebughi ndekọ omekome na mbụ.

rows.source: "Close to 80 percent of the individuals that are either sponsors or household members of sponsors are here in the country illegally, and a large chunk of those are criminal aliens.
rows.output: "N'ime pasentị iri asatọ nke ndị a bụ ma ọ bụ ndị na-akwado ma ọ bụ ndị òtù ezinụlọ nke ndị na-akwado, ha nọ ebe a n'ụzọ iwu na-akwadoghị, na nnukwu akụkụ n'ime ndị a bụ ndị omekome.
rows.reference: “Ihe rutere pasentị 80 nke ndị mmadụ bụ ndị nkwado ma ọ bụ onye otu ezinụlọ nke ndị nkwado nọ n’obodo a n’ụzọ gabigara iwu, ọtụtụ n’ime ndị ahụ bụ ndị mbịambịa gabigara iwu.

rows.source: So we are continuing to pursue those individuals," Mr. Albence said.
rows.output: Ya mere, anyị na-aga n'ihu na-achụ ndị mmadụ ahụ, ka Mr. Albence kwuru.
rows.reference: Yabụ anyị na aga n’ihu na achụ ndị mmadụ ahụ,” Maazị Albence kwuru.

rows.source: Seeking to process the children more quickly, officials introduced new rules that will require some of them to appear in court within a month of being detained, rather than after 60 days, which was the previous standard, according to shelter workers.
rows.output: N'ịgbalị ịrụ ọrụ ụmụaka ngwa ngwa, ndị ọrụ gọọmentị webatara iwu ọhụrụ nke ga-eme ka ụfọdụ n'ime ha pụta n'ụlọ ikpe n'ime ọnwa 1 ka ejidere ha, kama ụbọchị 60, nke bụ ụkpụrụ gara aga, dịka ndị ọrụ ebe nchekwa si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ịchọ ịhazi ụmụaka ahụ ọsọ ọsọ karịa, ndị ọrụ webatara iwu ọhụrụ ga-achọ ka ụfọdụ ha gosi n’ụlọ ikpe n’ime otu ọnwa nke ejidere ha, karịa ka ụbọchị 60 gachara, nke bubu ọkọlọtọ dịbu adị, site n’aka ndị ọrụ ebe obibi.

rows.source: Many will appear via video conference call, rather than in person, to plead their case for legal status to an immigration judge.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị ga-apụta site na oku vidiyo, kama ịbụ ndị dị ndụ, iji rịọ ka e mee ihe gbasara iwu ha nye onye ọka ikpe mbata na ọpụpụ.
rows.reference: Imirikiti ga-egosi site na oku nzụkọ vidio, kama n’onwe, iji rịọ okwu ha maka ọkwa iwu n’ihu ọkaikpe mbata na ọpụpụ.

rows.source: Those who are deemed ineligible for relief will be swiftly deported.
rows.output: Ndị a na-ewere na ha adịghị mma maka enyemaka ga-ebupụ ha ngwa ngwa.
rows.reference: A ga-ebupu ndị ahụtara ka ndị na etozughi maka ihe elele ozugbo.

rows.source: The longer that children remain in custody, the more likely they are to become anxious or depressed, which can lead to violent outbursts or escape attempts, according to shelter workers and reports that have emerged from the system in recent months.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ebe mgbaba na akụkọ ndị pụtara n'ime ọnwa ole na ole gara aga na-ekwu na ka ụmụaka nọrọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ, ka ha na-enwekwu nchegbu ma ọ bụ mwute, nke nwere ike ibute ọgbaghara ma ọ bụ mgbalị ịgbapụ.
rows.reference: Ka ụmụaka ahụ na anọte aka na njide, ka ha nwekwara ike ịnwekwu obi mmaja ma ọ bụ obi mmapụ, nke nwere ike ibute ngosipụta iwe ọkụ ma ọ bụ ọnwụnwa mgbapụ, site n’aka ndị ọrụ ebe obibi yana mkpesa pụtara na sistemụ ahụ n’ọnwa nso nso a.

rows.source: Advocates said those concerns are heightened at a larger facility like Tornillo, where signs that a child is struggling are more likely to be overlooked, because of its size.
rows.output: Ndị na-akwado ya kwuru na nchegbu ndị a na-abawanye n'ụlọ ọrụ buru ibu dị ka Tornillo, ebe ihe ịrịba ama na-egosi na nwatakịrị na-agbasi mbọ ike nwere ike ịghara ịhụ ya n'ihi nha ya.
rows.reference: Ndị nkwuchite kwuru na echiche ndị ahụ na agbalite na nnukwu ụlọ dị ka Tornillo, ebe mgbama na nwata na enwe nhịahụ na ka enwe nleghara anya karịa, n’ihi nha ya.

rows.source: They added that moving children to the tent city without providing enough time to prepare them emotionally or to say goodbye to friends could compound trauma that many are already struggling with.
rows.output: Ha kwuru na ịkwaga ụmụaka n'ogige ụlọikwuu ahụ na-enweghị inye ha oge zuru ezu iji kwadebe ha n'ụzọ mmetụta uche ma ọ bụ ikwu ndị enyi ha nke ọma nwere ike ime ka mmetụta ọjọọ nke ọtụtụ n'ime ha na-enwe ugbu a.
rows.reference: Ha tinyere na ibuga ụmụaka n’obodo akanya ahụ na enyeghi oge zuru oke iji kwadobe mmụọ ha ma ọ bụ iji kelee ndị enyi ha nwere ike ibuwanye mmaja ọtụtụ n’ime ha na enwe ugbu a.

rows.source: Syria tells US, French and Turkish 'occupying forces' to withdraw immediately
rows.output: Syria na-agwa ndị agha US, French na Turkish ka ha pụọ ozugbo
rows.reference: Syria gwara ‘ndị agha nọ n’obodo ha’ nke US, French na Turkey mebere ka ha pụọ ozugbo

rows.source: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem also called on Syrian refugees to come home, even though the country's war is now in its eighth year.
rows.output: N'ịgbakọ ọgbakọ mba ụwa, Mịnịsta na-ahụ maka mba ofesi Walid al-Moualem kpọkwara ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ na Syria ka ha laghachi n'ụlọ, n'agbanyeghị na agha obodo ahụ eruola afọ asatọ.
rows.reference: Ikwu okwu n’ihu Mgbakọ Ezumezu UN, Minista Ofesi Walid al-Moualem kpọkwara ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ na Syria ka ha laghachite, agbanyeghị na ọgụ nke obodo ahụ nọ n’afọ asatọ ya.

rows.source: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
rows.output: Moualem, onye na-eje ozi dịka onye isi ala, kwuru na ndị agha mba ọzọ nọ n'ala Siria n'ụzọ iwu na-akwadoghị, n'okpuru ụdị ịlụ ọgụ megide iyi ọha egwu, na "a ga-ahụ ha n'anya."
rows.reference: Moualem, onye na arụkwa ọrụ ka osote praịm minista, kwuru na ndị agha ofesi ahụ nọ n’ala Syrian n’ụzọ gabigara iwu, n’okpuru nzuzo nke iluso ndị alụọ alaa ọgụ, na “a ga-emeso ha omume otu ekwesịrị.”

rows.source: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.
rows.output: "Ha ga-ewepụ ozugbo na-enweghị ọnọdụ ọ bụla," o kwuru n'ọgbakọ ahụ.
rows.reference: “Ha ga-apụrịrị ozugbo na enweghị ọnọdụ ọ bụla,” ọ gwara ọgbakọ ahụ.

rows.source: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.
rows.output: Moualem kwusiri ike na "agha megide ụjọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ gwụ" na Syria, ebe ihe karịrị mmadụ 360,000 nwụrụ kemgbe 2011, na nde mmadụ ọzọ a chụpụrụ n'ụlọ ha.
rows.reference: Moualem kwusiri ike na “ọgụ nke ihe ụjọ agwụchaala” na Syria, ebe ihe karịrị ndị mmadụ 360,000 anwụọla na 2011, ebe ọnụọgụ nde ka achụpụrụ n’ụlọ ha.

rows.source: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."
rows.output: O kwuru na Damaskọs ga-aga n'ihu "ịlụ ọgụ a na-achọsi ike ruo mgbe anyị kpochapụrụ ala ndị Syria niile" nke otu ndị na-eyi ọha egwu abụọ na "onye ọ bụla na-abụghị onye obodo."
rows.reference: O kwuru Damascus ga-aga n’ihu “ịlụ ọgụ a ruo mgbe anyị chụpụrụ ndị alụọ ọlaa Syria niile” maka otu abụọ nke ndị ụjọ yana “ọnụnọ ofesi ọ bụla gabigara iwu.”

rows.source: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.
rows.output: Ndị agha United States nwere ihe dị ka ndị agha 2,000 na Syria, bụ́ ndị na-azụ na ịgwa ndị agha Kurdish na ndị Arabik na-emegide Onye isi ala Bashar al-Assad.
rows.reference: United States nwere ndị agha 2,000 n’ime Syria, bụkarị maka ọzụzụ na ịnye ndụmọdụ maka ndị agha Kurdish yana Syrian Arabs na agba Onye Isi Ala Bashar al-Assad mgba.

rows.source: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.
rows.output: Ndị agha France karịrị 1,000 nọ n'ala n'ala nke agha mebiri emebi.
rows.reference: France nwere karịa ndị agha 1,000 n’ala n’obodo ahụ ọgụ mebichagoro.

rows.source: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.
rows.output: N'ihe gbasara ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ, Moualem kwuru na ọnọdụ dị mma maka ha ịlaghachi, ma ọ katọrọ "ụfọdụ mba ọdịda anyanwụ" maka "ịgbasa egwu na-ezighị ezi" nke mere ka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ghara ịlaghachi.
rows.reference: N’okwu maka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ, Moualem kwuru ọnọdụ ndị ahụ dị mma maka ha ịlaghachite, wee tinye ụta n’isi “ụfọdụ obodo ọdịda anyanwụ” maka “ịfesa ụjọ na enweghị isi” nke manyere ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ịnọte aka.

rows.source: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.
rows.output: "Anyị ekwela ka obodo mba ụwa na òtù na-ahụ maka ọdịmma mmadụ na-eme ka a na-eweghachi ndị a."
rows.reference: “Anyị akpọọla ogbe ndị ofesi yana ọgbakọ ndị enyemaka mmadụ iji bido nlaghachite ndị a,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."
rows.output: "Ha na-eme ka ihe na-eme ka ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-eme ka ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-eme ka ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-eme ka ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-eme ka ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-eme ka ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na
rows.reference: “Ha ji ihe kwesịrị ịbụ naanị nsogbu enyemaka mmadụ eme ndọrọndọrọ.”

rows.source: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.
rows.output: Ndị United States na European Union ekwela na enweghị enyemaka mgbake maka Syria ruo mgbe e nwere nkwekọrịta ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị n'etiti Assad na ndị mmegide iji kwụsị agha ahụ.
rows.reference: United States na European Union adọọla aka na ntị na agaghị enwe enyemaka nrụgharị maka Syria ruo mgbe enwere nkwekọrịta ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị n’etiti Assad yana ndị mbuso agha iji kwụsị ọgụ ahụ.

rows.source: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.
rows.output: Ndị nnọchiteanya UN kwuru na nkwekọrịta n'oge na-adịbeghị anya dị n'etiti Rọshịa na Tọọkụ iji guzobe ebe nchekwa na mpaghara ikpeazụ nke nnupụisi nke Idlib emeela ka ohere dịrị iji gaa n'ihu na mkparịta ụka ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị.
rows.reference: Ndị nnọchite UN kwuru na nkwekọrịta nso nso a n’etiti Russia na Turkey iji tọọ mpaghara nchekwa n’ebe ndị mbuso agha ikpeazụ ka siri ike dị na Idlib nọ emepụtala ohere ij wee na achụ okwu ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị.

rows.source: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.
rows.output: Nkwekọrịta Rọshịa na Tọki gbochiri mwakpo buru ibu nke ndị agha Siria nke Rọshịa na-akwado na mpaghara ahụ, ebe nde mmadụ atọ bi.
rows.reference: Mkpebi Russian-Turkish ahụ kwụsịrị nnukwu nluso agha nke ndị agha Syria ndị Russia na akwadobe na mpaghara ahụ, ebe ọnụọgụ nde 3 ndị mmadu bi.

rows.source: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."
rows.output: Moualem kwuru na nkwekọrịta ahụ nwere "oge doro anya" ma gosipụta olile anya na a ga-elekwasị anya na ndị jihadist gụnyere ndị agha sitere na Nusra Front nke jikọtara ya na Al-Qaeda, bụ ndị "ga-akwatu."
rows.reference: Moualem kaosiladị kwụsịrị ike na nkwekọrịta ahụ nwere “oge njedebe ndị doro anya” ma kwupute olile anya na mmereme ndị agha ga-achụba ndị jihadist gụnyere ndị ọgụ si na Nusra Front jikọrọ al-Qaeda, ndị “ ga-ekpochapụ.”

rows.source: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.
rows.output: Onye nnọchite anya UN Staffan de Mistura na-atụ anya ịkpọkọta nzukọ mbụ nke otu ọhụrụ nke ndị gọọmentị na ndị mmegide na-achịkọta iwu nke a ga-eme mgbe agha gasịrị maka Syria na ịkwadebe ụzọ maka ntuli aka.
rows.reference: Onye ozi UN Staffan de Mistura na atụ anya ịme nzụkọ izizi ndị ahụ nke ọgbakọ ọhụrụ emepụtara n’ime ndị gọọmentị na ndị otu mbuso agha iji depụta akwụkwọ iwu osote ọgụ maka Syria ma dozie ụzọ maka ntuli aka.

rows.source: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.
rows.output: Moualem tọrọ ntọala ọnọdụ maka itinye aka n'ọchịchị Siria n'ime kọmitii ahụ, na-ekwu na ọrụ kọmitii ahụ kwesịrị ịdị na "nyocha isiokwu nke iwu ugbu a", ma dọọ aka ná ntị megide ịbanye n'ọrụ.
rows.reference: Moualem tụsara ọnọdụ maka nsonye gọọmentị Syria n’ọgbakọ ahụ, na ekwu na ọrụ ọgbakọ ahụ kwesịrị ka amachie ya na “inyocha edemede nke akwụkwọ iwu dị ugbu a,” ma dọọ aka na ntị maka itinye aka.

rows.source: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term
rows.output: Gịnị mere Trump ji ga-emeri n'ọkwa nke abụọ
rows.reference: Ihe Kpatara Na Trump Ga-emeri Agba Nke Abụọ

rows.source: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.
rows.output: N'ime ụkpụrụ ahụ, Maazị Trump ga-emeri ntuli aka 2020 ọzọ, ma ọ bụrụ na, dị ka ọtụtụ ndị na-ahụ maka ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya nwere ike ịtụ anya, ịwepụ ya na ịkpa ókè agbụrụ ga-eme ka ọchịchị ya kwụsị tupu oge ya.
rows.reference: Site na echiche ahụ, Maazị Trump ga-emeri nhọpụtagharị na 2020 belụsọ na, ebe imirikiti ndị nghọta ezi uche nwere ike ị na atụ anya, mwepu n’oche na agwa ọjọọ ga-akwụsị ọchịchị ya n’oge.

rows.source: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"
rows.output: N'ime ihe nke ga-abụ "Ihe kachasị mkpa n'ikpeazụ nke ọchịchị ọ bụla!"
rows.reference: N’ihe ga-abụ na enweghị mgbagha “Ngwụcha ikpeazụ nke onye isi ala kachasị dị egwu!”
